潜在空间：基础、演化、机制、能力、前景The Latent Space: Foundation, Evolution, Mechanism, Ability, and Outlook

Xinlei Yu∗,⋆    Zhangquan Chen∗    Yongbo He∗    Tianyu Fu∗    Cheng Yang∗    Chengming Xu∗    Yue Ma∗    Xiaobin Hu∗,†    Zhe Cao    Jie Xu    Guibin Zhang    Jiale Tao    Jiayi Zhang    Siyuan Ma    Kaituo Feng    Haojie Huang    Youxing Li    Ronghao Chen    Huacan Wang    Chenglin Wu    Zikun Su    Xiaogang Xu    Kelu Yao    Kun Wang    Chen Gao    Yue Liao    Ruqi Huang    Tao Jin    Zhucun Xue    Cheng Tan†    Jiangning Zhang†    Wenqi Ren    Yanwei Fu    Yong Liu    Yu Wang    Xiangyu Yue†    Yu-Gang Jiang†    Shuicheng Yan† ∗* Core Contributors  †\dagger Core Supervisors   ⋆\star OrganizerNational University of Singapore, Fudan University, Tsinghua University, Zhejiang University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Renmin University of China, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, DeepWisdom, Nanjing University, Shanghai Jiatong University, Nanyang Technological University, Tencent Hunyuan, QuantaAlpha, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Zhejiang Lab, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Sun Yat-sen Universityhttps://github.com/YU-deep/Awesome-Latent-Space
摘要Abstract

潜在空间正在迅速成为基于语言的模型的原生基础。虽然现代系统仍然通过显式的令牌级生成来普遍理解，但越来越多的工作表明，许多关键的内部过程在连续的潜在空间中比在人类可读的语言痕迹中更自然地进行。这种转变是由显式空间计算的结构限制驱动的，包括语言冗余、离散化瓶颈、顺序低效和语义丢失。因此，对潜在空间的研究已经从早期的潜在推理扩展到更广泛的领域，涵盖规划、建模、感知、记忆、协作和体现。然而，文献在机制、模式和任务方面仍然支离破碎，缺乏关于如何定义、分类和研究潜在空间的统一视角。LLatent space is rapidly emerging as a native substrate for language-based models. While modern systems are still commonly understood through explicit token-level generation, an increasing body of work shows that many critical internal processes are more naturally carried out in continuous latent space than in human-readable verbal traces. This shift is driven by the structural limitations of explicit-space computation, including linguistic redundancy, discretization bottlenecks, sequential inefficiency, and semantic loss. As a result, research on latent space has expanded from early latent reasoning into a broader landscape spanning planning, modeling, perception, memory, collaboration, and embodiment. However, the literature remains fragmented across mechanisms, modalities, and tasks, lacking a unified perspective on how latent space is defined, classified, and studied.

这项调查旨在提供基于语言的模型中潜在空间的统一且最新的景观。我们将调查分为五个连续的视角：This survey aims to provide a unified and up-to-date landscape of latent space in language-based models. We organize the survey into five sequential perspectives:基金会Foundation, 进化论Evolution, 机制Mechanism, 能力Ability, 和, and展望Outlook。我们首先描绘潜在空间的范围，将其与显性或言语空间以及生成视觉模型中通常研究的潜在空间区分开来。然后，我们追踪该领域从早期探索性努力到当前大规模扩张的演变。为了组织技术景观，我们通过机制和能力的互补镜头来检查现有的工作。从以下角度来看. We begin by delineating the scope of latent space, distinguishing it from explicit or verbal space and from the latent spaces commonly studied in generative visual models. We then trace the field’s evolution from early exploratory efforts to the current large-scale expansion. To organize the technical landscape, we examine existing work through the complementary lenses of mechanism and ability. From the perspective of机制Mechanism，我们确定了四大发展路线：, we identify four major lines of development:建筑Architecture, 代表Representation, 计算Computation, 和, and优化Optimization。从以下角度来看. From the perspective of能力Ability，我们展示了潜在空间如何支持广泛的能力范围, we show how latent space supports a broad capability spectrum spanning推理Reasoning, 规划Planning, 造型Modeling, 感知Perception, 内存Memory, 协作Collaboration, 和, and具体实施方式Embodiment。除了整合之外，我们还讨论了关键的开放挑战，并概述了未来研究的有希望的方向。我们希望这项调查不仅可以作为现有工作的参考，而且可以作为理解潜在空间作为下一代智能的通用计算和系统范式的基础。. Beyond consolidation, we discuss the key open challenges, and outline promising directions for future research. We hope this survey serves not only as a reference for existing work, but also as a foundation for understanding latent space as a general computational and systems paradigm for next-generation intelligence.

1 简介Introduction

基于语言的模型的最新进展，包括大型语言模型（LLM）、视觉语言模型（VLM）、视觉语言动作模型（VLA）和基于语言主干的代理系统，仍然通过显式令牌级生成来普遍理解，其中输入、输出甚至中间推理都以人类可读的形式表达Recent advances in language-based models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs), and agentic systems built on language backbones, are still commonly understood through explicit token-level generation, where inputs, outputs, and even intermediate reasoning are expressed in human-readable form[vaswani2017attention, wei2022chain, yao2023react]。然而，这种以代币为中心的框架越来越不够. Yet this token-centric framing is increasingly insufficient[hao2024training, perception2025bigverdi, jihoon2025llm]。由于此类模型中的计算从根本上是通过连续激活展开的，因此潜在空间越来越多地不再被重新视为隐藏的实现细节，而是作为机器原生的基础，例如推理. Because computation in such models fundamentally unfolds through continuous activations, latent space is increasingly being reconceived not as a hidden implementation detail, but as a machine-native substrate, such as reasoning[hao2024training, zhu2025soft, xu2025softcot], 感知, perception[perception2025bigverdi, ahmed2025alignvlm], 内存, memory[zhang2025memgen, yu2025vismem], 通讯, communication[zheng2025thought, zou2025latent]，和行动, and action[huang2025thinkact, ni2025swiftvla]。这种转变部分是由显式空间的结构限制、其冗余、离散化瓶颈、顺序解码成本以及细粒度信息的潜在损失驱动的，特别是在复杂、多模态或长视野设置中。相比之下，潜在空间计算提供了一种更连续、更紧凑、更具表现力的媒介，可以支持更高保真度的表示和更灵活的计算分配。. This shift is driven in part by the structural limitations of explicit space, its redundancy, discretization bottleneck, sequential decoding cost, and potential loss of fine-grained information, especially in complex, multimodal, or long-horizon settings. By contrast, latent-space computation offers a more continuous, compact, and expressive medium that can support higher-fidelity representations and more flexible allocation of computation.

因此，研究已经远远超出了最初将潜在空间视为潜在推理的框架。最初的尝试是将思想链内化为连续状态，但已迅速扩展到更广泛的系统范式，涵盖新模式、新交互设置和新设计选择Research has therefore moved far beyond the initial framing of latent space as latent reasoning alone.What began as an attempt to internalize chain-of-thought into continuous states has rapidly expanded into a broader systems paradigm spanning new modalities, new interaction settings, and new design choices[reasoning2025chen, survey2025zhu, implicit2025li]。然而，这种增长也至少在三个方面使文献变得支离破碎：按应用对象，. However, this growth has also fragmented the literature in at least three ways: by application object,例如e.g.、潜在推理、视觉理解和具体行动；通过机制，, latent reasoning, visual understanding, and embodied action; by mechanism,例如e.g.、架构设计、表示选择、计算模式和优化策略；并按场景，涵盖文本、视觉、多代理系统和具体环境。现有的评论主要关注潜在推理或隐式推理作为一种特定于推理的现象。还缺少的是, architecture design, representation choice, computation pattern, and optimization strategy; and by scenario, spanning text, vision, multi-agent systems, and embodied environments. Existing reviews mainly focus on latent reasoning or implicit reasoning as a reasoning-specific phenomenon. What remains missing is a统一视角unified perspective它将潜在空间视为跨模式、范式、机制和能力的更广泛的计算和系统范式。that treats latent space as a broader computational and systems paradigm across modalities, paradigms, mechanisms, and capabilities.

为了解决这一差距，我们围绕五个连续的问题组织调查，从概念基础到未来展望，如图所示To address this gap, we organize the survey around five sequential questions that move from conceptual grounding to future outlook, as illustrated in Figure2: 什么是潜在空间？它是如何发展的？它是如何运作的？它有什么作用？接下来是什么？What is latent space? How did it develop? How does it work? What does it enable? What is next?这些问题定义了本文的宏观叙述：These questions define the macro-level narrative of the paper:基金会Foundation（节(Section2）描绘了) delineates the潜在空间的概念concept of latent space并阐明它与生成视觉模型中的显性空间和潜在空间的关系；and clarifies its relation to explicit space and to latent space in generative visual models;进化论Evolution（节(Section3）跟踪字段如何) traces how the field进步了progressed从原型探索到快速爆发；from prototype exploration to rapid outbreak;机制Mechanism（节(Section4) 解释了潜在空间是如何存在的) explains how latent space is实例化和可操作化instantiated and operationalized; 能力Ability（节(Section5）检查潜在计算可以实现什么) examines what latent computation enables across下游能力downstream capabilities;和; and展望Outlook（节(Section6) 综合) synthesizes开放的挑战和未来的方向open challenges and future directions。这个五个问题的叙述是有意连续的。这种组织使我们能够保留清晰的叙述，同时通过共享原则和能力结果（而不是仅通过特定于任务的标签）来比较不同的方法。. This five-question narrative is intentionally sequential. This organization allows us to preserve a clear narrative while also comparing diverse methods through shared principles and capability outcomes, rather than through task-specific labels alone.

在这个连续的叙述中，我们的技术综合以如图所示的二维分类法为基础。Within this sequential narrative, our technical synthesis is anchored by a two-dimensional taxonomy shown in Figure1。第一个轴，. The first axis,机制Mechanism，询问如何构建和使用潜在空间，涵盖四个主要内容：, asks how latent space is built and used, and covers four major lines:建筑Architecture, 代表Representation, 计算Computation, 和, and优化Optimization。第二轴，. The second axis,能力Ability，询问潜在空间可以实现什么，并涵盖七个主要功能领域：, asks what latent space enables, and covers seven major capability domains:推理Reasoning, 规划Planning, 造型Modeling, 感知Perception, 内存Memory, 协作Collaboration, 和, and具体实施方式Embodiment。这种设计使我们能够保留清晰的调查级别故事情节，同时还通过共享设计原则和共享能力结果来比较不同的方法，而不是仅通过特定于任务的标签。. This design lets us preserve a clear survey-level storyline while also comparing diverse methods through shared design principles and shared capability outcomes, rather than through task-specific labels alone.

2 基金会：什么是潜在空间？Foundation: What is Latent Space?

作为一种新兴范式，对语言模型潜在空间的探索展现出了巨大的潜力和进一步发展的空间。因此，本节对其正式定义以及与现有范式的比较进行了初步阐述。As an emerging paradigm, the exploration of the latent space within language models has exhibited immense potential and vast room for further development. Accordingly, this section provides a preliminary elaboration covering its formal definition and comparisons with existing paradigms.

2.1 概念Concept

在基于语言的模型中，In language-based models,即i.e.，经典的自回归模型，包括LLM、VLM、VLA和具有语言骨干的衍生系统，整个操作过程在, classic autoregressive models, encompassing LLMs, VLMs, VLAs, and derivative systems with language backbone, the entire operational process unfolds explicitly within the显式空间explicit space，或, or the言语空间verbal space [vaswani2017attention]。 最直接和外部可观察的域是：表达输入和输出的语言符号的离散空间。形式上，这个空间是由指定语言模型的下一个标记预测的词汇表定义的。在这个空间中，语言被表示为明显的言语单位，. The most immediate and externally observable domain is: the discrete space of linguistic symbols in which inputs and outputs are expressed. Formally, this space is defined by a vocabulary that specifies the language model’s next-token predictions. In this space, language is represented as overt verbalized units,即i.e., 子字级标记, subword-level tokens[sennrich2016neural]，人类可以直接解释。语言模型的训练目标通常是在这个显式空间中制定的，因为模型学习将概率分配给符号序列并预测给定文本前缀的下一个标记。, that are directly interpretable by humans. The training objective of a language model is typically formulated in this explicit space, since the model learns to assign probabilities to symbol sequences and to predict the next token given a textual prefix.

然而，基于语言的模型不仅仅对离散符号进行操作。为了通过语言进行计算，它首先将标记映射到内部连续表示，并通过多层非线性计算对其进行转换。这就产生了通常所说的However, a language-based model does not operate solely on discrete symbols. To compute over language, it first maps tokens into internal continuous representations and transforms them through multiple layers of nonlinear computation. This gives rise to what is commonly called the潜在空间latent space：连续的、学习的表征空间，模型在其中编码和操作未在标记级别明确表达的信息。更准确地说，语言模型的潜在空间可以理解为隐藏状态空间族，其中输入的上下文、语义、句法和关系特征在该空间中共同表示。因此，显式空间中的标记序列被映射到潜在空间的轨迹，并且这些潜在状态随后被投影回言语空间，以产生可能的下一个标记的概率分布。 此外，这个潜在空间可以扩展到语言之外的统一空间，将特定于模态的输入映射到连续的内部表示。 我们在章节中进一步提供了正式的定义和表述: the continuous, learned representational space in which the model encodes and manipulates information that is not explicitly verbalized at the token level. More precisely, the latent space of a language model can be understood as the family of hidden-state spaces, within which contextual, semantic, syntactic, and relational features of an input are jointly represented in this space. A token sequence in the explicit space is thus mapped to a trajectory of latent space, and these latent states are subsequently projected back into the verbal space to yield a probability distribution over possible next tokens. Furthermore, this latent space could be expanded into a unified space beyond language that maps modality-specific inputs into continuous internal representations. We further provide a formal definition and formulation in Section4.

2.2 与显式空间的比较Comparison with Explicit Space

为了进一步阐明潜在空间的独特特征，我们在几个关键维度上与传统的显性空间或言语空间进行了比较分析To further elucidate the unique characteristics of the latent space, we conduct a comparative analysis with the traditional explicit space, or verbal space, across several critical dimensions[xi2025rise, humze2025comprehensive, wu2025evolutionary]。如图所示. As demonstrated in Figure3，这种比较凸显了两种语言模型的表示属性和功能能力的范式转变。, this comparison highlights a paradigm shift in the representational properties and functional capabilities of the two language models.

2.2.1 代表性属性Representational Properties

语言模型的两种不同范式，The two distinct paradigms of language models,即i.e.显性空间和隐性空间在表征形式、信息处理方式和实际表现上表现出根本的区别。潜在空间使用, explicit space and latent space, exhibit fundamental differences in their representational forms, information processing modes, and practical performances. The latent space uses a机器原生Machine-native向量化表示即vectorized representation that is连续Continuous, 灵活Flexible, 高效Efficient，并且能够保存, and capable of preserving高保真High-fidelity语义信息。semantic information.

人类可读Human-readable与v.s.机器原生。Machine-native.在显式空间中，每个状态都表示为从有限词汇表中提取的自然语言标记序列。这赋予生成的轨迹具有直接的人类可读性和可验证性In the explicit space, every state is expressed as a sequence of natural language tokens drawn from a finite vocabulary. This endows the generated trajectories with direct human readability and verifiability[wei2022chain, yao2023react].

相比之下，潜在空间是一种机器原生的表征范式，缺乏人类的直接可读性。其核心表示是高维实值向量，其中各个维度与人类可解释的语义、结构或感知特征没有直接对应关系By contrast, the latent space is a machine-native representational paradigm that lacks direct human legibility. Its core representations are high-dimensional real-valued vectors, where individual dimensions do not have a straightforward correspondence to human-interpretable semantic, structural, or perceptual features[xu2025formal, jos2025beyond]。 针对语言模型的内在操作逻辑量身定制，模型可以处理潜在表示和操作，无需对人类可读信号进行转换，从而减少额外编码/解码开销带来的计算冗余. Tailored for the intrinsic operational logic of language models, the latent representation and operations can be processed by the model, without the need for transformations of human-readable signals, reducing computational redundancy from additional encoding/decoding overhead[hao2024training, saunshi2025reasoning, zhang2025memgen].

离散和符号Discrete & Symbolic与v.s.连续且灵活。Continuous & Flexible.显式空间表示是冗余的、离散的和象征性的。例如，复杂推理问题的思想链跟踪可能跨越数千个标记Explicit-space representations are redundant, discrete, and symbolic. For instance, a chain-of-thought trace for a complex reasoning problem may span thousands of tokens[wei2022chain]。每个标记都是一个离散的符号，其含义基于语言约定，并且与其他标记的关系通过位置和语法结构来表达. Each token is a discrete symbol whose meaning is grounded in linguistic convention, and the relationship to other tokens is expressed through positional and grammatical structure[xu2024symbol, lanham2023measuring]。这种解码模式在某种程度上是冗余和不灵活的：大多数标记服务于文本连贯性而不是实质性的语义内容. This decoding pattern is, in part, a redundancy and inflexibility: the majority of tokens serve textual coherence rather than substantive semantic contents[xia2025tokenskip, dong2025rethinking]。它们确保语法性，保持主题连续性，并满足自回归约束，即每个标记都是前一个序列的合理延续，并映射到有限的离散标记，这些义务与自回归生成的逻辑结构没有内在联系. They ensure grammaticality, maintain topic continuity, and satisfy the autoregressive constraint that each token be a plausible continuation of the preceding sequence and be mapped into a finite discrete token, obligations that have no intrinsic connection to the logical structure of the autoregressive generation[tang2024language, clara2021revisiting, xu2025formal].

相反，潜在空间表现出固有的连续性和灵活性。它以连续的形式封装核心语义信息，丢弃表面的语言冗余和符号映射Conversely, latent space exhibits inherent continuity and flexibility. It encapsulates core semantic information in a continuous form, discarding superficial linguistic redundancies and symbolic mapping[hao2024training, shen2025codi, zhu2025reasoning]。从离散标记化和自回归语言约定的约束中解放出来，这种性质赋予潜在空间在增强表征能力方面的独特优势：在推理模型中，它将显式推理轨迹提升到连续流形上. Liberated from the constraints of discrete tokenization and autoregressive linguistic conventions, this nature confers upon latent space distinct advantages in bolstering representational capacity: in reasoning models, it elevates explicit reasoning trajectories onto continuous manifolds[zhuang2026geometric, su2025token];在视觉场景中，它可以实现更流畅的多模态操作（; in visual scenarios, it enables smoother multimodal operations (例如e.g.、融合、对齐和交互）在以更窄的模态间隙为标志的潜在空间内, fusion, alignment, and interaction) within latent spaces marked by a narrower modality gap[sun2025latent, yu2025vismem, wu2026lavit];在协作中，它本质上是一种更适合信息存储和传输的媒介; in collaboration, it inherently serves as a more fitting medium for information storage and transmission[fu2025cache, zou2025latent]。 从本质上讲，连续和灵活的属性使基于语言的模型能够优先考虑内在语义本质，从而释放不同任务的潜力。. In essence, the continuous and flexible properties enable language-based models to prioritize the intrinsic semantic essence, unlocking potential across diverse tasks.

效率低下Inefficient与v.s.高效。Efficient.传统的自回归生成完全在显式离散空间内运行，这种范式本质上引入了至少三个基本的低效率Conventional autoregressive generation operates entirely within an explicit discrete space, and this paradigm inherently introduces at least three fundamental inefficiencies[xia2024unlocking, zhang2024uncovering]： 第一，语言冗余：自然语言作为显性空间的主要媒介，不可避免地引入了结构和语义冗余，进一步降低了效率: First, linguistic redundancy: as the main medium of explicit space, natural language introduces unavoidable structural and semantic redundancy, further reducing the efficiency[tang2024language, lanham2023measuring]; 其次，表征转换效率低下：模型被迫在每个生成步骤（包括中间步骤）通过狭窄、显式的通道传输表征; Second, representational transformation inefficiency: the model is forced to transfer representations through a narrow, explicit channel at every generation step, including intermediate steps[pfau2024let, liang2026do]。这种强制转换带来了不必要的高代表性转换成本。 第三，顺序解码开销：离散标记化将生成锁定到严格顺序的管道中：每个标记都需要完整的模型前向传递和词汇范围的概率计算。这种顺序范式不仅计算效率低而且增加了计算负担. This mandatory conversion introduces unnecessary and high representational conversion costs. Third, sequential decoding overhead: discrete tokenization locks generation into a strictly sequential pipeline: each token requires a full model forward pass and vocabulary-wide probability calculation. This sequential paradigm not only has low computational efficiency but also increases computational burden[leviathan2023fast, arip2025your]; 相比之下，潜在空间方法绕过了这些低效率，; In contrast, latent space methods bypass these inefficiencies,例如e.g.，删除代理间通信中的强制表示转换, removing mandatory representation conversion in inter-agent communication[zou2025latent, fu2025cache, zheng2025thought]，以及高效的循环或循环计算模式, and efficient recurrent or looped computation patterns[jonas2025scaling, saunshi2025reasoning].

语义有损Semantically-lossy与v.s.高保真度。High-fidelity.显式空间表示很容易出现语义丢失。当模型将其内部连续状态外部化为令牌序列时，从潜在激活到离散符号的映射会产生量化瓶颈：有限的词汇表和自然语言的组合约束限制了可以表达的内容Explicit-space representations are prone to semantic loss. When a model externalizes its internal continuous state as a token sequence, the mapping from latent activations to discrete symbols imposes a quantization bottleneck: a finite vocabulary and the combinatorial constraints of natural language delimit what can be expressed[wei2022outlier, alec2021learning]。因此，细粒度的不确定性、中间计算轨迹、跨模式对齐以及其他难以用语言呈现的结构可能会被压缩、扭曲或丢弃。从这个意义上说，自然语言构成了底层计算状态的语义有损转换。. As a result, fine-grained uncertainty, intermediate computational traces, cross-modal alignments, and other structures that are difficult to render in language may be compressed, distorted, or discarded. In this sense, natural language constitutes a semantically lossy transformation of the underlying computational state.

相比之下，潜在空间表示以更高的保真度保存信息。通过避免离散化和语言渲染，潜在变量可以在计算步骤之间携带丰富、连续的信息，包括自然语言无法表达的内容和自然支持多模态结构的表示。这种观点直接激发了潜在空间中越来越多的工作，例如持续的思考Latent-space representations, by contrast, preserve information with higher fidelity. By avoiding discretization and linguistic rendering, latent variables can carry rich, continuous information between computational steps, including content that is inexpressible in natural language and representations that naturally support multimodal structure. This perspective motivates a growing line of work directly in latent space, such as continuous thoughts[hao2024training, shen2025codi, zhu2025reasoning], 潜在记忆, latent memory[zhang2025memgen, yu2025vismem, hou2026flashmem]，以及潜在的视觉推理, and latent visual reasoning[li2025latent, yang2025machine], 等等etc.

2.2.2 功能能力Functional Capabilities

潜在空间作为机器原生的表征空间，拥有多种区别于显性空间的关键功能，包括The latent space, as a machine-native representational space, possesses multiple key functional capabilities that distinguish it from the explicit space, including操作性Operability, 表现力Expressiveness, 可扩展性Scalability, 概括Generalization，以及可评估性、可控性和可解释性，这些共同支撑了其在各种高级计算和表征任务中的实用性。, as well as Evaluability, controllability, and interpretability, which collectively underpin its utility in various advanced computational and representational tasks.

可操作性。Operability.作为机器原生的表征空间，潜在空间的可操作性将其实用性描述为结构化的、可微分的流形，充当多个内部计算基底。这种可操作性无缝地实现了直接计算（例如串联、线性组合、As a machine-native representational space, the operability of latent space characterizes its utility as a structured, differentiable manifold that serves as several internal computational substrates. This operability seamlessly enables direct calculations (such as concatenation, linear combination,等等etc.）以及高级操作，) and also advanced operations,例如e.g.，可控语义转向, controllable semantic steering[yang2025lfsteering, kazama2025geosteer]、积极干预, active intervention[zhu2025soft, li2025latentseek, fu2025tah], 迭代交织, iterative interleaving[liu2025reason, chen2025reasoning]，和视觉潜在思维, and visual latent thinking[zhang2025latentsketchpad, wang2025monet, sun2025latent]。 相反，显式空间中的离散标记本质上是不可微的，并且缺乏连续的、结构化流形的支持，使得上述细粒度、高级语义操作不可行，并且仅允许有限的、间接的标记级操作。. On the contrary, the discrete tokens in the explicit space are inherently non-differentiable and lack the support of a continuous, structured manifold, rendering the aforementioned fine-grained, advanced semantic operations infeasible and permitting only limited, indirect token-level operations.

表现力。Expressiveness.它是内化和操纵复杂、高维甚至非语言信息的核心能力。与受离散词汇和语法约定限制的自然语言相比，潜在空间内的表示提供了更丰富的表示基础。原则上可以表达包括但不限于整个显式空间的表征，实现高效的沟通It serves as a core capacity for internalizing and manipulating complex, high-dimensional, and even non-linguistic information. In contrast to natural language, which is constrained by a discrete vocabulary and grammatical conventions, representations within latent space provide a substantially richer representational substrate. In principle, it can express the representation including but not limited to the whole explicit space, enabling efficient communication[zou2025latent, zheng2025thought, yang2025internal]、视觉感知, visual perception[yang2025machine, perception2025bigverdi, chen2025think],具体行动计划, embodied action planning[bu2025univla, huang2025thinkact], 潜在记忆的形成, latent memory formation[zhang2025memgen, yu2025vismem], 等etc.

可扩展性。Scalability.它自然地遵循矢量化表示的紧凑性和并行性。因此，潜在空间方法处于有利位置，可以从更长推理轨迹的持续扩展中受益It follows naturally from the compactness and parallelizability of vectorized representations. Latent-space approaches are therefore well-positioned to benefit from continued scaling of longer reasoning trajectories[liu2025deliberation, ruan2025reasoning, tan2025think, wei2025simcot]，更深层次的代理交互转向, deeper agent interaction turns[zheng2025thought, yu2026dual]，以及测试时计算, and test-time compute[you2025parallel, jonas2025scaling, zhang2025latentevolve].

概括。Generalization.它进一步增强了有效概括与训练期间遇到的输入不同的输入的能力，这些输入捕获抽象语义结构而不是表面语言模式。通过将抽象语义概念嵌入到潜在空间中，模型获得了改进的跨域迁移和零样本泛化，从而能够将学习到的抽象迁移到以前未见过的任务和域。迁移学习It further bolsters the ability to generalize effectively to inputs distinct from those encountered during training, which capture abstract semantic structures rather than superficial linguistic patterns. By embedding abstract semantic concepts into a latent space, models gain improved cross-domain transfer and zero-shot generalization, enabling the transfer of learned abstractions to previously unseen tasks and domains. Transfer learning[zhan2025l2vcot, wezuke2025transfer]和跨域鲁棒性, and cross-domain robustness[zhang2025memgen, shi2025bridging, deng2025latent, yu2025vismem]经验表明，所有这些都可以从这种信息丰富的潜在表征中受益。have all been empirically shown to benefit from such informative latent representations.

可评估性、可控性和可解释性。Evaluability & Controllability & Interpretability.这表示人类或自动化系统评估、控制、观察、解释和审核自回归生成过程的能力。对于显式生成，生成的生成轨迹是可评估、可控和可解释的，因为每个中间步骤都以人类可读的格式表示This denotes the ability of humans or automated systems to evaluate, control, observe, interpret, and audit the autoregressive generation process. For explicit generation, the resulting generation traces are evaluable, controllable, and interpretable, as each intermediate step is represented in a human-readable format[lightman2024verify, korbak2025chain, ball2025human]。原则上，基于显式推理机制构建的系统可以集成人工验证或自动一致性检查。相比之下，机器原生的潜在空间表示使得人类本质上难以对生成过程进行精细的、直接的评估、控制和解释，这对模型的可评估性、可控性和可解释性提出了潜在的挑战（第 1 节）. In principle, systems built upon explicit reasoning mechanisms can integrate human-aligned verification or automated consistency checks. In contrast, machine-native latent space representations make it inherently difficult for humans to perform granular, direct evaluation, control, and interpretation of the generation process, posing potential challenges to model evaluability, controllability, and interpretability (Section6.2).

2.3 与生成视觉模型的比较Comparison with Generative Visual Models

生成视觉模型的潜在空间源自 VAE 式框架The latent space of generative visual models is derived from a VAE-style framework[kingma2014auto]，它学习从高维观察到紧凑连续表示的概率映射。随后的工作通过 VQ-VAE 引入了离散潜在代码, which learns a probabilistic mapping from high-dimensional observations to a compact continuous representation. Subsequent work introduced discrete latent codes via VQ-VAE[van2017neural]，潜在扩散模型向可扩展合成迈出了决定性的一步, and the decisive step toward scalable synthesis was taken by latent diffusion models[rombach2022high]，这表明在感知压缩的潜在空间中运行的扩散过程可以实现计算效率和高样本保真度。视频生成的扩展，包括 VideoLDM, which demonstrated that diffusion processes operating in a perceptually compressed latent space could achieve both computational efficiency and high sample fidelity. Extensions to video generation, including VideoLDM[andreas2023stable]和相关的架构，沿着时空轴进一步组织这个空间，将外观和运动编码为联合结构化的表示。and related architectures, further organized this space along a spatiotemporal axis, encoding appearance and motion as jointly structured representations.

尽管都依赖于学习的连续表征，但生成视觉模型和大型语言模型的潜在空间在几何结构、表征组织和条件机制方面存在根本差异。Despite the shared reliance on learned continuous representations, the latent spaces of generative visual models and large language models differ fundamentally in their geometric structure, representational organization, and conditioning regimes.

培训目标。Training Objective.生成视觉模型的潜在空间由重建目标明确塑造，该重建目标将学习的几何形状锚定到视觉信号的统计结构The latent space of generative visual models is explicitly shaped by a reconstruction objective, which anchors the learned geometry to the statistical structure of the visual signal[arash2021score, andreas2023stable]。这产生了相对平滑的局部欧几里得流形，其中编码点之间的线性插值产生感知上连贯的中间体，并且其中距离携带可解释的感知意义。语言模型隐藏状态不是重建目标，而是通过预测标准（自回归模型中的下一个标记预测）来组织. This produces a relatively smooth, locally Euclidean manifold in which linear interpolation between encoded points yields perceptually coherent intermediates, and in which distances carry interpretable perceptual meaning. Rather than a reconstruction objective, language model hidden states are organized by a predictive criterion, next-token prediction in autoregressive models[tom2020language]，对空间的几何形状没有明确的约束。, with no explicit constraint on the geometry of the space.

结构。Structure.视觉生成模型的潜在空间保持显式的时空结构：图像的潜在张量是补丁级代码的空间网格Latent space of visual generative models maintains an explicit spatiotemporal structure: the latent tensor of an image is a spatial grid of patch-level codes[esser2021taming, peebles2023scarable]，视频的网格沿着时间轴延伸，运动被视为一流的表征元素。这种结构规律反映了视觉场景的连续性、组合性，其中空间邻近性和时间连贯性是强归纳先验。相反，语言模型的潜在空间侧重于语言语义，缺乏空间拓扑或物理动力学。, and that of a video extends this grid along the temporal axis, with motion treated as a first-class representational element. This structural regularity reflects the continuous, compositional nature of visual scenes, in which spatial proximity and temporal coherence are strong inductive priors. On the contrary, the latent space of a language model focuses on the linguistic semantics and is devoid of spatial topology or physical dynamics.

可控性。Controllability.通过集成到模型本身的专用架构路径来精确控制视觉生成Precise control over visual generation is exercised through dedicated architectural pathways integrated into the model itself[zhang2023adding]。这些信号包括姿势序列、深度图、分割掩模和参考图像，通过直接应用于代表性基底内的调节，对生成的输出提供细粒度的空间局部控制。. These signals include pose sequences, depth maps, segmentation masks, and reference images, affording fine-grained, spatially localized control over the generated output by conditioning applied directly within the representational substrate.

3 进化：潜在空间是如何发展的？Evolution: How Did Latent Space Develop?

由于大型语言模型在一系列自然语言理解和推理任务中表现出了出色的性能，对其潜在空间的探索经历了非常快速和变革性的演变。 在本节中，我们追踪这一新兴范式的发展轨迹，将文献分为四个按时间顺序和主题连贯的阶段（图As large language models have demonstrated outstanding performance across a range of natural language understanding and reasoning tasks, the exploration of their latent spaces has undergone a remarkably rapid and transformative evolution. In this section, we trace the developmental trajectory of this emerging paradigm, organizing the literature into four chronologically and thematically coherent stages (Figure4): (1) 原型(1) Prototype（上一篇 - 2025 年 3 月），其中开创性的工作首次证明了将推理从离散标记序列转移到连续潜在表示的可行性；(Previous – Mar 2025), where pioneering works first demonstrated the feasibility of moving reasoning from discrete token sequences into continuous latent representations;(2) 阵型(2) Formation（2025 年 4 月至 7 月），建立了理论基础并出现了系统评估，研究主要集中在文本潜在推理和对多模态设置的初步探索；(Apr – Jul 2025), where theoretical foundations were established and systematic evaluations emerged, with research primarily centered on textual latent reasoning and initial explorations into multimodal settings;(3) 扩展(3) Expansion（2025 年 8 月 – 11 月），该领域迅速多元化，涵盖视觉任务、具体行动、多智能体协作和其他应用路径；和(Aug – Nov 2025), where the field rapidly diversified into visual tasks, embodied action, multi-agent collaboration, and other application paths; and(4) 疫情爆发(4) Outbreak（2025 年 12 月至今），爆炸性增长推动了架构创新、高级优化、严格的理论分析和跨模式集成走向成熟。(Dec 2025 – Present), where explosive growth drove architectural innovation, advanced optimization, rigorous theoretical analysis, and cross-modal integration toward maturity.

3.1 原型Prototype

原型阶段标志着潜在空间推理的起源，研究人员首先质疑大型语言模型是否必须用自然语言阐明每个中间推理步骤。在这个阶段，The prototype stage marks the genesis of latent space reasoning, where researchers first question whether large language models must articulate every intermediate reasoning step in natural language. In this stage,理论验证Theory Validation和and早期探索Early Exploration开始使用连续表示作为替代基底。begin to use continuous representations as an alternative substrate.

理论验证。Theory Validation.在第一个潜在系统出现之前，一些工作通过揭示类似推理的行为已经编码在语言模型的内部表示中，奠定了重要的基础。 以HCoT为代表Before the first latent systems appeared, several works laid essential groundwork by revealing that reasoning-like behavior is already encoded in the internal representations of language models. Represented by HCoT[liu2024expediting]，早期的前兆表明，完整的 CoT 跟踪可以通过对比语义对齐压缩为紧凑的特殊令牌表示，这表明显式 CoT 中的许多信息对于模型本身来说是多余的。 与此同时，, early precursors show that a full CoT trace can be compressed into a compact special-token representation via contrastive semantic alignment, suggesting that much of the information in explicit CoT is redundant for the model itself. Meanwhile,zhang2024uncovering通过从模型激活中提取引导向量来发现潜在思维向量，并证明在推理时注入这些向量可以引发类似 CoT 的推理，而无需任何微调或显式提示。 从理论角度来看，discovers latent thinking vectors by extracting steering vectors from model activations, and demonstrates that injecting these vectors at inference time can elicit CoT-like reasoning without any fine-tuning or explicit prompting. From a theoretical perspective,hu2024understanding提供了霍普菲尔德式的解释，将推理框架视为以认知神经科学为基础的跨表征空间的转换。 此外，潜在空间嵌入链offers a Hopfieldian interpretation, framing reasoning as transitions across representation spaces with grounding in cognitive neuroscience. Furthermore, Latent Space Chain-of-Embedding[wang2025latent]证明法学硕士可以通过潜在嵌入而不是明确的口头输出来进行自我评估。 这些先驱共同建立了一个重要的见解：语言模型的能力从根本上来说并不与离散的标记序列绑定，而是已经在其潜在空间中进行了实质性编码。demonstrates that LLMs can perform self-evaluation through latent embeddings rather than explicit verbal outputs. Together, these precursors establish a critical insight: the capacities of language models are not fundamentally bound to discrete token sequences, but are already substantially encoded in their latent spaces.

早期探索。Early Exploration.基于这些见解，初始阶段产生了一系列高影响力的作品，逐渐塑造了潜在空间推理的初始方向。 椰子Building on these insights, the initial stage produced a series of high-impact works that gradually shaped the initial direction of latent space reasoning. COCONUT[hao2024training]提出了第一个完整的连续潜在空间推理框架，将最后一个隐藏状态反馈作为下一个输入嵌入，形成绕过离散词汇瓶颈的连续思维循环。其主要发现是连续思维向量可以对多个潜在后续步骤的叠加进行编码，从而实现潜在空间中的紧急广度优先搜索。 沿着类似的基于压缩的方向，CCoTproposes the first complete framework for reasoning in continuous latent space, feeding the last hidden state back as the next input embedding to form a loop of continuous thoughts that bypasses the discrete vocabulary bottleneck. Its key finding is that continuous thought vectors can encode superpositions of multiple potential next steps, enabling emergent breadth-first search in latent space. Along a similar compression-based direction, CCoT[cheng2024compressed]引入了将显式推理链压缩为密集潜在形式的沉思标记。同时，introduces contemplation tokens that compress explicit reasoning chains into dense latent form. At the same time,liu2025deliberation通过离线协处理器使用潜在嵌入增强 KV 缓存，使解码器完全冻结。 两者都表明，可以通过参数有效的适应将潜在表示注入到现有模型中，而无需推理延迟开销。augments the KV cache with latent embeddings via an offline coprocessor, keeping the decoder entirely frozen. Both demonstrate that latent representation can be injected into existing models through parameter-efficient adaptation without inference latency overhead.

随后，胡金Subsequently, Huginn[jonas2025scaling]提出使用循环深度来扩展潜在空间中的测试时计算，迭代共享变压器块可变次数以隐式执行所有推理，而无需专门的推理数据。 软CoTproposes using recurrent depth to scale test-time compute in latent space, iterating a shared transformer block a variable number of times to perform all reasoning implicitly without specialized reasoning data. SoftCoT[xu2025softcot]提供了第一个潜在空间的插件方法，将特定于实例的软思想标记投影到冻结主干的表示空间中，以避免灾难性遗忘。provides the first plug-in approach to latent space, projecting instance-specific soft thought tokens into the frozen backbone’s representation space to avoid catastrophic forgetting.

总而言之，原型阶段确立了潜在空间推理的可行性，但也暴露了其第一个主要瓶颈：该领域仍然缺乏对潜在空间推理的系统描述。Taken together, the prototype stage establishes the feasibility of latent-space reasoning, but it also exposes its first major bottleneck: the field still lacks a systematic account of为什么why潜在推理有效，latent reasoning works,当when它优于显式 CoT，并且it outperforms explicit CoT, and如何how它的评估不应局限于孤立的概念验证演示。换句话说，现阶段的核心挑战不仅仅是能力，而是可解释性、形式化和可比性。这些限制直接推动了下一阶段，社区从分散的原型走向理论系统化、基准构建和更有原则性的技术设计。it should be evaluated beyond isolated proof-of-concept demonstrations. In other words, the central challenge at this stage is not capability alone, but interpretability, formalization, and comparability. These limitations directly motivate the next stage, where the community moves from scattered prototypes toward theoretical systematization, benchmark construction, and more principled technical design.

3.2 编队Formation

形成阶段从原型阶段的见解发展到建立更具有实际意义的研究计划。这一时期主要以文本潜在推理为中心，具有两个进步的特点：The formation stage advances from the prototype-stage insights toward building a more practically meaningful research program. This period is primarily centered on textual latent reasoning and is characterized by two advances:理论系统化Theoretical Systematization这解释了它为什么有效，that explains why it works,技术阵型Technical Formation它的工作原理是它的运作效果如何，以及扩展到多模式和具体环境的初步探索。that works on how well it works, and initial explorations of extension into multimodal and embodied settings.

理论系统化。Theory Systematization.这一阶段最具变革性的贡献是对连续思维机制的理论理解。这些理论工作为潜在空间的表现力和计算优势提供了形式保证，将原型阶段的经验成功奠定了严格的数学框架的基础。The most transformative contribution of this stage is the theoretical understanding of continuous thought mechanisms. These theoretical works provide formal guarantees for the expressiveness and computational advantages of latent space, grounding the empirical successes of the prototype stage in rigorous mathematical frameworks.zhu2025reasoning（叠加推理）提供了第一个正式的复杂性分析，证明作为叠加状态的连续思维向量可以同时编码多个搜索前沿，为 COCONUT 的经验观察行为提供了严格的解释。 钴T2(Reasoning by Superposition) provide the first formal complexity analysis, proving that continuous thought vectors acting as superposition states can encode multiple search frontiers simultaneously, offering a rigorous explanation for COCONUT’s empirically observed behavior. CoT2[gozeten2025continuous]进一步量化并行性和嵌入维度之间的关系，并引入持续监督和强化学习以进行持续的思想优化。further quantifies the relationship between parallelism and embedding dimension and introduces continuous supervision and reinforcement learning for continuous thought optimization.saunshi2025reasoning证明具有潜在迭代的循环变压器可以表达比标准变压器严格更复杂的计算，为循环深度架构建立理论分离结果。prove that looped transformers with latent iterations can express strictly more complex computations than standard transformers, establishing theoretical separation results for recurrent-depth architectures.

技术形成。Technical Formation.形成阶段还见证了重要的方法创新，将原型转化为更实用、更通用的潜在技术。这些进步涵盖了表示设计和优化策略，逐步扩展了可用的工具包。 在表现方面，一系列作品探索了潜在的表现设计：The formation stage also witnesses important methodological innovations that translate the prototypes into more practical and versatile latent techniques. These advances span both representation design and optimization strategies, progressively expanding the toolkit available. On the representation front, a series of works explored latent representation design: Assorted[su2025token]提出将潜在离散标记与文本标记混合，以实现更短的轨迹并提高准确性；科迪proposes mixing latent discrete tokens with text tokens to achieve shorter traces with improved accuracy; CODI[shen2025codi]形式化了一个自蒸馏过程，其中同一模型既充当教师又充当学生，分别在显式空间和隐式空间中生成推理链；和博尔特formalizes a self-distillation procedure where the same model serves as both teacher and student to generate reasoning chains in explicit and latent spaces respectively; and BoLT[ruan2025reasoning]将注意力转移到预训练上，将网络文本视为思维过程的压缩结果，并使用引导程序进行数据高效的预训练。shifts attention to pretraining, treating web text as compressed outcomes of thought processes and using bootstrapping for data-efficient pretraining.

在优化方面，以HRPO为代表On the optimization front, represented by HRPO[yue2025hybrid], 系统1.5, System-1.5[wang2025system]和CoLaR, and CoLaR[tan2025think]，一系列方法分别引入了潜在强化方法、语言和潜在空间之间的自适应计算分配以及动态推理时间可控压缩。这些工作表明，潜在优化可以进行端到端优化，并在不同模式之间自适应分配。, a family of methods respectively introduced latent reinforcement methods, adaptive computation allocation between language and latent spaces, and dynamic inference-time controllable compression. These works demonstrate that latent optimization can be optimized end-to-end and adaptively allocated across different modalities.

这个阶段的另一个特征是潜在水平模型开始扩展到纯文本法学硕士之外。虽然主要焦点仍然是文本推理，但一些开创性的努力证明了潜在空间范式在跨模式中具有更广泛的适用性。 海市蜃楼Another characteristic of this stage is that latent-level models begin extending beyond text-only LLMs. While the primary focus remains on textual reasoning, several pioneering efforts demonstrate the broader applicability of the latent space paradigm across modalities. Mirage[yang2025machine]通过将隐藏状态重铸为与文本交织的潜在视觉标记，实现类似于人类心理意象的内部视觉操作，使 VLM 能够进行视觉思考。 大学VLAenables VLMs to think visually by recasting hidden states as latent visual tokens interleaved with text, implementing internal visual manipulation analogous to human mental imagery. UniVLA[bu2025univla]引入了跨实施例机器人策略的以任务为中心的潜在动作，从互联网规模的视频中学习潜在动作表示。 这些早期的多模态探索表明，潜在空间范式并不局限于文本推理，而是可能构成适用于跨模态和实施例类型的通用框架。introduces task-centric latent actions for cross-embodiment robot policies, learning latent action representations from internet-scale video. These early multimodal explorations demonstrate that the latent space paradigm is not confined to textual reasoning but may constitute a general framework applicable across modalities and embodiment types.

尽管取得了这些进展，形成阶段仍然受到第二个瓶颈的限制：大多数方法仍然是在相对狭窄的环境中开发和评估的，以文本为中心的假设，下游多样性有限，以及记忆、计划、沟通和行动之间的整合较弱。因此，该领域已经学会了如何使潜在推理更有原则性，但尚未学会如何使其在异构场景中广泛使用。这种差距自然会推动下一阶段，主要问题从“潜在推理能否形式化？”转变为主要问题。到“Despite these advances, the formation stage remains constrained by a second bottleneck: most methods are still developed and evaluated within relatively narrow settings, with text-centric assumptions, limited downstream diversity, and weak integration across memory, planning, communication, and action. As a result, the field has learned how to make latent reasoning more principled, but not yet how to make it broadly useful across heterogeneous scenarios. This gap naturally drives the next stage, where the main question shifts from “can latent reasoning be formalized?” to “潜在空间范式可以在多大程度上跨领域、模式和系统设置推广？how far can the latent-space paradigm generalize across domains, modalities, and system settings?”

3.3 扩张Expansion

扩展阶段将潜在空间研究从以文本为中心的景观转变为多模式、多领域的生态系统。这个阶段见证了并行维度的快速多样化。该时期由The expansion stage transforms latent space research from a text-centric landscape into a multi-modal, multi-domain ecosystem. This stage witnesses rapid diversification along concurrent dimensions. The period is marked by the技术成熟度Technical Maturation特定领域的创新和of domain-specific innovations and范式/场景扩展Paradigm/Scenario Expansion交叉主题，例如潜在记忆、测试时间缩放和基于 RL 的优化。of cross-cutting themes such as latent memory, test-time scaling, and RL-based optimization.

技术成熟度。Technical Maturation.在法学硕士领域，潜在方法从概念验证发展到更复杂的系统，以解决内存、可扩展性、优化和特定领域应用程序中的挑战。研究领域大大拓宽，多个子方向并行发展。 由 MemGen 代表In the LLM domain, latent methods evolve from proof-of-concept to more sophisticated systems that address challenges in memory, scalability, optimization, and domain-specific applications. The research landscape broadens considerably, with multiple sub-directions developing in parallel. Represented by MemGen[zhang2025memgen]，一系列作品开创了智能体的潜在记忆，将推理和记忆交织在一起，使得计划、程序和工作记忆类型在没有明确监督的情况下出现。 在测试时间扩展方面，LTPO, a line of works pioneers latent memory for agents, interweaving reasoning and memory so that planning, procedural, and working memory types emerge without explicit supervision. On the test-time scaling front, LTPO[ye2025thinking]将潜在思维向量视为具有在线策略梯度的可优化参数；欧罗treats latent thought vectors as optimizable parameters with online policy gradient; Ouro[zhu2025scaling]通过循环语言模型将优化转移到预训练中；和moves optimization into pretraining via looped language models; andyou2025parallel通过随机采样策略和用于轨迹选择的潜在奖励模型来实现并行测试时间扩展。 对于 RL 驱动的优化，SofT-GRPOenables parallel test-time scaling through stochastic sampling strategies with a latent reward model for trajectory selection. For RL-driven optimization, SofT-GRPO[zheng2025softgrpo]通过 Gumbel 重新参数化策略优化，解决了将强化学习应用于连续潜在推理的可微性挑战。 在交错和混合方向，SpiralThinkersolves the differentiability challenge of applying RL to continuous latent reasoning through Gumbel-reparameterized policy optimization. In the interleaving and hybrid direction, SpiralThinker[piao2025spiralthinker]和克拉拉and CLaRa[he2025clara]分别提出共享连续空间中的文本潜在迭代交织和统一检索增强生成。 此外，出现了特定领域的应用程序，包括搜索和推荐的统一propose text-latent iterative interleaving and unified retrieval-augmented generation in shared continuous spaces, respectively. Additionally, domain-specific applications emerge, including search-and-recommendation unification[shi2025bridging]、代码语言模型可解释性, code language model interpretability[sharma2025analyzing]，和System 1/2双架构通信, and System 1/2 dual-architecture communication[codaforno2025exploring].

范式/场景扩展。Paradigm/Scenario Expansion.扩展阶段见证了视觉潜在层面方法的爆发，建立了视觉空间思维范式作为文本推理的补充。这些方法使 VLM 能够直接在潜在表示中执行内部视觉操作和推理，从而绕过将视觉内容转换为离散文本标记所造成的信息丢失。 以LVR为代表The expansion stage sees an explosion of visual latent-level methods, establishing the paradigm of thinking in visual space as a complement to textual reasoning. These methods enable VLMs to perform internal visual manipulation and reasoning directly in latent representations, bypassing the information loss incurred by converting visual content into discrete text tokens. Represented by LVR[li2025latent]和莫奈and Monet[wang2025monet]，一系列作品在视觉嵌入空间中引入了自回归推理，生成与文本交织的潜在状态，以实现细粒度的视觉理解。 3D思考者, a family of works introduces autoregressive reasoning in the visual embedding space, generating latent states interleaved with text for fine-grained visual understanding. 3DThinker[chen2025think]通过将潜在表征与 3D 基础模型对齐，进一步将其从有限的 2D 视图扩展到 3D 心理模拟。 另一行解决潜在的视觉任务：VisMemfurther extends this to 3D mental simulation from limited 2D views by aligning latent representations with 3D foundation models. Another line address latent visual tasks: VisMem[yu2025vismem]提出了认知启发的短期和长期潜在视觉记忆模块，而 CoMEMproposes cognitively inspired short-term and long-term latent vision memory modules, while CoMEM[wu2025autoscaling]缩放视觉代理的连续记忆。 潜画板等作品scales continuous memory for visual agents. Works such as Latent Sketchpad[zhang2025latentsketchpad]和拉科特and LaCoT[sun2025latent]分别进一步探索用于规划的视觉暂存器和用于视觉推理的变分推理。further explore visual scratchpads for planning and variational inference for visual reasoning, respectively.

扩展阶段催生了潜在通信作为多智能体系统的新范式。与传统的基于文本的代理间通信不同，潜在通信可以直接交换连续表示，从而提供更高的带宽和更低的延迟。 C2CThe expansion stage gives birth to latent communication as a new paradigm for multi-agent systems. Unlike traditional text-based inter-agent communication, latent communication enables direct exchange of continuous representations, offering higher bandwidth and lower latency. C2C[fu2025cache]通过 KV 缓存投影和融合引入了 LLM 之间的直接语义通信。introduces direct semantic communication between LLMs via KV-cache projection and fusion.[zheng2025thought]开发了心智潜在思想交流的理论框架，而 LatentMASdevelops a theoretical framework for mind-to-mind latent thought communication, while LatentMAS[zou2025latent]通过共享潜在工作记忆展示潜在协作，显着减少输出标记，同时提高准确性。demonstrates latent collaboration through shared latent working memory, significantly reducing output tokens while improving accuracy.

在此阶段，具体领域也显着扩展，潜在表征成为学习和转移机器人操作和导航技能的核心工具。来自未标记视频的自我监督预训练成为一种关键方法。 代表：拉帕The embodied domain also expands significantly during this stage, with latent representations becoming a central tool for learning and transferring robotic manipulation and navigation skills. Self-supervised pretraining from unlabeled video emerged as a key methodology. Represented by LAPA[ye2025latent]和 LAWMand LAWM[tharwat2025latent]，一系列自监督方法开创了通过世界建模从未标记的视频数据进行潜在动作预训练。 奥克VLA, a line of self-supervised methods pioneers latent action pretraining from unlabeled video data through world modeling. OccVLA[liu2025occvla]集成隐式 3D 占用监督以实现可解释的轨迹规划，而 SRPOintegrates implicit 3D occupancy supervision for interpretable trajectory planning, while SRPO[fei2025srpo]将 RL 与潜在世界表示应用于 VLA 训练。 ATEapplies RL with latent world representations for VLA training. ATE[zhang2025alignthensteer]通过统一的潜在指导实现数据高效的 VLA 适应，从而实现实质性的现实世界跨实施例收益。enables data-efficient VLA adaptation through unified latent guidance, achieving substantial real-world cross-embodiment gains.

然而，快速扩张也带来了新的瓶颈：领域日益碎片化。一旦潜在空间方法跨语言、视觉、多智能体系统和具体化传播，主要的挑战不再是缺乏应用，而是缺乏统一。不同的作品采用不同的架构假设、优化目标、评估标准和潜在接口，使得比较方法或确定稳定的设计原则变得困难。这种碎片化为爆发期奠定了基础，在此期间，研究前沿转向架构专业化、优化复杂性以及更成熟的尝试，以将潜在空间巩固为一流的计算范式。However, rapid expansion also introduces a new bottleneck: the field becomes increasingly fragmented. Once latent-space methods spread across language, vision, multi-agent systems, and embodiment, the main challenge is no longer lack of applications, but lack of unification. Different works adopt different architectural assumptions, optimization objectives, evaluation criteria, and latent interfaces, making it difficult to compare methods or identify stable design principles. This fragmentation sets the stage for the outbreak period, in which the research frontier shifts toward architectural specialization, optimization sophistication, and more mature attempts to consolidate latent space as a first-class computational paradigm.

3.4 爆发Outbreak

爆发阶段代表了场的爆炸性加速，其特点是The outbreak stage represents an explosive acceleration of the field, characterized by the全面爆发All-round Outbreak所有研究主题。这一阶段的成熟体现在许多标志上： 建筑和表征专业化，具有专门为潜在表征设计的专用模型； 计算和优化的复杂性，以及解决细粒度挑战的方法，例如探索崩溃和潜在奖励编码； 此外，多场景激增，跨越语言、视觉、动作和多智能体系统的统一框架。of all research threads. The maturity of this stage is reflected in many hallmarks: architectural and representational specialization, with purpose-built models designed specifically for latent representation; computation and optimization sophistication, with methods addressing fine-grained challenges such as exploration collapse and latent reward encoding; Moreover, multi-scenario surge, with unified frameworks spanning language, vision, action, and multi-agent systems.

全面爆发。All-round Outbreak.此阶段的一个决定性特征是模型架构的日益专业化。最近的工作不仅仅是通过浅层递归或迭代解码来适应标准变压器主干，而是开发了明确设计为支持潜在计算作为一流机制的架构。这些模型通常旨在提高潜在空间推理的可控性、效率和表现力。A defining feature of this stage is the increasing specialization of model architectures. Rather than merely adapting standard transformer backbones via shallow recurrence or iterative decoding, recent work has developed architectures explicitly designed to support latent computation as a first-class mechanism. These models generally aim to improve the controllability, efficiency, and expressiveness of reasoning in latent space.

代表例子有梦想家Representative examples include Dreamer[knupp2026depthrecurrent]和循环成形器and LoopFormer[jeddi2026loopformer]，它引入了深度循环设计，将序列注意力与深度计算和弹性循环相结合，从而实现预算感知推理和更灵活的计算分配。 MLRA, which introduce depth-recurrent designs that combine sequence attention with depth-wise computation and elastic looping, thereby enabling budget-aware reasoning and more flexible compute allocation. MLRA[liu2026multi]通过低秩投影进一步修改注意力机制，而 DLCMfurther revises the attention mechanism through low-rank projections, while DLCM[qu2025dynamic]将潜在计算的粒度从标记级操作转变为具有自适应概念边界的概念级推理。总的来说，这些研究表明架构开发正在超越序列模型的增量修改，转向专用的潜在空间系统。shifts the granularity of latent computation from token-level operations toward concept-level reasoning with adaptive conceptual boundaries. Collectively, these studies suggest that architectural development is moving beyond incremental modifications to sequence models toward dedicated latent-space systems.

除了建筑专业化之外，潜在空间的优化策略也变得更加复杂。 例如，ReLaXAlongside architectural specialization, optimization strategies for latent space also become substantially more sophisticated. For example, ReLaX[zhang2025relax]和主动潜在规划and Active Latent Planning[zheng2026beyond]通过超越基于模仿的学习转向更明确的基于强化学习的规划来推进潜在空间探索。同时，advance latent-space exploration by moving beyond imitation-based learning toward more explicit reinforcement-learning-based planning. At the same time,enes2025reinforcement通过系统分析表明，强化学习仍然对设计选择敏感，并继续面临持续的优化挑战。 LEDdemonstrate, through a systematic analysis, that reinforcement learning remains sensitive to design choices and continues to face persistent optimization challenges. LED[xiaomi2026led]通过利用循环深度上的熵变化来解决训练后探索崩溃问题。相比之下，潜在思维优化addresses post-training exploration collapse by leveraging entropy variation across recurrent depth. In contrast, Latent Thinking Optimization[du2025latent]研究表明，潜在想法本身可以编码与奖励相关的信息，从而开启了直接优化潜在轨迹而无需完全依赖外部奖励模型的可能性。总体而言，这些发展表明优化正在成为一个独立的进步轴，而不是次要问题。shows that latent thoughts can themselves encode reward-relevant information, thereby opening the possibility of directly optimizing latent trajectories without relying exclusively on external reward models. Overall, these developments indicate that optimization is becoming an independent axis of progress rather than a secondary concern.

在视觉任务中，最近的研究表明，潜在空间支持日益复杂的多步骤和交错推理形式。 ILVRIn visual tasks, recent studies demonstrate that latent space supports increasingly complex forms of multi-step and interleaved inference. ILVR[dong2025interleaved]和水晶and CrystaL[yang2026crystal]例如，探索视觉文本交错推理并报告推理过程中视觉潜在表征的出现。 LIVR, for instance, explore visual-text interleaved reasoning and report the emergence of visual latent representations during the reasoning process. LIVR[li2025latent1]和多代币and Mull-Tokens[ray2025mulltokens]通过将视觉推理更充分地推入潜在空间并提出与模态无关的潜在思维机制，进一步扩展了这一工作范围。 VL-JEPA等相关工作further extend this line of work by pushing visual reasoning more fully into latent space and by proposing modality-agnostic latent thinking mechanisms. Related efforts such as VL-JEPA[chen2025vljepa]和DMLRand DMLR[liu2025reason]进一步拓展视觉推理的设计空间，并凸显该领域方法论表述日益多样化。further expand the design space of visual reasoning and highlight the growing diversity of methodological formulations in this area.

类似的扩展在多智能体系统中也很明显，其中潜在通信从初步演示演变为用于协调和表示共享的更结构化的框架。A similar expansion is also evident in multi-agent systems, where latent communication evolves from preliminary demonstrations into more structured frameworks for coordination and representation sharing.dery2026latent建议通过 K-V 缓存与轻量级适配器对齐进行潜在空间通信，从而实现异构内部状态之间的转换。 L2-VMASpropose latent-space communication via K-V cache alignment with lightweight adapters, enabling translation between heterogeneous internal states. L2-VMAS[yu2026dual]和虫洞and Wormhole[liu2026vision]将此视角扩展到视觉和异构多代理设置，而 LatentMemextend this perspective to visual and heterogeneous multi-agent settings, while LatentMem[fu2026latentmem]引入了用于多智能体经验积累的共享潜在记忆机制。这些工作表明，潜在通信正在成为可扩展的智能体间协调的重要机制。introduces shared latent memory mechanisms for multi-agent experience accumulation. These works suggest that latent communication is becoming an important mechanism for scalable inter-agent coordination.

体现的 VLA 设置提供了另一个主要的扩展领域。在这里，潜在表示越来越多地充当感知、生成和行动的统一界面，而潜在行动建模正在成为一种中心设计范式。莫图斯The embodied VLA setting provides another major area of expansion. Here, latent representations increasingly serve as a unifying interface for perception, generation, and action, and latent action modeling is emerging as a central design paradigm. Motus[bi2025motus]和VLA-JEPAand VLA-JEPA[ginwind2026vlajepa]通过开发统一的潜在动作世界模型来体现这一趋势，该模型将动作生成和环境理解集成在共享的潜在空间中。别墅-Xexemplify this trend by developing unified latent action world models that integrate action generation and environment understanding within a shared latent space. Villa-X[chen2025villax]和加拉and JALA[jala2026joint]进一步提高潜在动作建模的表现力和可扩展性，同时CoWVLAfurther improve the expressiveness and scalability of latent action modeling, while CoWVLA[fx2026cowvla]引入潜在运动空间中的世界模型推理。其他工作，包括 WholeBodyVLAintroduces world-model reasoning in latent motion space. Additional work, including WholeBodyVLA[jiang2025wholebodyvla], SwiftVLA [ni2025swiftvla]，和洛拉, and LoLA[wang2025lola]，强化了这样的观点：潜在动作表示对于 VLA 预训练和部署变得越来越重要。, reinforces the view that latent action representations are becoming increasingly central to VLA pretraining and deployment.

与此同时，爆发阶段也暴露了整个领域的下一个瓶颈：一旦潜在空间方法变得专业化、强大和广泛，最困难的问题不再是示范，而是整合。现在的开放问题涉及潜在接口的标准化、跨模态的原则性评估、潜在效率和可解释性之间的一致性，以及将潜在计算集成到更广泛的代理系统中。从这个意义上说，爆发阶段并不意味着故事的结束；相反，它揭示了下一阶段的进展可能取决于将快速增长的技术集合转变为连贯的科学并利用工程进行潜在计算。At the same time, the outbreak stage surfaces the next-order bottleneck for the field as a whole: once latent-space methods become specialized, powerful, and widespread, the hardest problem is no longer demonstration but consolidation. The open questions now concern standardization of latent interfaces, principled evaluation across modalities, alignment between latent efficiency and interpretability, and the integration of latent computation into broader agentic systems. In this sense, the outbreak stage does not mark the end of the story; rather, it reveals that the next phase of progress will likely depend on turning a rapidly growing collection of techniques into a coherent science and harness engineering for latent computation.

4 机制：潜在空间如何运作？Mechanism: How Does Latent Space Work?

机制涉及潜在空间如何在模型中实例化、结构化和可操作，超出了其为何有用的高级问题。现有方法的不同不仅在于引入潜在变量的位置，还在于它们的表示方式、如何通过它们进行计算以及它们在哪个阶段被塑造或利用。为了组织这个设计空间，我们沿着四个互补轴对潜在空间机制进行分类：Mechanism concerns how latent space is instantiated, structured, and operationalized within a model, beyond the high-level question of why it is useful. Existing methods differ not only in where latent variables are introduced, but also in how they are represented, how computation is carried out through them, and at which stage they are shaped or exploited. To organize this design space, we categorize latent-space mechanisms along four complementary axes:建筑Architecture（节(Section4.1) 表征潜在空间在模型中的结构作用，包括它是否嵌入主干、作为专用组件实现或由辅助模型支持；) characterizes the structural role of latent space in the model, including whether it is embedded in the backbone, realized as a dedicated component, or supported by an auxiliary model;代表Representation（节(Section4.2）描述了潜在变量的形式，区分内部、外部、可学习和混合表示。) describes the form of latent variables, distinguishing internal, external, learnable, and hybrid representations.计算Computation（节(Section4.3）捕获潜在空间如何参与信息处理，包括压缩、扩展、自适应或交错计算。) captures how the latent space participates in information processing, including compressed, expanded, adaptive, or interleaved computation.优化Optimization（节(Section4.4）重点关注何时以及如何诱导、对齐或细化潜在空间，涵盖训练前、训练后和推理时间机制。 这四种机制类型提供了一个统一的视角，用于比较不同的方法，并阐明控制现代基于语言的系统中如何构建和使用潜在空间的主要设计选择。) focuses on when and how latent space is induced, aligned, or refined, spanning pre-training, post-training, and inference-time mechanisms. These four mechanistic types provide a unified lens for comparing diverse approaches and clarify the major design choices that govern how latent spaces are constructed and used in modern language-based systems.

一般符号和形式化。General Notation and Formalization.根据表中的符号Based on the notations in Table1，我们首先形式化标准自回归生成范式。给定一个输入序列, we first formalize the standard autoregressive generation paradigm. Given an input sequence𝐱∈𝒱\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{V}，一个模型, a modelΦθ\Phi_{\theta}定义输出序列的条件分布defines a conditional distribution over the output sequence𝐲∈𝒱\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{V}:

𝐲∼Φθ(⋅∣𝐱).\mathbf{y}\sim\Phi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid\mathbf{x}). (1)

其中生成纯粹在令牌空间中执行：模型根据输入和先前生成的上下文来预测每个输出令牌。虽然计算是通过连续隐藏状态内部进行的where generation is performed purely in token space: the model predicts each output token conditioned on the input and the previously generated context. Although the computation is internally carried out through continuous hidden states𝐡∈ℋ\mathbf{h}\in\mathcal{H}，生成接口本身仍然是令牌到令牌的。, the generation interface itself remains token-to-token.

潜在空间方法通过引入额外的潜在表示来扩展这个公式Latent-space methods extend this formulation by introducing an additional latent representation𝐳∈ℋ\mathbf{z}\in\mathcal{H}，这样生成不仅取决于可观察的输入, such that generation is conditioned not only on the observable input𝐱\mathbf{x}也适用于连续潜变量：but also on a continuous latent variable:

𝐲∼Φθ(⋅∣𝐱,𝐳),\mathbf{y}\sim\Phi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid\mathbf{x},\mathbf{z}), (2)

哪里where𝐳\mathbf{z}表示潜在空间中的潜在表示denotes a latent representation in the latent spaceℋ\mathcal{H}。与标准自回归生成相比，潜在变量. Compared with standard autoregressive generation, the latent variable𝐳\mathbf{z}提供了一个额外的通道来编码可能难以直接在标记空间中表达的信息，例如全局语义、多模态特征、中间推理状态、结构约束或其他与任务相关的因素。provides an additional channel for encoding information that may be difficult to express directly in token space, such as global semantics, multimodal features, intermediate reasoning states, structural constraints, or other task-relevant factors.

从这个角度来看，核心问题不仅仅是方法是否使用潜在变量，而是如何实例化潜在空间并将其集成到生成过程中。这激发了本次调查中以机制为导向的分类法。Under this perspective, the central question is not merely whether a method uses latent variables, but how latent space is instantiated and integrated into the generation process. This motivates the mechanism-oriented taxonomy in this survey.

4.1 建筑Architecture

潜在水平方法的最新进展促进了对在显式表征空间中运行的模型的既定架构设计范式的深刻反思Recent advances in latent-level methods have catalyzed a profound rethinking of the established architectural design paradigms for models operating in explicit representational spaces[hu2024understanding]。与对传统自回归框架的完全依赖不同，越来越多的研究开创了创新机制，使高级认知过程能够在潜在空间内进行核心计算。. Departing from the exclusive reliance on conventional autoregressive frameworks, an increasing number of studies have pioneered innovative mechanisms that enable core computations within latent spaces, where high-level cognitive processes[li2026dynamics], 例如e.g.、推理、感知和规划，可以显着提高效率和表现力。这种变革性的转变远远超出了表征领域的简单改变。它概括了现代神经模型架构哲学的根本演变, reasoning, perception, and planning, can be conducted with substantially enhanced efficiency and expressiveness. This transformative shift extends far beyond a mere change of representational domain; it encapsulates a fundamental evolution in the architectural philosophy of modern neural models[zhu2025reasoning].

这种新兴的范式揭示了潜在空间正在从一种孤立的技术启发演变为一种普遍的、基础的架构原则。回答核心问题：This emerging paradigm reveals that latent space is evolving from an isolated technical heuristic into a general, foundational architectural principle. To answer the core question:利用什么架构来学习潜在空间？what architectures are utilized to learn the latent space?, 我们通过潜在空间的位置来区分这些方法, we distinguish these methods by the location where latent spaceℋ\mathcal{H}被整合到is integrated intoΦ\Phi，重点关注, with a focus on the结构structure模型空间内的潜在系统of the latent system within model spaceΦ={Φb​a​c​k,Φc​o​m​p,Φa​u​x}\Phi=\left\{\Phi^{back},\Phi^{comp},\Phi^{aux}\right\}。 如表所示. As reported in Table2和表and Table3，我们将所有现有的架构驱动方法分为三类：, we classify all existing architecture-driven methods into three categories:

4.1.1 骨干网Backbone

在这一类别中，潜在计算本质上嵌入在主要生成架构中，而不是通过外部辅助模块引入。形式上，主干本身对潜在状态进行迭代或结构化转换：In this category, latent computation is intrinsically embedded in the primary generative architecture rather than introduced via an external auxiliary module. Formally, the backbone itself carries out an iterative or structured transition over latent states:

𝐡t+1=Φb​a​c​k​(𝐡1:t,𝐱,𝐲1:t),\mathbf{h}_{t+1}=\Phi^{back}(\mathbf{h}_{1:t},\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}_{1:t}), (3)

其中每个后续输出令牌都是基于更新的隐藏状态生成的，在这个公式下，潜在操作构成了本机操作机制where each subsequent output token is produced based on the updated hidden state, under this formulation, the latent operation constitutes a native operational mechanism ofΦb​a​c​k​(⋅)\Phi^{back}(\cdot)本身，这意味着推理或中间转换过程是在主干内部实现的，不需要任何额外的组件。itself, meaning that the reasoning or intermediate transformation process is realized internally within the backbone, without requiring any additional component.

现有的基于主干的方法可以从三个互补的角度来广泛理解：Existing backbone-based methods can be broadly understood from three complementary perspectives:参数共享Parameter-shared, 迭代细化Iterative Refinement, 和, and增强型Augmented。这些作品不是简单地遵循显式水平的对应物，而是重新审视主干设计本身，以提供一条有希望的道路。. Rather than simply following the explicit-level counterparts, these works revisit the backbone design itself to offer a promising path.

参数共享骨干网。Parameter-shared Backbone.从参数共享的角度来看，代表性的工作线用一组较小的重复应用的可重用模块取代了不同层的深堆栈。然而，在这种范例中，循环深度或次数通常是固定的。胡金From the perspective of parameter sharing, a representative line of work replaces a deep stack of distinct layers with a smaller set of reusable modules applied repeatedly. However, in this paradigm, the recurrent depth or times is typically fixed. Huginn[jonas2025scaling]例如，采用仅解码器架构，但通过引入跨多个深度步骤重用的共享循环块来补偿浅显式深度。这种设计大大减少了唯一参数的数量，同时实现了测试时间扩展，其中可以在推理过程中应用额外的循环步骤，以牺牲计算性能来换取性能。循环传输。, for example, adopts a decoder-only architecture, but compensates for the shallow explicit depth by introducing a shared recurrent block that is reused across multiple depth steps. This design substantially reduces the number of unique parameters while enabling test-time scaling, where additional recurrent steps can be applied during inference to trade compute for performance. Looped Trans.[saunshi2025reasoning]通过强制实施显式的层循环机制进一步发展了这一想法。一个关键的技术特征是其基于循环的正则化，它可以在重复应用相同变换的情况下稳定隐藏状态动态，并鼓励迭代表示的收敛。 在相关的以效率为导向的环境中，PHD-Trans。further develops this idea by enforcing an explicit layer-looping mechanism. A key technical feature is its looping-based regularization, which stabilizes the hidden-state dynamics under repeated application of the same transformation and encourages convergence of iterative representations. In a related efficiency-oriented setting, PHD-Trans.[wu2025efficient]探讨了这种循环计算如何在长上下文解码下保持实用。它将缓存管理与滑动窗口注意力集成在一起，减少内存开销，同时保留重复更新的好处。explores how such recurrent computation can remain practical under long-context decoding. It integrates cache management with sliding-window attention, reducing memory overhead while preserving the benefits of repeated updates.

迭代骨干网。Iterative Backbone.该范例强调迭代过程和动态更新，具有可变或可学习的深度分配。 比如说欧罗This paradigm highlights the iterative process and dynamic updating, with variable or learnable depth allocation. For instance, Ouro[zhu2025scaling]引入了一种递归推理框架，其迭代可以作为替代缩放轴，类似于增加架构深度，表明重复应用参数共享转换可以产生一致的增益。循环成形器introduces a recursive inference framework whose iterations can serve as an alternative scaling axis, analogous to increasing architectural depth, showing that repeated application of parameter-shared transformations can yield consistent gains. LoopFormer[jeddi2026loopformer]引入了弹性深度循环变压器，其中循环迭代的次数不固定，但可以根据输入或计算预算而变化。这使得循环深度执行更加灵活，并且更好地适应各个示例的复杂性。 思考LM2introduces an elastic-depth looped transformer, where the number of loop iterations is not fixed but can vary across inputs or computational budgets. This makes recurrent-depth execution more flexible and better aligned with the complexity of individual examples. PonderLM2[zeng2025pretraining]是这一类中具有代表性的方法。它构建为仅解码器模型，通过雅可比式并行更新进行迭代细化。它没有严格遵循标准的自回归机制，即每次前向传递将预测推进一个标记，而是并行执行多步隐藏状态演化，从而在保持解码效率的同时实现更丰富的内部计算。is a representative method in this category. Built as a decoder-only model, it employs iterative refinement via Jacobi-style parallel updates. Instead of strictly following the standard autoregressive regime, where each forward pass advances the prediction by one token, it also performs multi-step hidden-state evolution in parallel, enabling richer internal computation while retaining decoding efficiency.

增强骨干。Augmented Backbone.除了这两种设计之外，还有一些作品探索了不同粒度的增强架构。 比如黑马Beyond these two designs, several works explore augmented architectures at different granularities. For example, Heima[wu2025efficient]和DLCMand DLCM[qu2025dynamic]与大多数仅编码器的设计不同，它采用分层编码器-解码器架构来组织潜在计算。后者还将计算从标记转移到压缩的概念空间，并具有更有效的语义操作。 梦想家, unlike most encoder-only designs, employ hierarchical encoder-decoder architectures to organize latent computation. The latter one also shifts computation from tokens to a compressed concept space, with more efficient semantic operations. Dreamer[knupp2026depthrecurrent]和MLRAand MLRA[liu2026multi]分别设计序列深度稀疏注意力混合和低秩注意力，使多步潜在转换在计算上易于处理且高效。 此外，MoLAEdesign sequence-depth sparse attention mixtures and low-rank attention, respectively, making multi-step latent transitions computationally tractable and efficient. In addition, MoLAE[liu2025molae]设计了一种在较低维度重新构建潜在专家混合的架构。designs an architecture of reformulating the mixture of latent experts in lower dimension.

总结。Summary.总体而言，面向主干的方法代表了架构级潜在建模的最本质形式。 参数共享方法通过重用层或模型的子集来提高效率；迭代细化方法通过启用动态、自适应迭代进一步增强灵活性；基于增强的设计为架构转变提供了更广阔的视野。 这种转变为更灵活、具有计算意识和认知表达的生成系统奠定了基础。Overall, backbone-oriented methods represent the most intrinsic form of architecture-level latent modeling. Parameter-sharing approaches improve efficiency by reusing subsets of layers or models; iterative-refinement methods further enhance flexibility by enabling dynamic, adaptive iterations; and augmentation-based designs provide a broader view of architectural shifts. This shift provides the foundation for more flexible, computation-aware, and cognitively expressive generative systems.

4.1.2 组件Component

该范例保留了原始的主干架构，但通过构建、转换、存储或检索潜在表示的功能模块对其进行了增强。形式上，组件生成然后注入骨干解码过程：This paradigm preserves the original backbone architecture but augments it with functional modules that construct, transform, store, or retrieve latent representations. Formally, a component produces and is then injected into the backbone decoding process:

𝐳=Φcomp​(𝐡,𝐱),\mathbf{z}=\Phi^{\mathrm{comp}}\left(\mathbf{h},\mathbf{x}\right), (4)

骨干在哪里where the backboneΦb​a​c​k​(⋅)\Phi^{back}(\cdot)仍然是主要发电机，而额外的组件remains the principal generator, while the extra componentΦcomp​(⋅)\Phi^{\mathrm{comp}}(\cdot)充当潜在空间上的插件运算符，并且输出acts as a plug-in operator over latent space, and the output𝐳\mathbf{z}将在方程中使用will be used in Equation2.

这样的设计保留了主干架构，同时为其配备了潜在机制以促进或指导下游生成。 它涵盖了广泛的模块系列，这些模块在潜在空间上运行，同时使骨干网基本上处于冻结状态。我们将现有方法分为五个组成部分：Such a design preserves the backbone architecture while equipping it with a latent mechanism to facilitate or guide downstream generation. It covers a broad family of modules that operate on latent spaces while leaving the backbone largely frozen. We categorize existing approaches into five component families:一代Generation, 投影Projection, 对准Alignment, 控制Control, 和, and存储Storage，鉴于其功能特点。, in view of their functional characteristics.

生成组件。Generation Component.这部分的主要目标是在隐藏空间中构建中间潜在状态，允许模型合成新的隐式目标、子目标或推理状态，这些以前无法作为显式符号使用。 代表性范式是作为离散代币或软链演化来实现的，而不是通过明确的语言化链来实现。例如，ETDA major line of this part aims to construct intermediate latent states in hidden space, allowing the model to synthesize new implicit objectives, subgoals, or reasoning states that are not previously available as explicit symbols. A representative paradigm is realized as discrete tokens or a soft chain evolving rather than through explicit verbalized chains. For instance, ETD[koishekenov2025encode]引入了一种编码-思考-解码机制，该机制将部分过程转移到潜在计算中，而不需要明确的语言表达。与此同时，调色板introduces an encode–think–decode mechanism that shifts part of the process into latent computation without requiring explicit verbalization. At the same time, Palette[long2025reasoning], iCLP [chen2025iclp], ATP 潜伏, ATP-Latent[zheng2026beyond]，和雷古拉R, and ReGuLaR[wang2026regular]使用 VAE 风格的组件来调节高层上下文并鼓励多样化的探索。在较粗的粒度上，JEPA-Reasoneremploy VAE-style components to modulate high-level contexts and encourage diverse exploration. At a coarser granularity, JEPA-Reasoner[liu2025jepareasoner]将推理公式化为 JEPA 风格框架下的一系列潜在预测，从而将潜在推理与表面令牌生成解耦。formulates reasoning as a chain of latent predictions under a JEPA-style framework, thereby decoupling latent reasoning from surface token generation.

除了潜在轨迹生成之外，另一项工作利用非轨迹潜在信号，Beyond latent trajectory generation, another line of work leverages non-trajectory latent signals,例如e.g.、压缩嵌入、激活空间特征或学习的转向向量。科拉R, compressed embeddings, activation-space features, or learned steering vectors. CoLaR[tan2025think]例如，通过嵌入预测和控制来实现更有效的无声推理。更广泛地说，AR, for example, enables more efficient silent reasoning through embedding prediction and control. More broadly, AR[lukas2025activationreasoning]和RB-CoTand RB-CoT[he2026reasoning]两者都采用 SAE 在激活空间中生成可解释的特征方向，而 PILOTboth employ SAE to generate interpretable feature directions in activation space, while PILOT[zheng2026pilot]通过 MLP 合成潜在引导向量来引导解码。此外，MemGensynthesizes latent guidance vectors via an MLP to steer decoding. Additionally, MemGen[zhang2025memgen]、VisMem, VisMem[yu2025vismem]和潜在内存, and LatentMem[fu2026latentmem]还采用附着在主干上的LoRA来编织潜在记忆作为注射。also adopt LoRA attached to the backbone to weave latent memories as an injection.

这个想法也被扩展到多模态设置，其中潜变量不仅充当语义状态，而且充当视觉载体。近期作品，如AURORAThis idea has also been extended to the multimodal setting, where latent variables serve not only as semantic states but also as vision carriers. Recent works, such as AURORA[perception2025bigverdi]，引入变分自动编码器来合成感知标记，从而实现更丰富的视觉理解。微机电系统, introduce a variational autoencoder to synthesize perception tokens, enabling richer visual understanding. CoMEM[wu2025towards]及其代理变体 CoMEM-Agentand its agent variant CoMEM-Agent[wu2025autoscaling]部署查询变压器来生成紧凑的视觉记忆标记，显示出在长期任务中的潜力。 此外，SteerVADdeploy querying transformers to produce compact visual memory tokens, showing potential in long-horizon tasks. In addition, SteerVAD[cai2026steering]从基于视频的任务的混合层生成相关的潜在帧级视觉嵌入，以及潜在画板generates related latent frame-level vision embeddings from mixed layers for video-based tasks, and Latent Sketchpad[zhang2025latentsketchpad]使用 VAE 解码器在多步视觉推理过程中生成中间视觉想象。uses a VAE decoder to generate intermediate visual imaginations during multi-step visual reasoning.

投影组件。Projection Component.该类别主要并不合成新的潜在内容，而是通过将现有的内部表示投影到不同的目标空间来改进推理或控制。 几件作品附加了轻质线性层，This category does not primarily synthesize new latent content, but instead improves reasoning or control by projecting existing internal representations into a different target space. Several works attach lightweight linear layers,例如e.g., SoftCoT++ [xu2025softcot1]和PLaTand PLaT[wang2026latent]，或 MLP，例如 SpiralThinker, or MLPs, such as SpiralThinker[piao2025spiralthinker]和 LiteReasonand LiteReason[gurung2025lightweight]，将隐藏状态投影到目标语义空间中。此外，低频转向, that project hidden states into a target semantic space. Besides, LF-Steering[yang2025lfsteering]训练 SAE 将激活投影到语义子空间中以确保语义一致性。trains an SAE to project activations into a semantic subspace to ensure semantic consistency.

在另一个典型的路径中，投影充当跨模式或代理的桥梁。虫洞In another typical path, projection serves as a bridge across modalities or agents. Wormhole[liu2026vision]通过编码器-解码器桥连接异构视觉代理，该桥将每个代理的视觉表示投影到共享的潜在空间中。奥克VLAconnects heterogeneous visual agents through an encoder–decoder bridge that projects each agent’s visual representation into a shared latent space. OccVLA[liu2025occvla]通过变压器适配器投影 3D 空间特征，提高统一的多模式理解。 此外，随着具体场景的发展，越来越多的研究人员开始关注动作预测。例如，LCLAprojects 3D spatial features via a transformer adapter, improving unified multimodal understanding. Furthermore, as embodied scenarios advance, more researchers are focusing on action projection. For instance, LCLA[subedi2026lcla]和 LaST0and LaST0[liu2026last0]在具体操作中附加 MLP 投影仪。 思考行动attach MLP projectors in embodied manipulation. ThinkAct[huang2025thinkact]和快速思考行动and Fast-ThinkAct[huang2026fastthinkact]两者都附有 Q-former 和 MLP 头，将视觉推理轨迹投射到机器人动作空间中。 结合两者，VITAboth attach Q-former and MLP heads to project visual reasoning traces into robot action spaces. Combining both, VITA[ma2025unifying]采用编码器-解码器架构将视觉动作上下文编码为一种潜在表示，统一操作中的感知和控制，而 ColaVLAadopts an encoder–decoder architecture to encode visual-action context into one latent representation, unifying perception and control in manipulation, while ColaVLA[peng2025colavla]引入了一个前向层，将视觉特征投射到行动规划空间中。introduces a forward layer that projects visual features into the action-planning space.

对齐组件。Alignment Component.当生成创造和投影重塑时，对齐确保转换后的潜在物锚定到有意义的东西。这些组件强制执行潜在表示和外部基础信号之间的对应关系，无论是视觉特征、任务语义还是跨领域知识。 对齐VLMWhile generation creates and projection reshapes, alignment ensures the transformed latent is anchored to something meaningful. These components enforce correspondence between latent representations and external grounding signals, whether visual features, task semantics, or cross-domain knowledge. AlignVLM[ahmed2025alignvlm]重新设计跨模式融合层，引入混合对齐层，更忠实地将视觉标记与文本语义绑定在一起，而 PREGENredesigns the cross-modal fusion layers, introducing mixed alignment layers that more faithfully bind visual tokens to textual semantics, while PREGEN[serussi2026pregen]将生成的视频嵌入与检索相关的文本语义对齐。 与生成先验一致，LaDiRaligns generated video embeddings to retrieval-relevant textual semantics. Aligned with generative priors, LaDiR[kang2025ladir]和洛拉and LoLA[wang2025lola]将隐藏状态对齐到扩散兼容或基于变压器的语义空间，确保与所需接地信号的一致性。扩展到跨域场景，Interpreteralign hidden states into diffusion-compatible or transformer-based semantic spaces, ensuring consistency with desirable grounding signals. Extending to cross-domain scenes, Interpreter[kamai2026talking]使用 LoRA 跨域传输潜在能力，使源域能力与目标域表示保持一致。uses LoRA to transfer latent abilities across domains, aligning source-domain competencies with target-domain representations.

控制组件。Control Component.它确定模型何时以及如何进入、退出或委托潜在模式。它们不是生成内容，而是充当元级交换机或路由器，自适应地调制生成过程。 提供开关信号，FR-PonderIt determines when and how the model enters, exits, or delegates latent modes. Rather than generating content, they act as meta-level switches or routers that adaptively modulate the generation process. To provide switching signals, FR-Ponder[he2025learning]训练一个小型 MLP 门控头来预测给定输入是否需要扩展潜在思考，而 TaHtrains a small MLP gating head to predict whether a given input requires extended latent pondering, and TaH[fu2025tah]在每一层放置一个小型 MLP 式决策器，用于投票决定是否进入潜在审议阶段，从而实现潜在流形中的动态预算分配。 记忆基因positions a small MLP-style decider at each layer that votes on whether to enter a latent deliberation phase, enabling dynamic budget allocation in latent manifolds. MemGen[zhang2025memgen]包含一个触发器，通过 LoRA 或熵信号实现，确定何时应调用内存，而 Kelpincorporates a trigger, implemented via LoRA or entropy signals, that determines when memory should be invoked, while Kelp[li2025kelp]同样，使用基于 MLP 的模块进行安全场景中的风险敏感输入。similarly uses an MLP-based module for risk-sensitive inputs in safety scenarios.

存储组件。Storage Component.存储组件跨步骤、回合或情节维持持久的潜在状态，使模型能够积累、压缩和检索信息，而不依赖于有限的上下文窗口。 注塑机Storage components maintain persistent latent states across steps, turns, or episodes, enabling models to accumulate, compress, and retrieve information without relying on the finite context window. IMM[jos2025beyond]和L2-VMASand L2-VMAS[yu2026dual]引入一个可微向量库作为潜在记忆库，以及 G-MemLLMintroduce a differentiable vector library that acts as a latent memory bank, and G-MemLLM[xu2026gmemllm]通过有选择地更新内存的门控读写逻辑来扩展这一点。此外，PolarMemscales this with a gated write–read logic that selectively updates memory. Further, PolarMem[chen2026polarmem]用图形拓扑结构取代平面向量存储，该结构可以跨情节聚类和链接视觉记忆。replaces the flat vector store with a graph-topology structure that clusters and links visual memory across episodes.

总结。Summary.基于组件的方法保留了主干架构，同时使用插件潜在模块对其进行增强，这些模块可以构建、转换、对齐、控制或存储下游生成的内部表示。这些组件不是取代主干，而是在潜在空间上作为功能运算符运行，以最小的架构破坏增强推理、基础、可控性和记忆。现有的方法可以大致分为五个系列：合成潜在推理状态的生成组件；将隐藏表示映射到任务相关空间的投影组件；将潜在因素锚定到外部语义或先验的对齐组件；自适应调节潜在计算的控制组件；以及维护持久潜在存储的存储组件。Component-based methods preserve the backbone architecture while augmenting it with plug-in latent modules that construct, transform, align, control, or store internal representations for downstream generation. Rather than replacing the backbone, these components operate as functional operators over latent space, enhancing reasoning, grounding, controllability, and memory with minimal architectural disruption. Existing approaches can be broadly organized into five families: generation components that synthesize latent reasoning states; projection components that map hidden representations into task-relevant spaces; alignment components that anchor latents to external semantics or priors; control components that regulate latent computation adaptively; and storage components that maintain persistent latent storage.

4.1.3 辅助型号Auxiliary Model

在这里，潜在引导信号是由外部辅助模型引入的，而不是在主干内本地诱导或由内部功能组件实例化。具体来说，辅助模型首先生成潜在表示，然后用于条件、指导或细化主模型的生成过程：Here, the latent guidance signal is introduced by an external auxiliary model, rather than being natively induced within the backbone or instantiated by an internal functional component. Concretely, an auxiliary model first produces a latent representation and then is used to condition, guide, or refine the generation process of the host model:

𝐳=Φaux​(𝐱),\mathbf{z}=\Phi^{\mathrm{aux}}(\mathbf{x}), (5)

其中潜在的引入外包给辅助模型where the latent introduction is outsourced to auxiliary modelΦa​u​x​(⋅)\Phi^{aux}(\cdot)补充宿主模型to replenish the host modelΦb​a​c​k​(⋅)\Phi^{back}(\cdot)，那么, then𝐳\mathbf{z}将被注入到方程中的自回归过程中will be injected into the autoregressive process in Equation2.

这种范式引入了功能分工：主机模型保留下游预测的责任，而辅助模型要么塑造其学习目标，要么丰富其内部表示。根据辅助模型的贡献，最终的作品干净地分为两个系列：This paradigm introduces a functional division of labour: the host model retains responsibility for downstream prediction, while the auxiliary model either shapes its learning objective or enriches its internal representations. The resulting works bifurcate cleanly into two families according to what the auxiliary model contributes:监督导向Supervision-oriented提供训练信号的方法，以及approaches that provide training signals, and面向特征Feature-oriented提供中间表示的方法。approaches that provide intermediate representations.

监管导向的辅助模式。Supervision-oriented Auxiliary Model.对于该范式中的方法，辅助模型提供信号，通过语义约束、正则化和监督来指导主模型。 最直接的策略是利用另一种语言模型作为教师来生成表达痕迹。例如，HCoTFor the methods in this paradigm, the auxiliary models supply signals that guide the host model with semantic constraints, regularization, and supervision. The most direct strategy is to leverage another language model serving as a teacher to generate expressive traces. For instance, HCoT[liu2024expediting]和拉维特and LaViT[wu2026lavit]实例化辅助模型以生成显式推理链，然后将其内部表示提炼为主机隐藏状态。软CoTinstantiate assistant models to generate explicit reasoning chains, whose internal representations are then distilled into the host hidden states. SoftCoT[xu2025softcot]通过将辅助链投影到连续的潜在嵌入而不是离散的令牌序列中来扩展此范式，从而产生与基于梯度的微调兼容的软监督。 对于更细粒度的监督，一些方法侧重于将宿主潜在表示与外部参考模型的潜在表示对齐。 SIM-CoTextends this paradigm by projecting the auxiliary chain into a continuous latent embedding rather than discrete token sequences, yielding soft supervision compatible with gradient-based fine-tuning. For finer-grained supervision, some methods focus on aligning the host latent representations with those of an external reference model. SIM-CoT[wei2025simcot]和SEMCoTand SemCoT[he2025semcot]耦合其隐藏状态充当语义锚的加法模型，并训练主机通过对比目标在其自己的潜在空间内重现这些表示。couple addition models whose hidden states function as semantic anchors, and train the host to reproduce these representations within its own latent space via a contrastive objective.
