另一组将辅助模型视为状态生成器，其输出定义潜在轨迹上的结构化训练目标。控制系统Another group treats the auxiliary model as a state generator whose outputs define structured training targets over latent trajectories. CTRLS[wu2025ctrls]使用小型 LLM 来合成中间推理状态，作为宿主潜在空间内的探索路径点。潜在进化uses a small LLM to synthesise intermediate reasoning states that serve as exploration waypoints within the host latent space. LatentEvolve[zhang2025latentevolve]将这一想法扩展到进化优化，采用辅助模型来生成候选标记序列，从而驱动记忆表示的迭代细化。钴酸锂extends this idea to evolutionary optimisation, employing an auxiliary model to generate candidate token sequences that drive iterative refinement of memory representations. CoLT[zhu2026colt]采取更加针对特定任务的立场，分配一个微型辅助模型来将潜在的工具调用状态分解为可解释的中间表示，以监督内部规划阶段。takes a more task-specific stance, assigning a tiny-scale auxiliary model to decompose latent tool-calling states into interpretable intermediate representations that supervise the internal planning phase.

面向特征的辅助模型。Feature-oriented Auxiliary Model.这些辅助模型将轨迹转移到可用于主机模型的特征，生成中间表示并将其直接注入到计算图中。 这种范式在多模式和具体环境中尤其普遍，其中模式之间的异质性，These auxiliary models shift the locus to features available for the host model, generating and injecting intermediate representations directly into the computation graph. This paradigm is especially prevalent in multimodal and embodied settings, where the heterogeneity between modalities,即i.e.、语言、视觉和行动，造成了表征瓶颈。 大量方法采用专用视觉模型，其输出补充或取代宿主自己的视觉表征。 CoVT, language, vision, and action, creates representational bottlenecks. A sizeable cohort of methods employs dedicated vision models whose outputs supplement or supplant the host’s own visual representations. CoVT[qin2025chainofvisualthought]将此注入构建为视觉思维链，其中辅助视觉模型迭代地构建类似于文本 CoT 的标记级推理步骤的中间视觉表示。 3D思考者frames this injection as a chain of visual thought, wherein auxiliary vision models iteratively construct intermediate visual representations analogous to the token-level reasoning steps of textual CoT. 3DThinker[chen2025think]配对一个专门的 3D 基础模型，提供基于空间的几何先验。其他作品，包括 LaRepairs a specialised 3D foundation model that provides spatially-grounded geometric priors. Further works, including LaRe[ma2025multimodal], MM-CoT [shao2026learning], 和 ValLR, and VaLR[jeon2026vision]，利用扩散架构的生成模型。给定视觉输入，他们重建或想象视觉状态，其潜在代码被馈送到宿主模型作为丰富的感知上下文，从而实现视觉想象的形式。 一个潜在的, leverage diffusion-architected generative models. Given a visual input, they reconstruct or imagine visual states whose latent codes are fed to the host model as an enriched perceptual context, enabling forms of visual imagination. OneLatent[lv2026onelatent]和RoTand RoT[wang2026renderofthought]使用视觉编码器将文本推理渲染到潜在的视觉空间中。 此外，滑雪场use a vision encoder to render textual reasoning into latent visual spaces. In addition, SkiLa[tong2025sketchinlatents]和VL-JEPAand VL-JEPA[chen2025vljepa]分别进一步探索生成和自我监督机制中的视觉投射。further explore vision projection in generative and self-supervised regimes, respectively.

在体现和自治系统中，辅助模型的作用转向政策基础和环境感知。大学VLAIn embodied and autonomous systems, the role of the auxiliary model shifts to policy grounding and environment perception. UniVLA[bu2025univla]包含专用视觉编码器来生成特定于任务的特征序列，以及 SSM-VLAincorporates a dedicated vision encoder to generate task-specific feature sequences, and SSM-VLA[cai2025seeing]引入了基于 VLM 的辅助装置，可在状态空间框架内连接视觉感知和运动动作。 斯威夫特VLAintroduces a VLM-based auxiliary that bridges visual perception and motor action within a state-space framework. SwiftVLA[ni2025swiftvla]和最后的VLAand LaST-VLA[luo2026last]通过视觉辅助引入时空信息，这对于需要连贯时间推理的长视距操作任务特别有益。 在自动驾驶领域，LCDriveintroduce spatial-temporal information through vision auxiliary, proving particularly beneficial for long-horizon manipulation tasks that demand coherent temporal reasoning. In autonomous driving, LCDrive[tan2025latent]和 DW-VLAand DW-VLA[liu2026driveworld]分别将世界模型和额外视觉编码器作为辅助特征源，为场景动态的一致表示奠定基础。未来-VLAincorporate world models and extra vision encoders, respectively, as auxiliary feature sources, grounding consistent representations of scene dynamics. Future-VLA[fan2026future]通过根据辅助预测的未来视觉特征调节动作生成，从而进一步将辅助模型渲染为预测前瞻机制。 此外，WholeBodyVLAtakes this further by conditioning action generation on auxiliary-predicted future visual features, effectively rendering the auxiliary model as a predictive look-ahead mechanism. In addition, WholeBodyVLA[jiang2025wholebodyvla]和潜在VLAand LatentVLA[xie2026latentvla]通过采用潜在动作模型作为特征编码器，其表示捕获关节级协调结构，将其扩展到全身人形控制。extend this to whole-body humanoid control by employing a latent action model as a feature encoder whose representations capture joint-level coordination structure.

总结。Summary.辅助模型范式通过外部模型而不是主干模型本身引入潜在指导。这种辅助模型要么提供监督信号来塑造主干的潜在空间，要么提供丰富其内部计算的中间特征，使得这种范式对于复杂推理、多模态理解和具体决策特别有效。The auxiliary-model paradigm introduces latent guidance through an external model rather than the backbone itself. Such auxiliary models either provide supervision signals to shape the backbone’s latent space or supply intermediate features that enrich its internal computation, making this paradigm particularly effective for complex reasoning, multimodal understanding, and embodied decision-making.

4.2 代表Representation

从离散标记序列到连续潜在空间的过渡The transition from discrete token sequences to the continuous latent spaceℋ\mathcal{H}需要对核心信息载体进行精确定义：潜在表示necessitates a precise definition of the core information carrier: the latent representation𝐳∈ℋ\mathbf{z}\in\mathcal{H}。与离散代币不同. Unlike discrete tokens𝐱∈𝒱\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{V}，它们被限制在预定义的词汇表中，潜在表示驻留在连续的高维流形上，从而实现更丰富的语义表达, which are constrained to a predefined vocabulary, latent representations reside on a continuous, high-dimensional manifold, enabling substantially richer semantic expressivity[yoshua2013representation, hao2024training, xu2025softcot].

两个核心问题激发了对这些方法的研究：Two central questions motivate the study of these methods:潜在表示编码哪些信息，以及如何将其集成到生成管道中？what information does a latent representation encode, and how is it integrated into the generative pipeline?答案从根本上决定了所得系统的表征能力、训练动态和泛化行为。为了提供一个连贯的组织框架，我们提出了一种分类法，沿着两个正交轴对现有方法进行分类：The answers fundamentally determine the representational capacity, training dynamics, and generalization behavior of the resulting system. To provide a coherent organizational framework, we propose a taxonomy that classifies existing methods along two orthogonal axes: the主题subject表示的（如何of the representation (how𝐳\mathbf{z}是按结构构造的，is structurally constructed,即i.e.，无论是在主干内本地计算还是由结构独立的模块生成）及其, whether it is computed natively within the backbone or generated by a structurally independent module) and its参数化parameterization（构建过程是否依赖于固定模型状态或包含专用的可训练模块）。如图所示(whether the construction process relies on fixed model states or incorporates dedicated trainable modules). As illustrated in Figure6和表and Table4，这些轴的交集产生了一个全面的分类法，包括四个不同的范式，详细信息如下：, the intersection of these axes yields a comprehensive taxonomy comprising four distinct paradigms, detailed as follows:

Depending on which activation type is extracted, internal representations manifest in three principal forms:隐藏状态Hidden State, 加权嵌入Weighted Embedding, 和, and缓存Cache.

内部隐藏状态。Internal Hidden State.作为最普遍的形式，提取中间激活以提供模型演进计算的连续摘要。常见的实例化包括获取位置的最后一个隐藏状态As the most prevalent form, intermediate activations are extracted to provide a continuous summary of the model’s evolving computation. Common instantiations include taking the last hidden state of positionTT，或计算特定层上所有令牌的均值池表示, or computing a mean-pooled representation across all tokens at a particular layerll:

例如，椰子For example, COCONUT[hao2024training]通过将最后一个隐藏状态直接反馈回作为下一个输入嵌入，绕过离散词汇投影并形成连续“思想”的循环，建立了连续生成的基础模式。 SIM-CoTestablishes a foundational pattern for continuous generation by feeding the last hidden state directly back as the next input embedding, bypassing discrete vocabulary projection and forming a recurrent loop of continuous “thoughts”. SIM-CoT[wei2025simcot]和潜在的MASand LatentMAS[zou2025latent]采用这种循环范式。除了直接生成之外，隐藏状态的丰富语义几何在下游应用中证明是有价值的。例如，CoEadopt this recurrent paradigm. Beyond direct generation, the rich semantic geometry of hidden states proves valuable in downstream applications. For instance, CoE[wang2025latent]从合并的隐藏状态构建嵌入链以执行无标签自我评估。在多模式设置中，内部激活经常用作诊断和纠正信号：VTIconstructs chains of embeddings from pooled hidden states to perform label-free self-evaluation. Because these states natively encode pre-trained knowledge, CLReg[tang2026from]进一步利用它们作为调节器来减轻灾难性遗忘。然而，从安全角度来看，内生国家的高表现力是一把双刃剑。进攻端，LFJfurther leverages them as a regularizer to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. The high expressivity of endogenous states is, however, a double-edged sword from a security perspective. On the offensive side, LFJ[xing2025latent]和潜在断裂and LatentBreak[mura2025latentbreak]利用隐藏状态漏洞发起绕过离散文本级过滤器的潜在越狱攻击。相反，JLTexploit hidden-state vulnerabilities to mount latent jailbreak attacks that bypass discrete text-level filters. Conversely, JLT[kadali2026jailbreaking]防御性地监视这些相同的信号，利用它们来检测恶意意图并提高越狱的稳健性。monitors these same signals defensively, using them to detect malicious intent and improve jailbreak robustness.

通过将这些压缩张量视为操作内存，SALSBy treating these compressed tensors as operational memory, SALS[mu2025sals]利用 KV 缓存上的稀疏注意力模式来加速步骤间计算并提高推理效率。潜在MASexploits sparse attention patterns over the KV cache to accelerate inter-step computation and improve inference efficiency. LatentMAS[zou2025latent]将其扩展到多代理协作，使用 KV 缓存作为共享的、连续的工作内存，使代理能够在没有显式文本通信的情况下进行协调。在多模态领域，LRPextends this to multi-agent collaboration, using the KV cache as a shared, continuous working memory that enables agents to coordinate without explicit textual communication. In the multimodal domain, LRP[yao2025reading]结合注意力权重和隐藏状态来捕获更丰富的视觉语义，展示复杂视觉任务的改进抽象和泛化。combines attention weights and hidden states to capture richer visual semantics, demonstrating improved abstraction and generalization on complex visual tasks.

总结。Summary.内部范式将内源模型激活转换为无参数潜在表示，完全绕过离散词汇瓶颈。通过将标准计算副产品视为通用语义资产，它表明内在模型状态具有足够的表示能力来支持连续推理、加速推理并实现稳健的下游分析。The internal paradigm converts endogenous model activations into parameter-free latent representations, entirely bypassing the discrete vocabulary bottleneck. By treating standard computational byproducts as versatile semantic assets, it demonstrates that intrinsic model states carry sufficient representational capacity to support continuous reasoning, accelerate inference, and enable robust downstream analysis.

Based on the modality and functional role ofΦaux\Phi^{\mathrm{aux}}，我们确定了三个方向：, we identify three directions:推理先验Reasoning Priors, 知觉先验Perceptual Priors, 和, and体现先验Embodied Priors.

外部推理先验。External Reasoning Priors.在这里，辅助源在语义域中运行，为骨干网提供结构化逻辑和认知痕迹。一种流行的策略是从专家推理模型中提取知识。科迪Here, the auxiliary source operates in the semantic domain to supply the backbone with structured logic and cognitive traces. A prevalent strategy is knowledge distillation from an expert reasoning model. CODI[shen2025codi]通过自我蒸馏循环将其形式化，其中冻结教师的隐藏状态作为持续的监督目标，指导学生的隐式推理。软CoTformalizes this via a self-distillation loop in which the frozen teacher’s hidden states serve as continuous supervision targets, guiding the implicit reasoning of the student. SoftCoT[xu2025softcot]将这一概念扩展到显式注入：轻量级辅助模型生成推测推理链，这些推理链被投影到软令牌嵌入中并预先添加到主干输入中，从而创建梯度兼容的条件信号，从而大大提高零样本泛化能力。卡瓦extends this concept to explicit injection: a lightweight assistant model generates speculative reasoning chains that are projected into soft-token embeddings and prepended to the backbone input, creating a gradient-compatible conditioning signal that substantially improves zero-shot generalization. KaVa[kuzina2025kava]通过提取教师的压缩 KV 缓存来完全绕过中间输出标记，直接将结构化注意力状态传输为 紧凑的潜在先验。bypasses intermediate output tokens entirely by distilling the teacher’s compressed KV cache, directly transferring structured attention states as compact latent priors.

外部感知先验。External Perceptual Priors.在这里，预先训练的视觉编码器或专门的多模态辅助模型提供空间、时间或结构上丰富的特征图，以增强主要的文本主干。 3D思考者Here, pre-trained vision encoders or specialized multimodal auxiliary models supply spatially, temporally, or structurally rich feature maps to augment a primarily textual backbone. 3DThinker[chen2025think]从专门的空间注入 3D 令牌 辅助网络提供基本模型无法从中导出的几何先验 仅二维输入。滑雪场injects spatially grounded 3D tokens from a specialized auxiliary network to supply geometric priors that the base model cannot derive from two-dimensional inputs alone. SkiLa[tong2025sketchinlatents]利用预先训练的草图标记将中间视觉思维与文本推理交织在一起，明确地奠定模型的空间理解基础。 VL-JEPAleverages pre-trained sketch tokens to interleave intermediate visual thoughts with textual reasoning, explicitly grounding the model’s spatial understanding. VL-JEPA[chen2025vljepa]在抽象表示空间中采用来自预测编码模型的预训练嵌入来改进跨模态分类和 检索。科沃特employs pre-trained embeddings from a predictive-coding model in an abstract representation space to improve cross-modal classification and retrieval. COVT[qin2025chainofvisualthought]使用辅助视觉模型迭代 提取视觉标记并将其融合到主干中，构建连续的视觉思维链。一个潜在的uses an auxiliary vision model to iteratively extract visual tokens and fuse them into the backbone to construct continuous visual thought chains. OneLatent[lv2026onelatent]证明来自强大视觉语言模型的隐藏状态可以将丰富的感知和 OCR 上下文压缩为单个潜在标记，以实现高效的视觉推理。多重代币demonstrates that hidden states from a strong vision-language model can condense rich perceptual and OCR context into a single latent token for highly efficient visual reasoning. Mull-Tokens[ray2025mulltokens]使用源自辅助系统的与模态无关的潜在标记来概括这种注入，从而在语言和视觉基底上实现统一的潜在推理。generalizes this injection with modality-agnostic latent tokens derived from an auxiliary system, enabling uniform latent reasoning across both linguistic and visual substrates.

外部体现先验。External Embodied Priors.这一方向在实体模型和自动驾驶中普遍存在，依靠辅助模型来生成环境动力学、3D 几何和未来行动的结构化潜在表示。奥克VLAThis direction, prevalent in embodied models and autonomous driving, relies on auxiliary models to generate structured latent representations of environmental dynamics, 3D geometry, and future actions. OccVLA[liu2025occvla]应用预先训练的 3D 占用令牌作为监督信号，以传递细粒度的空间理解，而无需在推理时明确的 3D 输入。液晶驱动器applies pre-trained 3D occupancy tokens as a supervisory signal to impart fine-grained spatial understanding without requiring explicit 3D inputs at inference time. LCDrive[tan2025latent]结合外部世界模型来生成动作和场景标记，这些标记注入场景动态的时间一致表示，为主机模型的导航推理奠定基础。拉拉-VLAincorporates an external world model to generate action and scene tokens that inject temporally consistent representations of scene dynamics, grounding the host model’s navigational reasoning. LaRA-VLA[bai2026latent]通过利用预先训练的视觉和动作标记来连接连续感知和运动控制，从而实现从显式多模态监督到复杂具体操作的内化潜在推理的平稳过渡。bridges continuous perception and motor control by utilizing pre-trained visual and action tokens, enabling a smooth transition from explicit multimodal supervision to internalized latent reasoning for complex embodied manipulation.

总结。Summary.外部范式提供了一种弥合模式差距的原则性方法 通过注入结构化知识来规避离散令牌瓶颈 独立的辅助系统。通过将推理、感知和体现先验作为动态条件信号或密集监督目标，它赋予主干网连续推理能力和复杂的结构约束——无需修改主干网的参数。这表明基础模型的表征范围并不严格受限于其本机架构：利用专门的潜在先验提供了一种可扩展的途径来扩展语义范围，同时保持骨干网很大程度上冻结。The external paradigm provides a principled approach to bridging modality gaps and circumventing the discrete token bottleneck by injecting structured knowledge from independent auxiliary systems. By aligning reasoning, perceptual, and embodied priors as either dynamic conditioning signals or dense supervision targets, it endows the backbone with continuous reasoning capabilities and complex structural constraints — without modifying the backbone’s parameters. This demonstrates that a foundation model’s representational scope is not strictly bounded by its native architecture: leveraging specialized latent priors offers a scalable pathway to expand semantic reach while keeping the backbone largely frozen.

Depending on the targeted optimization objective, learnable representations manifest in three primary forms:压缩学习Compression Learning, 分布学习Distribution Learning, 和, andAlignment Learning.

压缩学习。Compression Learning.第一类是由信息瓶颈原则驱动的，优化The first class is driven by information-bottleneck principles, optimizingΦcomp\Phi^{\mathrm{comp}}将显式数据压缩为密集、连续的向量。科拉Rto compress explicit data into dense, continuous vectors. CoLaR[tan2025think]学习使用方差保留缩放因子将连续推理标记聚合到压缩嵌入中。钴酸锂learns to aggregate consecutive reasoning tokens into compressed embeddings using a variance-preserving scaling factor. CoLT[zhu2026colt]采用监督学习将长推理轨迹压缩为参数工具调用的连续种子标记。在多模式领域，LIVRemploys supervised learning to condense long reasoning trajectories into continuous seed tokens for parametric tool calls. In the multimodal domain, LIVR[li2025latent1]在训练过程中造成了视觉瓶颈，要求模型学习隐式空间压缩而不依赖于显式文本描述。在内存层面，DeltaKVimposes a visual bottleneck during training, requiring the model to learn implicit spatial compressions without relying on explicit textual descriptions. At the memory level, DeltaKV[hao2026deltakv]对连续缓存状态之间的残余差异进行编码，以显着压缩长期推理开销。encodes residual differences between successive cache states to substantially compress long-term reasoning overhead.

分布学习。Distribution Learning. The second class abandons deterministic point mappings, instead optimizing Φcomp\Phi^{\mathrm{comp}}捕捉潜在的随机分布和推理的结构流形。控制系统to capture the underlying stochastic distributions and structural manifolds of reasoning. CTRLS[wu2025ctrls]将推理表述为马尔可夫决策过程，并通过狄利克雷分布对状态转换进行建模以捕获认知不确定性。马科斯formulates reasoning as a Markov decision process and models state transitions via Dirichlet distributions to capture epistemic uncertainty. MARCOS[liu2025marcos]采用具有阶梯级潜变量的条件隐马尔可夫模型，依靠变分训练来学习随机连续表示。优尼科格employs a conditional hidden Markov model with step-level latent variables, relying on variational training to learn stochastic continuous representations. UniCog[liu2026unicog]将认知分布表述为潜变量模型，优化证据下限以将激活投影到高维稀疏空间中。潜伏卫士formulates cognitive distributions as a latent variable model, optimizing an evidence lower bound to project activations into a high-dimensional sparse space. LatentGuard[shu2025latentguard]学习使用 VAE 对潜在空间进行建模，操纵生成的语义分布以实现对对抗性输入的稳健拒绝。learns to model the latent space using a VAE, manipulating the resulting semantic distributions to enable robust refusal of adversarial inputs.

KVCA[dery2026latent]学习全局共享的潜在流形learns a globally shared latent manifoldΣ\Sigma通过交叉注意力在架构异构模型之间转换 KV 缓存。 C2Cvia cross-attention to translate KV caches between architecturally heterogeneous models. C2C[fu2025cache]trains a neural MLP to directly project KV caches between specific models by aligning their terminal-layer representations.英特拉特trains a neural MLP to directly project KV caches between specific models by aligning their terminal-layer representations. Interlat[du2025enabling]通过加权 Jensen-Shannon 散度优化通信适配器，以将传输的隐藏状态与接收代理的内部表示对齐。 该范例还桥接了多种模式：MCOUToptimizes communication adapters via a weighted Jensen-Shannon divergence to align transmitted hidden states with the receiving agent’s internal representations. This paradigm also bridges modalities: MCOUT[pham2025multimodal]学习跨模态注意力融合，同时惩罚熵崩溃； MAS4TSlearns cross-modal attention fusion while penalizing entropy collapse; MAS4TS[ruan2026visual]学习从视觉时间序列图重建预测数值轨迹；和TCLAlearns to reconstruct predictive numerical trajectories from visual time-series plots; and TCLA[nikulin2026visionlanguage]将噪声观测信号与干净的、VLM 提示的潜在动作目标对齐，以进行具体操作。aligns noisy observational signals with clean, VLM-prompted latent action targets for embodied manipulation.

总结。Summary.可学习范式擅长获取显式优化的潜在结构 具体的下游目标，摆脱严格的语义界限 通过文本预训练。这种灵活性允许模型对非语言模式进行编码（The learnable paradigm excels at acquiring latent structures explicitly optimized for specific downstream objectives, breaking free from the rigid semantic boundaries imposed by textual pre-training. This flexibility allows models to encode non-verbal modalities (例如e.g., complex spatial layouts and embodied actions) and support high-bandwidth inter-agent collaboration.然而，授予对连续空间的无约束优化访问会带来流形过度拟合的风险：模块可能会记住监督信号中的噪声，从而产生高度专业化的表示，而牺牲了零样本泛化。严格的正则化，包括强制的结构稀疏性、保留方差的标准化和受控的信念转移调整，因此对于保持广泛的效用至关重要。, complex spatial layouts and embodied actions) and support high-bandwidth inter-agent collaboration. However, granting unconstrained optimization access to continuous spaces introduces the risk of manifold overfitting: modules may memorize the noise in supervision signals, yielding highly specialized representations that sacrifice zero-shot generalization. Rigorous regularization, including enforced structural sparsity, variance-preserving normalizations, and controlled belief-shift tuning, which is therefore essential to maintain broad utility.

4.2.4 混合动力Hybrid

混合范例利用专用的、结构性的The hybrid paradigm utilizes a dedicated, structurally独立的independent模块moduleΦcomp\Phi^{\mathrm{comp}}具有可学习的参数with learnable parametersθ\theta构建结构化的潜在表示。让to construct a structured latent representation. Let𝐜\mathbf{c}表示从输入中提取的条件上下文denote a conditioning context drawn from the input𝐱\mathbf{x}或辅助功能。混合表示形式表述为：or auxiliary features. The hybrid representation is formulated as:

𝐳=Φcomp​(𝐜;θ).\mathbf{z}=\Phi^{\mathrm{comp}}(\mathbf{c};\,\theta). (14)

至关重要的是，与可学习范式不同，Crucially, unlike the Learnable paradigm,Φcomp\Phi^{\mathrm{comp}}在架构上仍然与主干脱节remains architecturally disjoint from the backboneΦback\Phi^{\mathrm{back}}。一旦建成，. Once constructed,𝐳\mathbf{z}is deployed in the same manner as the External paradigm: it acts either as an exogenous conditioning signal injected into a typically frozen backbone (serving as a learned alignment bridge), or as a rich, optimized supervision target for latent distillation.这种方法可以概括为三个功能类别：is deployed in the same manner as the External paradigm: it acts either as an exogenous conditioning signal injected into a typically frozen backbone (serving as a learned alignment bridge), or as a rich, optimized supervision target for latent distillation. This approach can be summarized into three functional categories:痕迹Traces, 接地Grounding, 和, and增强Augmentation.

痕迹。Traces.第一个分支将离散推理轨迹提炼为紧凑的连续向量，这些向量指导主干，而不会产生显式思维链的延迟。 HCoTThe first branch distills discrete reasoning trajectories into compact continuous vectors that guide the backbone without the latency of explicit chain-of-thought generation. HCoT[liu2024expediting]将多步推理压缩为专门的思想标记，注入冻结解码器以加速推理。什锦compresses multi-step reasoning into a specialized thought token injected into a frozen decoder to accelerate inference. Assorted[su2025token]通过 VQ-VAE 码本压缩推理段来组合潜在标记和文本标记。潜在SFTcombines latent and text tokens by compressing reasoning segments via a VQ-VAE codebook. Latent-SFT[deng2025latent]restricts the latent space to the column space of the pre-trained vocabulary matrix via induction-supervision masking.循证医学CoTrestricts the latent space to the column space of the pre-trained vocabulary matrix via induction-supervision masking. EBM-CoT[chen2025think1]通过朗之万动力学校准将思维轨迹细化至低能量区域。增益路由器refines thought trajectories toward lower-energy regions via Langevin dynamics calibration. GainRouter[zheng2025fast]学习离散策略先验的密码本，以在连续思维向量上进行单通道解码。思想通讯learns a codebook of discrete strategy priors to condition single-pass decoding on continuous thinking vectors. ThoughtComm[zheng2025thought]采用稀疏正则化自动编码器在代理之间传输潜在思想。对于专业领域，LatentChememploys a sparsity-regularized autoencoder to transmit latent thoughts between agents. For specialized domains, LatentChem[ye2026latentchem]将投影的分子表征与语言空间对齐，而 iCLPaligns projected molecular representations with linguistic spaces, while iCLP[chen2025iclp]和RB-CoTand RB-CoT[he2026reasoning]生成对提示敏感的潜在计划来指导多步推理。generate prompt-sensitive latent plans to guide multi-step reasoning.

接地。Grounding.第二个分支将连续的感觉或控制信号转换为结构化的潜在令牌，将冻结的主干植根于物理现实。在视觉领域，AURORAThe second branch translates continuous sensory or control signals into structured latent tokens, grounding the frozen backbone in physical reality. In the visual domain, AURORA[perception2025bigverdi]训练 VQ-VAE 产生离散的视觉潜在代码，增强空间感知，而 Monettrains a VQ-VAE to produce discrete visual latent codes that enhance spatial perception, while Monet[wang2025monet]generates continuous embeddings as intermediate visual thoughts via multi-stage distillation.在具身机器人领域，UniVLAgenerates continuous embeddings as intermediate visual thoughts via multi-stage distillation. In embodied robotics, UniVLA[bu2025univla]从异构视频中导出以任务为中心的潜在动作，并将它们投影到统一的动作空间中。拉特机器人derives task-centric latent actions from heterogeneous videos and projects them into a unified action space. LatBot[li2025latbot]将潜在动作分解为离散运动和场景标记；莫图斯decomposes latent actions into discrete motion and scene tokens; Motus[bi2025motus]通过光流提取像素级增量动作；尤尼拉克特extracts pixel-level delta actions via optical flow; UniLACT[govind2026unilact]从 RGB-D 帧构建深度感知的潜在动作表示；和维塔constructs depth-aware latent action representations from RGB-D frames; and VITA[ma2025unifying]将视觉动作动态映射到统一的密码本中。maps visual-action dynamics into unified codebooks.

增强。Augmentation.第三个分支将大量上下文历史压缩为压缩的软提示或动态增强的缓存状态，将有效上下文扩展到标准窗口限制之外。 DCAThe third branch condenses large contextual histories into compressed soft prompts or dynamically augmented cache states, extending effective context beyond standard window limits. DCA[liu2025deliberation]通过离线协处理器生成潜在嵌入并将其直接附加到 KV 缓存，从而在不改变解码架构的情况下丰富上下文。克拉拉generates latent embeddings via an offline coprocessor and appends them directly to the KV cache, enriching context without altering the decoding architecture. CLaRa[he2025clara]通过在合成数据上训练的显着压缩器将冗长的文档编码为紧凑的内存令牌，从而实现检索表示空间的端到端优化。 DEPencodes lengthy documents into compact memory tokens via a salient compressor trained on synthetic data, enabling end-to-end optimization of the retrieval representation space. DEP[qiu2025latent]isolates user-specific interaction patterns via a sparse autoencoder and injects them as soft prompts for personalized generation.在多模式设置中，VisMemisolates user-specific interaction patterns via a sparse autoencoder and injects them as soft prompts for personalized generation. In multimodal settings, VisMem[yu2025vismem]和CoMEMand CoMEM[wu2025towards]构建专用的视觉记忆标记，提取情景经验以进行长期规划，而 MemGenconstruct dedicated visual memory tokens that distill episodic experiences for long-horizon planning, while MemGen[zhang2025memgen]将情景表示集成到自我进化行为的计算中。integrates episodic representations into computation for self-evolving behavior.

总结。Summary.混合表示特别适合复杂的、多模式的或领域专用的设置，在这些设置中，原始输入和主干文本流形之间的差距造成了纯粹内部方法和纯粹可学习方法都无法充分解决的瓶颈。通过首先通过有针对性的可学习采集构建特定于任务的潜在表示，然后将其部署为结构化外部条件信号，混合方法实现了双重优势：语义保真度、原始输入模态中的基础表示；和计算效率，使主干网无需在推理时处理原始的高维输入。Hybrid representations are particularly suited to complex, multimodal, or domain-specialized settings in which the gap between raw inputs and the backbone’s textual manifold creates bottlenecks that neither purely internal nor purely learnable approaches can adequately resolve. By first constructing a task-specific latent representations via targeted learnable acquisition and subsequently deploying it as a structured external conditioning signal, hybrid approaches achieve a dual advantage: semantic fidelity, grounding representations in the raw input modality; and computational efficiency, sparing the backbone from processing raw, high-dimensional inputs at inference time.

4.3 计算Computation

近年来，潜在层计算的研究进展迅速，反映出与传统范式的更广泛的背离，在传统范式中，语言模型通过固定深度、逐个令牌生成来执行推理。In recent years, research on latent-level computation has advanced rapidly, reflecting a broader departure from the conventional paradigm in which language models perform inference through fixed-depth, token-by-token generation[survey2025zhu, feng2025efficient]。相反，越来越多的工作旨在通过将部分推理过程转移到潜在空间来为模型配备更灵活、高效和可扩展的计算机制。. Instead, a growing body of work aims to equip models with more flexible, efficient, and scalable computational mechanisms by shifting part of the reasoning process to the latent space.

To enable a systematic analysis, a central question to consider is: what kinds of computational operations are performed in the latent space?从这个角度来看，现有的方法可以沿着以下维度进行组织：From this perspective, existing methods can be organized along the dimension of操作operation，产生四个主要类别。具体来说，根据其底层的计算操作，如图所示, yielding four major categories. Specifically, based on their underlying computational operations, as illustrated in Figure7和表and Table5，我们将现有方法分为四种有代表性的类型：, we classify existing approaches into four representative types:

4.3.1 压缩的Compressed

该范式包含了投射明确的方法 轨迹This paradigm subsumes approaches that project an explicit trajectory𝐫∈𝒱\mathbf{r}\in\mathcal{V}到语义密集的 潜在表征onto a semantically dense latent representation𝐳\mathbf{z}。 压缩算子. A compression operatorΦ​(⋅)\Phi(\cdot)作用于中间体 隐藏状态acts upon the intermediate hidden states𝐡\mathbf{h}产生：to yield:

𝐳=Φ​(𝐡),|𝐳|≪|𝐡|,\mathbf{z}=\Phi(\mathbf{h}),\quad|\mathbf{z}|\ll|\mathbf{h}|, (15)

哪里whereΦ​(⋅)\Phi(\cdot)可以实现为功能 组件may be realized as both a functional componentΦc​o​m​p​(⋅)\Phi^{comp}(\cdot)或脊梁骨or the backboneΦback\Phi^{\mathrm{back}}本身，减少自回归开销 同时保留忠实下游解码所需的语义保真度。itself, reducing autoregressive overhead while preserving the semantic fidelity requisite for faithful downstream decoding.

压缩计算旨在通过将冗长的推理轨迹或高维隐藏状态映射到紧凑的潜在表示中来降低显式中间计算的成本，同时保留准确下游解码所需的语义信息。该范式并不是完全消除推理，而是寻求以信息更密集的形式保留推理内容，从而以三种形式提高文本、内部和跨模式推理过程的效率：Compressed computation aims to reduce the cost of explicit intermediate computation by mapping verbose reasoning trajectories or high-dimensional hidden states into compact latent representations, while preserving the semantic information necessary for accurate downstream decoding. Rather than eliminating reasoning altogether, this paradigm seeks to retain inferential content in a more information-dense form, thereby improving efficiency across textual, internal, and cross-modal reasoning processes in three forms:迹线压缩Traces Compression, 状态压缩States Compression, 和, and特征压缩Features Compression.

痕迹压缩。Traces Compression.最近在这个方向上的工作可以围绕一个共同的目标进行组织：保持推理保真度，同时减少显式跟踪长度。 HCoTRecent work on this direction can be organized around a shared goal: preserving inferential fidelity while reducing explicit trace lengths. HCoT[liu2024expediting]和软CoTand SoftCoT[xu2025softcot]使用 HCoT 强调跨抽象级别的语义对齐emphasize semantic alignment across abstraction levels, with HCoT[liu2024expediting]使用分层压缩来跳过冗余的中间令牌和 SoftCoTusing hierarchical compression to skip redundant intermediate tokens and SoftCoT[xu2025softcot]将推理投影到连续的软令牌空间中，将推理深度与离散迹线长度解耦，从而支持零样本传输，而无需特定于任务的重新训练。同时，CCoTprojecting reasoning into a continuous soft-token space that decouples reasoning depth from discrete trace length, thereby supporting zero-shot transfer without task-specific retraining. In parallel, CCoT[cheng2024compressed]将压缩建模为可变长度的潜在分配，将较短的表示分配给更简单的推理，将更丰富的表示分配给更复杂的推论，而 CODImodels compression as variable-length latent allocation, assigning shorter representations to simpler inferences and richer ones to more complex deductions, while CODI[shen2025codi]和CoLaRand CoLaR[tan2025think]分别关注通过自蒸馏和动态令牌级别控制的自适应压缩。focus on adaptive compaction through self-distillation and dynamic token-level control, respectively.

状态压缩。States Compression.一种互补且可能更深的压缩形式不是针对解码的令牌序列，而是针对内部缓存，其随序列长度的线性增长已成为长上下文和推理密集型推理的主要瓶颈。最近的工作探索了三种主要方法。卡瓦A complementary and potentially deeper form of compression targets not the decoded token sequence but the internal cache, whose linear growth with sequence length has become a major bottleneck for long-context and reasoning-intensive inference. Recent work explores three main approaches. KaVa[kuzina2025kava]将 KV 缓存压缩表述为知识蒸馏问题，训练学生模型以匹配教师在整个缓存上操作的输出分布。萨尔斯formulates KV-cache compression as a knowledge distillation problem, training a student model to match the output distribution of a teacher operating over the full cache. SALS[mu2025sals]相反，通过将缓存投影到低秩主子空间中，采用轻量级、免训练的策略，认为主导方向足以保留具有有限误差的注意力模式。德尔塔KVinstead adopts a lightweight, training-free strategy by projecting the cache into a low-rank principal subspace, arguing that the dominant directions are sufficient to preserve attention patterns with bounded error. DeltaKV[hao2026deltakv]利用连续推理步骤中 KV 缓存之间的高度相关性，存储语义压缩的残差而不是完整的缓存状态，并在步骤间冗余最大的多步骤推理任务上报告特别强大的收益。exploits the high correlation between KV-caches across successive reasoning steps, storing semantically compressed residuals rather than full cache states, and reports particularly strong gains on multi-step reasoning tasks where inter-step redundancy is greatest.

特点 压缩。Features Compression.最近关于潜在空间压缩的工作已经从文本转向多模式和具体化设置，其中主要瓶颈是感知-动作循环中使用的高维视觉和动作表示，例如自动驾驶、机器人操作和具体化导航。在视觉推理中，RoTRecent work on latent-space compression has moved beyond text to multimodal and embodied settings, where the main bottleneck is the high-dimensional visual and action representations used in perception–action loops such as autonomous driving, robot manipulation, and embodied navigation. In visual reasoning, RoT[wang2026renderofthought]将中间推理状态渲染为低分辨率图像块而不是标记序列，从而使后续步骤能够在压缩视觉结构上进行操作，OneLatentrenders intermediate reasoning states as low-resolution image patches rather than token sequences, enabling subsequent steps to operate over compressed visual structure, OneLatent[lv2026onelatent]学习单个潜在视觉标记，该标记可以提取下游推理所需的图像上下文，从而以大幅减少视觉标记预算的方式实现有竞争力的性能。在体现控制中，LatentVLAlearns a single latent visual token that distills the image context needed for downstream reasoning, achieving competitive performance with a drastically reduced visual token budget. In embodied control, LatentVLA[xie2026latentvla]将视觉输入投射到紧凑的动作潜伏中以进行实时规划，表明低维表示可以保留闭环决策所需的信息，而 Future-VLAprojects visual inputs into compact action latents for real-time planning, showing that low-dimensional representations can retain the information necessary for closed-loop decision making, while Future-VLA[fan2026future]通过学习包含预期状态而不增加维度的未来条件潜伏来扩展这个想法。extends this idea by learning future-conditioned latents that incorporate anticipated states without increasing dimensionality.

总结。Summary.总的来说，压缩推理可以理解为用显式长度换取潜在密度的统一范式。在显式轨迹、内部状态和跨模式表示中，现有方法具有相同的中心目标：保持推理保真度，同时减少与冗长的中间表示相关的计算和内存开销。这表明有效的推理不必总是保持完全标记化或完全物化，并且语义紧凑的表示可以为日益复杂的推理系统中的有效推理提供可扩展的基础。Overall, compressed reasoning can be understood as a unifying paradigm for trading explicit length for latent density. Across explicit traces, internal states, and cross-modal representations, existing methods share the same central objective: to preserve reasoning fidelity while reducing the computational and memory overhead associated with verbose intermediate representations. This suggests that effective reasoning need not always remain fully tokenized or fully materialized, and that semantically compact representations may provide a scalable foundation for efficient inference in increasingly complex reasoning systems.

4.3.2 扩展Expanded

在此类别中，它通过沿潜在计算扩展来增强模型的有效计算能力 深度或宽度尺寸。形式上，该模型迭代 步-In this category, it augments the effective computational capacity of the model by extending latent computation along the depth or width dimensions. Formally, the model iterates over a step-TT, 宽度-, width-KK:

𝐡t+1(k)=Φ​({𝐡t(k)}k=1K),t=1,…,T,k=1,…,K,\mathbf{h}_{t+1}^{(k)}=\Phi\!\left(\bigl\{\mathbf{h}_{t}^{(k)}\bigr\}_{k=1}^{K}\right),\quad t=1,\ldots,T,\;\;k=1,\ldots,K, (16)

哪里where𝐡t(k)\mathbf{h}_{t}^{(k)}表示denotes thekk第-步的潜在轨迹-th latent trajectory at steptt，以及所有, and allKK路径共享共同的初始化paths share a common initialization𝐡(0)\mathbf{h}^{(0)}.

扩展方法通过沿不同维度扩大潜在过程来增加有效计算能力。它们不依赖于单一的固定前向传递，而是使模型能够用额外的潜在计算来换取更强的能力、更高的可信度和更好的跨任务适应性，这可以分为三种类型的扩展：Expanded methods increase the effective computational capacity by enlarging the latent process along different dimensions. Rather than relying on a single fixed forward pass, they enable the model to trade extra latent computation for stronger ability, improved faithfulness, and better adaptability across tasks, which could be classified into three types of expansion:深度拓展Depth Expansion, 宽度扩展Width Expansion, 和, and结构扩张Structural Expansion.

深度扩展。Depth Expansion.深度扩展方法通过在多个循环过程中重复使用相同或结构相似的层来提高有效计算，从而允许模型在生成输出之前迭代地细化潜在表示。在循环预训练中，HuginnDepth-expanding approaches increase effective compute by reusing the same or structurally similar layers across multiple recurrent passes, allowing the model to iteratively refine a latent representation before producing an output. In recurrent pretraining, Huginn[jonas2025scaling]引入了一种从头开始训练的具有循环深度的轻量级模型，其中固定的变压器块应用于可变数量的思维步骤，从而将参数计数与推理时间计算解耦，并在不添加参数的情况下实现测试时间缩放。 RD-VLAintroduces a lightweight model trained from scratch with recurrent depth, where a fixed transformer block is applied for a variable number of thinking steps, thereby decoupling parameter count from inference-time compute and enabling test-time scaling without adding parameters. RD-VLA[tur2026recurrent]将这种范式扩展到具体模型，并表明循环潜在细化可以改善长期操纵规划。在环形变压器中，Loopextends this paradigm to embodied models and shows that recurrent latent refinement improves long-horizon manipulation planning. In looped transformers, Loop[saunshi2025reasoning]证明重复应用完整的解码器堆栈可以引发真正的多步推理，而不是简单地近似更深的固定网络，而 LoopFormerdemonstrates that repeatedly applying the full decoder stack can induce genuinely multi-step reasoning rather than simply approximating a deeper fixed network , while LoopFormer[jeddi2026loopformer]添加输入自适应循环以根据任务复杂性动态分配深度。从预训练的角度来看，Ouroadds input-adaptive looping to allocate depth dynamically according to task complexity . From a pretraining perspective, Ouro[zhu2025scaling]沿着循环维度表现出良好的缩放行为，并提高了忠实度和效率。相关地，ETDshows favorable scaling behavior along the looping dimension, with gains in faithfulness and efficiency . Relatedly, ETD[koishekenov2025encode]提出了一种编码-思考-解码框架，其中潜在思维状态在解码之前被迭代地细化，从而在没有明确的思维链监督的情况下对算术和常识任务产生强大的零样本概括。proposes an encode-think-decode framework in which a latent thought state is iteratively refined before decoding, yielding strong zero-shot generalization on arithmetic and commonsense tasks without explicit chain-of-thought supervision.

宽度扩展。Width Expansion.这些方法与其他方法形成对比，通过在多个并行假设或潜在轨迹之间分配计算，从而优先考虑广泛探索而不是顺序细化。这种范式出现在最近的几个框架中，SoftCoT++These methods contrast with other approaches by allocating compute across multiple parallel hypotheses or latent trajectories, thereby prioritizing broad exploration over sequential refinement. This paradigm appears in several recent frameworks, SoftCoT++[xu2025softcot1]在连续嵌入空间中实例化多个并行推理路径，并在解码前聚合它们，从而实现零样本性能增益，该增益随路径数量单调扩展，而不需要特定于路径的监督。 LatentTTS 也遵循类似的原理instantiates multiple parallel reasoning paths in continuous embedding space and aggregates them before decoding, achieving zero-shot performance gains that scale monotonically with the number of paths without requiring path-specific supervision. A similar principle underlies LatentTTS[you2025parallel]，它执行并发潜在树搜索并使用学习值函数修剪部分假设。 PCCoT, which performs concurrent latent tree search and prunes partial hypotheses with a learned value function. PCCoT[wu25parallel]通过使多个潜在链并行运行并在同步点交换信息，进一步扩展了这一想法，提高了效率，同时保留了解决方案的多样性；同样，CoT2further extends this idea by enabling multiple latent chains to run in parallel and exchange information at synchronization points, improving efficiency while preserving solution diversity; likewise, CoT2[gozeten2025continuous]表明连续思维空间中的并行采样甚至对组合推理任务的 GPT2 规模模型也有很大好处。在特殊设置中，气泡shows that parallel sampling in continuous thought space substantially benefits even GPT2-scale models on compositional reasoning tasks. In specialized settings, Bubbles[liu2025thoughtbubbles]将宽度扩展制定为并行“气泡”，其池化表示支持大规模的零样本和无监督学习，而 PLRformulates width expansion as parallel “bubbles" whose pooled representations support zero-shot and unsupervised learning at scale, while PLR[tang2026parallel]将并行潜在推理应用于顺序推荐，其中不同的潜在表示比单个确定性传递更好地捕获用户偏好的不确定性。applies parallel latent reasoning to sequential recommendation, where diverse latent representations better capture user preference uncertainty than a single deterministic pass.

结构性扩张。Structural Expansion.较小但概念上不同的工作线不再只是简单地增加计算图的深度或宽度，而是引入了新的拓扑原语，用于跨位置、模式或控制级别组合潜在信息。潜在SFTA smaller but conceptually distinct line of work departs from simply increasing the depth or width of the computation graph and instead introduces new topological primitives for composing latent information across positions, modalities, or levels of control. Latent-SFT[deng2025latent]监督叠加潜在链上的模型（多步推理轨迹的连续压缩），而不是其令牌级实现，从而在保持推理性能的同时降低解码成本。将类似的叠加原理扩展到视觉推理，激光supervises models on superposed latent chains—continuous compressions of multi-step reasoning trajectories—rather than their token-level realizations, thereby reducing decoding cost while preserving reasoning performance. Extending a similar superposition principle to visual reasoning, Laser[wang2026forest]将多尺度视觉特征融合到共享的潜在表示中，而不是独立处理每个分辨率。在系统层面，ColaVLAfuses multi-scale visual features into a shared latent representation instead of processing each resolution independently. At the system level, ColaVLA[peng2025colavla]将 VLA 建模分解为并行但交互式的高级语义推理和低级运动规划流，通过跨时间尺度的交叉注意力连接起来，从而更好地将语言抽象与连续控制结合起来。decomposes VLA modeling into parallel but interactive high-level semantic reasoning and low-level motor planning streams, linked through cross-attention across temporal scales, which better aligns linguistic abstraction with continuous control.

总结。Summary.在这一部分中，方法通过沿着三个互补维度（深度、宽度和结构）扩展计算来丰富潜在推理。深度扩展强调通过循环或循环计算进行迭代细化，宽度扩展促进对多个潜在假设的并行探索，结构扩展引入更丰富的拓扑，用于跨轨迹、位置或模态组合信息。总之，这些方法都有一个共同的目标，即通过增加潜在空间中的有效计算来提高推理性能，同时避免模型参数成比例增加。In this part, approaches enrich latent reasoning by scaling computation along three complementary dimensions: depth, width, and structure. Depth expansion emphasizes iterative refinement through recurrent or looped computation, width expansion promotes parallel exploration over multiple latent hypotheses, and structural expansion introduces richer topologies for composing information across trajectories, positions, or modalities. Together, these methods share a common goal of improving reasoning performance by increasing effective calculation in latent space, while avoiding a proportional increase in model parameters.

4.3.3 自适应Adaptive

在这一部分中，方法通过调节两者来概括扩展框架 复发深度In this part, methods generalize the Expanded framework by conditioning both recurrence depthTT和轨迹宽度and trajectory widthKK关于输入复杂度 的on the input complexity of𝐱\mathbf{x}，而不是将它们规定为固定的超参数。 学习停止函数, rather than prescribing them as fixed hyperparameters. A learned halting functional𝒯\mathcal{T}管理特定于实例的 终止，产生可变范围计算：governs instance-specific termination, yielding a variable-horizon computation:

𝐡t+1(k)=Φ​({𝐡t(k)}k=1K),\mathbf{h}_{t+1}^{(k)}=\Phi\!\left(\bigl\{\mathbf{h}_{t}^{(k)}\bigr\}_{k=1}^{K}\right), (17)

哪里wheret∈[1,T]t\in[1,T]和andk∈[1,K]k\in[1,K]可以按以下粒度确定 令牌边界，或通过暂停函数基于当前隐藏状态的其他自适应策略may be determined at the granularity of tokens boundaries, or other adaptive strategies based on the current hidden states by a halting function𝒯​(⋅)\mathcal{T}(\cdot):

(T,K)=𝒯​(𝐡t;𝐱),(T,\,K)=\mathcal{T}(\mathbf{h}_{t};\,\mathbf{x}),\qquad (18)

其中停止函数可以是显式组件，也可以内化到模型中。 这个输入条件 在任务难度允许的情况下，分配集中推理深度， 实现计算节约和计算节约之间的原则性权衡 表达能力。where the halting function could be a explicit component, or be internalized the model. This input-conditioned allocation concentrates reasoning depth where warranted by task difficulty, realizing a principled trade-off between computational frugality and expressive capacity.

自适应计算允许模型根据输入的复杂性动态分配计算资源，而不是依赖于固定的递归深度或轨迹宽度。在这种设置下，计算量、结构和位置变得依赖于输入，使模型能够更灵活地平衡效率和容量。现有的方法大致可以从三个角度来理解：Adaptive computation allows the model to allocate computational resources dynamically according to the complexity of the input, rather than relying on a fixed recurrence depth or trajectory width. In this setting, the amount, structure, and locus of computation become input-dependent, enabling the model to balance efficiency and capacity more flexibly. Existing methods can be broadly understood from three perspectives:深度/宽度适应Depth/Width Adaptation, 语义适应Semantic Adaptation, 和, and控制适应Control Adaptation.

深度/宽度适应。Depth/Width Adaptation.自适应计算的自然轴是深度，即应用的步数。基于这一原则，TaHA natural axis for adaptive computation is depth, that is, the number of steps applied. Building on this principle, TaH[fu2025tah]提出了一种思考和停止机制，允许共享权重迭代模型在简单的令牌上提前退出，同时为较难的令牌分配额外的细化步骤。轻量级WSproposes a think-and-halt mechanism that allows a shared-weight iterative model to exit early on easy tokens while allocating additional refinement steps to harder ones. LWS[ning2025learning]类似地，将停止视为一种学习策略，与语言建模目标联合优化辅助停止变量。从深度迭代转向潜在链指导，PLaTsimilarly treats halting as a learned policy, jointly optimizing an auxiliary stopping variable with the language modeling objective. Moving from depth-wise iteration to latent-chain guidance, PLaT[wang2026latent]学习在解码之前何时终止潜在令牌生成，明确地权衡深度和效率。在架构层面，梦想家learns when to terminate latent token generation before decoding, explicitly trading off depth against efficiency. At the architectural level, Dreamer[knupp2026depthrecurrent]和螺旋成型机and SpiralFormer[yu2026spiralformer]用重量绑定的循环变压器取代固定深度堆栈，证明深度自适应不仅可以通过学习停止策略来实现，还可以通过循环设计来实现。replace fixed-depth stacks with weight-tied recurrent transformers, demonstrating that depth adaptivity can be achieved not only through learned halting policies but also through recurrent designs.

深度自适应调节计算链的长度，宽度自适应调节其分支结构，While depth adaptation modulates the length of the computational chain, width adaptation modulates its branching structure,即i.e.，每一步探索的平行假设或政策轨迹。 I2B-LPO, the parallel hypotheses or policy trajectories explored at each step. I2B-LPO[deng2026iiblpo]学习在高度不确定性的区域扩展其分支因子，并在置信度足够的情况下折叠分支，这表明宽度适应在长视野推理任务中特别有影响力，在这些任务中，过早地致力于单一推理路径会导致系统失败。learns to expand its branching factor in regions of high uncertainty and to collapse branches where confidence is sufficient, demonstrating that width adaptation is particularly impactful in long-horizon reasoning tasks where premature commitment to a single reasoning path leads to systematic failure.

语义适应。Semantic Adaptation.该范例通过将不同的预算分配给单个前向传递中的各个标记或语义单元，以最细粒度分配计算。例如，AL-CoTThis paradigm allocates computation at the finest granularity by assigning different budgets to individual tokens or semantic units within a single forward pass. For example, AL-CoT[zeng2025pretraining]在语义中应用标记级适应，为困难的标记分配更多的细化步骤。 PonderLM-3 也提出了类似的想法applies token-level adaptation within the semantic, assigning more refinement steps to difficult tokens. A similar idea is developed in PonderLM-3[li2026ponderlm]和阿达庞德LMand AdaPonderLM[song2026adaponderlm]，赋予各个令牌学习深度或停止决策，从而实现异构的每个令牌计算和更强的语义一致性。 相比之下，DLCM, which endow individual tokens with learned depth or halting decisions, enabling heterogeneous per-token computation and stronger semantic consistency. In contrast, DLCM[qu2025dynamic]将适应从标记转变为可能跨越多个标记的语义连贯概念。shifts adaptation from tokens to semantically coherent concepts that may span multiple tokens.

控制适应。Control Adaptation.这部分是指通过控制信号调节计算的方法，This part refers to methods that regulate computation through control signals,例如e.g.、学习的激活向量、路由策略或提取机制。系统1.5, learned activation vectors, routing policies, or extraction mechanisms. System-1.5[wang2025system]引入了认知捷径，允许根据估计的输入难度绕过中间变压器块。 FR思考introduces cognitive shortcuts that allow to bypass intermediate transformer blocks according to estimated input difficulty. FR-Ponder[he2025learning]通过实例自适应激活控制扩展了这个想法，通过基于早期层特征的动态选择的表示子空间子集路由每个输入。立管extends this idea through instance-adaptive activation steering, routing each input through a dynamically selected subset of representational subspaces based on early-layer features. RISER[ye2026riser]同样，将适应视为潜在推理技能的组合，编码为激活空间中的转向方向，从而无需基于梯度的更新即可对看不见的任务进行零样本泛化。作为补充，PREsimilarly treats adaptation as the composition of latent reasoning skills encoded as steering directions in activation space, enabling zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks without gradient-based updating. Complementarily, PRE[liu2026layerorder]表明选择性提取中间层表示作为反向信号，优于对最终层输出的依赖。shows that selective extraction of intermediate-layer representations as reversed signals, outperforming reliance on final-layer outputs.

总结。Summary.总之，自适应方法将固定预算循环推理推广到输入条件计算范式中。在深度/宽度适应、语义适应和控制适应方面，共同目标是更有选择性地分配计算：在困难输入、不确定推理分支或关键语义单元上花费更多资源，同时在更简单的情况下保持效率。总而言之，这些方法表明自适应方法的未来不仅在于增加计算量，还在于学习何时、何地以及如何最有效地使用它。In summary, adaptive methods generalize fixed-budget recurrent reasoning into an input-conditioned computation paradigm. Across depth/width adaptation, semantic adaptation, and control adaptation, the common goal is to allocate computation more selectively: spending more resources on difficult inputs, uncertain reasoning branches, or critical semantic units, while preserving efficiency on simpler cases. Taken together, these approaches suggest that the future of adaptive methods lie not merely in increasing computation, but in learning where, when, and how to use it most effectively.

4.3.4 交错Interleaved

该范式通过以下方式构建异构生成序列 交替离散令牌嵌入This paradigm constructs a heterogeneous generation sequence by alternating discrete token embeddings in𝒱\mathcal{V}与 连续潜伏于with continuous latent inℋ\mathcal{H}，产生交错生成：, yielding interleaved generation:

𝐫=[r1,z1,r2,z2,…,rM,zN],ri∈𝒱,zj∈ℋ,\mathbf{r}=\bigl[r_{1},\,z_{1},\,r_{2},\,z_{2},\,\ldots,\,r_{M},\,z_{N}\bigr],\quad r_{i}\in\mathcal{V},\;\;z_{j}\in\mathcal{H}, (19)

哪里的where the𝐫\mathbf{r}生成轨迹，实现 显式符号推理和隐式符号推理的协同耦合 神经计算。generation trajectory, achieving a synergistic coupling of explicit symbolic reasoning and implicit neural computation.

交错计算将推理视为异构顺序过程，其中离散标记和连续潜在变量在统一轨迹内交替。与纯粹基于标记或纯粹潜在推理相比，该范例提供了更灵活的接口，用于跨显式符号步骤和隐式神经操作分配计算。现有的工作可大致分为三类：Interleaved computation views reasoning as a heterogeneous sequential process in which discrete tokens and continuous latents are alternated within a unified trajectory. Compared with purely token-based or purely latent reasoning, this paradigm provides a more flexible interface for allocating computation across explicit symbolic steps and implicit neural operations. Existing work can be broadly grouped into three categories:显隐交错Explicit-latent Interleaving, 模态交织Modality Interleaving, 和, and任务交错Task Interleaving.

显式-隐式交错。Explicit-latent Interleaving.混合生成将自然语言标记与潜在内部状态交错在单个轨迹内，其动机是观察到许多中间步骤不需要完全语言化，因此可以在不降低性能的情况下更有效地执行。早期的实证支持来自于 AssortedHybrid generation interleaves natural-language tokens with latent internal states within a single trajectory, motivated by the observation that many intermediate steps need not be fully verbalised and can therefore be executed more efficiently without degrading performance. Early empirical support comes from Assorted[su2025token]，这表明用潜在激活替换选定的口头思维链步骤可以保留下游准确性，同时大大减少令牌的使用。随后的工作将这个想法扩展到两个主要方向。一线研究固定或基于课程的交错方案：SpiralThinker, which shows that replacing selected verbal chain-of-thought steps with latent activations preserves downstream accuracy while substantially reducing token usage. Subsequent work extends this idea in two main directions. One line studies fixed or curriculum-based interleaving schemes: SpiralThinker[piao2025spiralthinker]通过螺旋式课程逐步内化明确的推理步骤，LiteReasonprogressively internalises explicit reasoning steps through a spiral curriculum, and LiteReason[gurung2025lightweight]证明即使是轻量级模型也可以学习一种混合显式-隐式推理的形式。第二行使显式-潜在边界本身具有适应性：SwiReasoningdemonstrates that even a lightweight model can learn a form of mixed explicit–latent reasoning. A second line makes the explicit–latent boundary itself adaptive: SwiReasoning[shi2025swireasoning]通过强化学习、LT-Tuning 学习阶梯级切换策略learns a step-level switching policy via reinforcement learning, LT-Tuning[liu2026latent]将潜在思想位置纳入指令调整中，ThinkRouterincorporates latent-thought positions into instruction tuning, and ThinkRouter[xu2026thinkrouter]将查询路由到系统级别的不同推理深度，以平衡效率和准确性。routes queries to different reasoning depths at the system level to balance efficiency and accuracy.

模态交织。Modality Interleaving.当通过非文本输入（例如视觉想象或感知特征图）生成时，潜在表示不仅是一种效率机制，而且是一种表示要求，因为底层信息无法在离散文本中完全捕获。因此，模态交织方法将连续感知潜在与语言标记相结合，允许模型在潜在域中执行中间推理。早期作品如AURORAWhen generation over non-textual inputs such as visual imagination, or perceptual feature maps, latent representations are not merely an efficiency mechanism but a representational requirement, since the underlying information cannot be fully captured in discrete text. Modality-interleaving methods therefore integrate continuous perceptual latents with linguistic tokens, allowing models to perform intermediate reasoning in the latent domain. Early work such as AURORA[perception2025bigverdi]通过插入明确的感知推理步骤建立了这种范式。随后的研究，包括 Mirageestablished this paradigm by inserting explicit perceptual reasoning steps. Subsequent studies, including Mirage[yang2025machine], 左室容积, LVR[li2025latent]、VisMem, VisMem[yu2025vismem]和莫奈, and Monet[wang2025monet]，表明直接将视觉潜伏插入架构中可以改善视觉任务，而无需依赖文本场景描述。, showed that directly interleaving vision latents into architectures improves visual tasks without relying on textual scene descriptions.

相关工作将交织扩展到多种潜在类型：IVT-LRA related line of work extends interleaving to multiple latent types: IVT-LR[chen2025reasoning]通过交叉注意力耦合文本和视觉激活，而 SkiLacouples text and vision activations through cross-attention, while SkiLa[tong2025sketchinlatents], LS [zhang2025latentsketchpad]，和 MM-CoT, and MM-CoT[shao2026learning]使用视觉潜在作为支持后续语言推理的内部画板。超越二维感知，3DThinkeruse visual latents as an internal sketchpad that supports subsequent language reasoning. Beyond two-dimensional perception, 3DThinker[chen2025think]结合了几何和空间推理的空间潜伏以及 DMLRincorporates spatial latents for geometric and spatial reasoning, and DMLR[liu2025reason]与ILVR一起together with ILVR[dong2025interleaved]表明稀疏潜在交织可以保持强大的接地性能，同时降低计算成本。shows that sparse latent interleaving can preserve strong grounding performance while reducing computational cost.

任务交错。Task Interleaving.第三个家族并不将交错视为混合令牌类型或模态的机制，而是将其视为协调异构功能模块（例如内存存储、检索组件、生成头和代理子流程）的手段。其定义特征是交错的潜在流携带特定于任务的结构化信号，A third family views interleaving not as a mechanism for mixing token types or modalities, but as a means of coordinating heterogeneous functional modules such as memory stores, retrieval components, generative heads, and agent sub-processes. Its defining feature is that the interleaved latent stream carries task-specific structured signals,例如e.g.、检索到的证据、情景记忆痕迹或代理间通信，而不是通用推理状态。在单模型设置中，这个想法主要表现为记忆推理集成：LCR-SER 显式地将压缩历史缓冲区与持续推理交错以进行顺序推荐, retrieved evidence, episodic memory traces, or inter-agent communications, rather than general-purpose reasoning states. In single-model settings, this idea primarily appears as memory–reasoning integration: LCR-SER explicitly interleaves a compressed history buffer with ongoing inference for sequential recommendation[shi2025bridging];记忆基因; MemGen[zhang2025memgen]、VisMem, VisMem[yu2025vismem]和闪存and FlashMem[hou2026flashmem]分别通过生成的内存令牌为模型配备持久工作内存；和克拉拉equip models with persistent working memory through, respectively, generated memory tokens; and CLaRa[he2025clara]在联合训练的潜在查找框架中交错检索和生成，而不是将检索视为外部管道。在多代理设置中，交错进一步充当异步操作代理之间的协调协议：LatentMeminterleaves retrieval and generation in a jointly trained latent lookup framework, rather than treating retrieval as an external pipeline. In multi-agent settings, interleaving further serves as a coordination protocol across asynchronously operating agents: LatentMem[fu2026latentmem]引入了共享潜在记忆，支持协作解决问题期间的隐式通信，而 L2-VMASintroduces a shared latent memory that supports implicit communication during collaborative problem solving, while L2-VMAS[yu2026dual]在代理之间交替感知和规划流，以在长期具体任务中保持一致的联合世界模型。alternates perceptual and planning streams across agents to maintain a coherent joint world model in long-horizon embodied tasks.

总结。Summary.交错计算通过允许模型在符号输出和潜在计算之间交替，将生成过程推广到同质令牌流之外。当某些中间步骤不需要用语言表达时，这种设计提高了效率；当生成必须在非文本模式下运行时，这种设计扩展了表征能力；当多个功能模块或代理在共享轨迹内交互时，这种设计能够实现更紧密的协调。总而言之，这些研究表明，交织不仅仅是一种解码策略，而且是组织将显式可解释性与隐式计算能力相结合的混合计算系统的一般原则。Interleaved computation generalises the generation process beyond a homogeneous token stream by allowing models to alternate between symbolic outputs and latent computations. This design improves efficiency when some intermediate steps need not be verbalised, expands representational capacity when generation must operate over non-textual modalities, and enables tighter coordination when multiple functional modules or agents interact within a shared trajectory. Taken together, these studies suggest that interleaving is not merely a decoding strategy, but a general principle for organising hybrid computation systems that combine explicit interpretability with implicit computational power.

4.4 优化Optimization

潜在空间优化通常发生在三个阶段：训练前、训练后和推理。这三个阶段的主要区别在于优化的内容：在训练前和训练后，优化的变量通常是模型参数Latent space optimization generally happens at three stages: pre-training, post-training, and inference. The three stages differ mainly in what is optimized: during pre-training and post-training, the optimized variable is typically model parametersθ∈𝒲\theta\in\mathcal{W}（或其子集）； 在推理过程中，模型参数大多是固定的（有时也经过训练），优化的变量是推理时状态，例如潜在表示(or a subset of them); during inference, the model parameters are mostly fixed (sometimes also be trained), and the optimized variable is instead an inference-time state, such as a latent representation𝐳∈ℋ\mathbf{z}\in\mathcal{H}或一代人的轨迹or a generation trajectory𝐫∈𝒱\mathbf{r}\in\mathcal{V}。 对于每个阶段，我们根据两个方面对方法进行分类：. For each stage, we categorize methods based on two aspects:监督supervision，指定提供学习信号的内容；, that specifies what provides the learning signal;目标objective，它捕获了每个损失分量背后的潜在优化目的。 根据底层计算操作，我们将现有方法分为三种代表性类型：, that captures the purpose behind each loss component for latent optimization. Based on underlying computational operations, we categorize existing methods into three representative types:

4.4.1 预训练Pre-training

在预训练阶段，During the pre-training stage,𝐳\mathbf{z}从头开始与基础模型联合训练，目标是从大规模预训练数据中学习模型参数is trained jointly with the base model from scratch, the objective is to learn model parameters from large-scale pre-training data𝒟\mathcal{D}。 形式上，优化变量是. Formally, the optimization variable isθ∈Φ\theta\in\Phi，目标可以写为：, and the objective can be written as:

θ⋆=arg⁡minθ∈Φ⁡𝔼(𝐱,𝐲)∼𝒟​[ℒ​(𝐱,𝐲,𝐳;Φθ)],\theta^{\star}=\arg\min_{\theta\in\Phi}\mathbb{E}_{(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})\sim\mathcal{D}}\left[\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y},\mathbf{z};\Phi_{\theta})\right], (20)

哪里whereθ∈Φ⊆𝒲\theta\in\Phi\subseteq\mathcal{W}表示预训练中可训练参数的集合，并且denotes the set of trainable parameters in pre-training, andℒ\mathcal{L}端到端地训练整个系统。trains the whole system end-to-end.

此阶段的优化主要依赖于已经为显式空间训练建立的简单、可扩展的监督，而不是需要人工注释或精细处理的更复杂的监督。为了稳定训练，设计了可选的辅助损失来调节潜在空间。总的来说，这些方法分为三类：Optimization at this stage mostly relies on simple, scalable supervision already well-established for explicit-space training, rather than more sophisticated supervision that requires human annotation or elaborate processing. To stabilize training, optional auxiliary losses are designed to regulate the latent space. In total, these methods fall into three types:自回归监督Autoregressive Supervision, 辅助监管Auxiliary Supervision, 和, and加固Reinforcement.

自回归监督预训练。Autoregressive Supervision Pre-Training.该类别侧重于将推理内化为下一个标记预测或循环循环的自然副产品，而无需显式匹配中间表示。实施基于雅可比迭代的并行训练，PonderLM-2This category focuses on internalizing reasoning as a natural byproduct of next-token prediction or recurrent looping, without explicitly matching intermediate representations. Implementing Jacobi-iteration-based parallel training, PonderLM-2[zeng2025pretraining]有效地计算递归潜在想法，而无需严格的因果阻塞。通过循环变压器层探索循环深度缩放，Looped Trans。efficiently computes recursive latent thoughts without strict causal blocking. Exploring recurrent depth scaling through looped transformer layers, Looped Trans.[saunshi2025reasoning]通过持续的潜在更新本机模拟复杂的推理。将循环语言模型扩展至 26 亿个参数，Ouronatively simulates complex reasoning via continuous latent updates. Scaling looped language models up to 2.6 billion parameters, Ouro[zhu2025scaling]利用熵正则化目标来进行一致的潜在推理。为了解决扩展效率问题，PHD-Trans。utilizes an entropy-regularized objective for consistent latent reasoning. To address scaling efficiency, PHD-Trans.[wu2025efficient]通过连续状态的动态探索来优化预测。为了在动态场景中保持稳定性，AL-CoToptimizes predictions via dynamic exploration of continuous states. To maintain stability in dynamic scenarios, AL-CoT[zeng2026pretraining]采用连续状态预测目标。employs continuous state prediction objectives.

辅助监督预培训。Auxiliary Supervision Pre-Training.这个方向通过辅助语义、对比学习或重建目标明确指导潜在空间几何的形成。通过交叉熵和重建损失优化连续语义概念，CoCoMixThis direction explicitly guides the formation of the latent space geometry through auxiliary semantics, contrastive learning, or reconstruction objectives. Optimizing continuous semantic concepts via cross-entropy and reconstruction losses, CoCoMix[jihoon2025llm]隐式指导多任务文本预测。结合 InfoNCE 和交叉熵，LARESimplicitly guides multi-task textual predictions. Incorporating InfoNCE and cross-entropy, LARES[liu2025lares]对齐潜在表示以进行顺序推荐。通过 VQ-VAE、LAPA 引入潜在动作预训练aligns latent representations for sequential recommendation. Introducing latent action pretraining via VQ-VAE, LAPA[ye2024lapa]直接从未注释的视频中学习离散的潜在动作。将视频中的视觉潜在空间与本体感受动作空间对齐，CLAPlearns discretized latent actions directly from unannotated videos. Aligning visual latent spaces from videos with proprioceptive action spaces, CLAP[zhang2026clap]利用对比预训练进行稳健的具体操作。绕过全视觉动态重建，JALAutilizes contrastive pretraining for robust embodied manipulation. Bypassing full visual dynamic reconstruction, JALA[jala2026joint]导出与逆动态和稀疏物理动作联合对齐的预测动作嵌入。关注均方误差和任务损失，CAREderives predictive action embeddings jointly aligned with inverse dynamics and sparse physical actions. Focusing on mean squared error and task losses, CARE[shi2026care]扩展具体操作的多任务预测。利用交叉熵和均方误差，ConceptLMscales multi-task prediction for embodied manipulation. Utilizing cross-entropy and mean squared error, ConceptLM[liu2026next]本地学习潜在表示以实现高效的多任务预测。learns latent representations natively for efficient multi-task prediction.

强化预训练。Reinforcement Pre-Training.该类别将奖励信号直接整合到基础预训练阶段，以主动塑造潜在思维轨迹。整合强化信号，LoopRPTThis category integrates reward signals directly into the foundational pre-training phase to actively shape latent thought trajectories. Integrating reinforcement signals, LoopRPT[tang2026looprpt]通过嘈杂的潜在推出将下一个令牌预测重新构建为推理任务，优化中间表示以从生命周期的一开始就将有效推理压缩为更少的迭代。reframes next-token prediction as a reasoning task via noisy latent rollouts, optimizing intermediate representations to compress effective reasoning into fewer iterations from the very beginning of the lifecycle.

总结。Summary.此阶段的方法在大规模训练期间将潜在推理能力直接嵌入到模型参数中，无需人工注释或精心监督。主要方法是对连续状态的自回归预测，其中循环或循环架构通过标准的下一个令牌目标自然地开发潜在推理。辅助损失起到正则化的作用，在不破坏可扩展性的情况下塑造潜在空间的几何形状。新生线程在预训练时引入强化信号，旨在在进行任何微调之前灌输有效的推理轨迹。Methods at this stage embed latent reasoning capacity directly into model parameters during large-scale training, foregoing the need for human annotation or elaborate supervision. The dominant approach is autoregressive prediction over continuous states, where looped or recurrent architectures naturally develop latent reasoning through standard next-token objectives. Auxiliary losses serve a regularizing role, shaping the geometry of the latent space without disrupting scalability. A nascent thread introduces reinforcement signals at pre-training time, aiming to instill efficient reasoning trajectories before any fine-tuning occurs.

4.4.2 培训后Post-training

在训练后阶段，During the post-training stage,𝐳\mathbf{z}通过对预训练模型进行微调进一步优化。 由于与训练前相比数据要求减少，训练后监督可以涉及更复杂的数据增强或专门的损失设计。 许多方法侧重于定义附加信号来监督潜在变量，因为仅对显式变量进行监督可能是不够的。 同样，优化的变量仍然是模型参数，但优化现在仅限于训练后目标：is further optimized via fine-tuning on a pre-trained model. Thanks to the reduced data requirements compared to pre-training, post-training supervision can involve more sophisticated data augmentation or specialized loss designs. Many methods focus on defining an additional signal to supervise the latent variable, as supervision on explicit variables alone may not be sufficient. Again, the optimized variable is still model parameters, but the optimization is now restricted to a post-training objective:

θ⋆=arg⁡minθ∈𝒲⁡𝔼(𝐱,𝐲)∼𝒟​[ℒ​(𝐱,𝐲,𝐳;Φθ)]−β​𝔼𝐫∼Φθ(⋅∣𝐱)​[R​(𝐱,𝐫,𝐳)],\theta^{\star}=\arg\min_{\theta\in\mathcal{W}}\mathbb{E}_{(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})\sim\mathcal{D}}\left[\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y},\mathbf{z};\Phi_{\theta})\right]-\beta\,\mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{r}\sim\Phi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid\mathbf{x})}\left[R(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{r},\mathbf{z})\right], (21)

其中公式包含监督微调、偏好优化和基于强化学习的对齐。 在潜在空间方法中，训练后通常专门研究如何诱导、控制潜在变量或与下游目标保持一致。根据监控信号的不同，可分为三种类型，包括：where the formulation subsumes supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement-learning-based alignment. In latent-space methods, post-training often specializes in refining how latent variables are induced, controlled, or aligned with downstream objectives. Based on the supervision signals, there are three types, including:明确的监督Explicit Supervision, 隐性监督Implicit Supervision, 和, and强化学习Reinforcement Learning.

显式监督微调。Explicit Supervision Fine-Tuning.该类别通过仅将损失函数应用于最终的人类可读输出来优化潜在推理，而不为连续表示提供逐步目标。通过特定任务损失来微调连续变量，LAPCThis category optimizes latent reasoning by applying loss functions solely to the final human-readable output, without providing step-by-step targets for the continuous representations. Fine-tuning continuous variables via specific task losses, LATPC[yi2026latentspace]增强了针对越狱攻击的安全性和鲁棒性。使用任务丢失对齐，GainRouterenhances safety and robustness against jailbreak attacks. Using task loss alignment, GainRouter[zheng2025fast]动态路由功能以实现快速和自适应的潜在推理。在学习的潜在流形上引导隐藏状态，GeoSteerdynamically routes features to enable fast and adaptive latent reasoning. Steering hidden states on a learned latent manifold, GeoSteer[kazama2025geosteer]确保推理轨迹忠实且逻辑一致。通过交叉熵和正则化微调模型，PILOTensures faithful and logically consistent reasoning trajectories. Fine-tuning models with cross-entropy and regularization, PILOT[zheng2026pilot]将大型模型的战略监督内化为内在的潜在指导。专注于下一个令牌预测和对齐，TSinternalizes the strategic oversight of large models into intrinsic latent guidance. Focusing on next-token prediction and alignment, TS[amos2026latent]利用交叉熵来简化潜在推理。utilizes cross-entropy to streamline latent reasoning.

隐式监督微调。Implicit Supervision Fine-Tuning.这种方法使用知识蒸馏、对比对齐或逐步重建信号为潜在表示提供了明确的黄金目标。This approach provides explicit gold targets for latent representations using knowledge distillation, contrastive alignment, or step-wise reconstruction signals.

基于蒸馏的方法将潜在状态锚定到教师提供的信号。点Distillation-based methods anchor latent states to teacher-provided signals. SPOT[chu2026spot]通过将显式推理轨迹锚定到相应的教师范围，将其压缩为紧凑的潜在标记，而 SemCoTcompresses explicit reasoning trajectories into compact latent tokens by anchoring them to corresponding teacher spans, while SemCoT[he2025semcot]将真实推理提炼为语义对齐的隐式标记以加速计算。潜在SFTdistills ground-truth reasoning into semantically aligned implicit tokens to accelerate computation. Latent-SFT[deng2025latent]采用不同的角度，将潜在标记重新定义为词汇空间叠加，并使用 KL 散度和交叉熵损失对其进行训练。takes a different angle, redefining latent tokens as vocabulary-space superpositions and training them with KL divergence and cross-entropy losses.

对比学习是另一种重要的技术。 LTA思想家Contrastive learning constitutes another prominent technique. LTA-Thinker[wang2025ltathinker]和 EPR 潜伏and EPR-Latent[wang2025efficient]采用对比目标分别优化潜在思维分布和细化中间表示，而 ReaRecemploy contrastive objectives to optimize latent thought distributions and refine intermediate representations, respectively, while ReaRec[tang2025think]将相同的原则应用于顺序推荐。循证医学CoTapplies the same principle to sequential recommendation. EBM-CoT[chen2025think1]进一步将对比信号与正则化相结合，以提高整体潜在推理效率。further combines contrastive signals with regularization to improve overall latent reasoning efficiency.

重建目标在多模式环境中尤其普遍，其中跨模式的协调需要明确的特征级监督。拉维特Reconstruction objectives are especially prevalent in multimodal settings, where aligning across modalities demands explicit feature-level supervision. LaViT[wu2026lavit]联合预测下一个标记并重建视觉特征以对齐跨模态推理和 RoTjointly predicts next tokens and reconstructs visual features to align cross-modal reasoning, and RoT[wang2026renderofthought]采用一种独特的方法，将思想链渲染为图像，并将 MSE 与交叉熵结合起来。法国国家邮政局takes a distinctive approach by rendering chain-of-thought as images and applying MSE together with cross-entropy. BNPO[li2026controlling]使用重建和任务损失来调整具体的行动空间。方法如 Mirageuses reconstruction and task losses to align embodied action spaces. Methods such as Mirage[yang2025machine], 3D思想家, 3DThinker[chen2025think]、VisMem, VisMem[yu2025vismem], 莫奈, Monet[wang2025monet]和 CogSense, and CogSense[li2026toward]进一步证明了这种范式在视觉想象、空间推理和泛化任务方面的广度。further demonstrate the breadth of this paradigm across visual imagination, spatial reasoning, and generalization tasks.

强化学习。Reinforcement Learning.为了减轻几何漂移，该子类别利用策略梯度、奖励和偏好信号来自主发现有效的潜在轨迹。To mitigate geometric drift, this sub-category leverages policy gradients, rewards, and preference signals to autonomously discover efficient latent trajectories.

自我奖励机制形成了一个重要的线索，其中模型本身提供训练信号而无需外部注释。拉特罗Self-rewarding mechanisms form one important thread, where the model itself provides the training signal without external annotation. LaTRO[chen2024language]将推理公式化为通过模型自身的概率估计和 I2B-LPO 优化的变分采样过程formulates reasoning as a variational sampling process optimized via the model’s own probability estimates, and I2B-LPO[deng2026iiblpo]采用具有自我奖励的迭代信息瓶颈来进行彻底的潜在政策探索。记忆基因employs an iterative information bottleneck with self-rewards for thorough latent policy exploration. MemGen[zhang2025memgen]同样依靠有针对性的自我奖励来增强泛化能力。similarly relies on targeted self-rewards to enhance generalization.

另一组方法引入了专门的正则化器来稳定或丰富优化环境。软T-GRPOA further set of methods introduces specialized regularizers to stabilize or enrich the optimization landscape. SofT-GRPO[zheng2025softgrpo]应用 Gumbel 重新参数化进行稳定组相对策略优化，GANPOapplies Gumbel reparameterization for stable group relative policy optimization, GANPO[jiang2026latent]引入对抗性正则化器来增强偏好优化，以及 DLRintroduces an adversarial regularizer to robustify preference optimization, and DLR[shan2026latentspace]将对比稳定性约束与奖励信号相结合，以进行定向潜在探索。人力资源办公室combines contrastive stability constraints with reward signals for directed latent exploration. HRPO[yue2025hybrid]采用混合方法，使用可学习的门逐步将连续隐藏状态与离散标记集成。科拉Rtakes a hybrid approach, using a learnable gate to progressively integrate continuous hidden states with discrete tokens. CoLaR[tan2025think],LWS, LWS[ning2025learning], 潜在R3, LatentR3[zhang2025reinforced]，和原因-IAD, and Reason-IAD[chen2026reason]通过将奖励驱动的优化应用于动态轨迹预测、顺序推荐和视觉空间理解来完善景观。 KL 散度正则化还可以作为许多方法中的循环稳定机制。拉雷斯round out the landscape by applying reward-driven optimization to dynamic trajectory prediction, sequential recommendation, and visual spatial understanding. KL divergence regularization also serves as a recurring stabilization mechanism across many methods. LARES[liu2025lares], RL-潜伏, RL-Latent[enes2025reinforcement],单片机, SCM[wang2025improving]和 ATP 潜伏, and ATP-Latent[zheng2026beyond]所有这些都将 KL 惩罚与奖励目标结合起来，以防止在潜在空间优化期间过度偏离参考策略。放松all incorporate KL penalties alongside reward objectives to prevent excessive deviation from the reference policy during latent space optimization. ReLaX[zhang2025relax]通过严格的奖励正则化和 RLTT 进一步解决过早收敛问题further addresses premature convergence through strict reward regularization, and RLTT[williams2026prioritize]在整个轨迹上分配奖励以改善一致性。distributes rewards across the full trajectory to improve alignment.

总结。Summary.与训练前相比，训练后在监督设计方面提供了更大的灵活性，能够提供更丰富的信号，例如蒸馏、对比对齐和基于奖励的反馈来细化潜在表示。这一阶段的一个核心紧张点是是否通过黄金目标明确地监督潜在变量，还是仅通过产出水平的任务损失隐式地监督潜在变量。强化学习方法更进一步，将潜在轨迹发现视为策略优化问题，允许模型在不依赖预定监督的情况下自主识别紧凑且高效的推理路径。Compared to pre-training, post-training affords greater flexibility in supervision design, enabling richer signals such as distillation, contrastive alignment, and reward-based feedback to refine latent representations. A central tension in this stage is whether to supervise latent variables explicitly through gold targets or implicitly through output-level task losses alone. Reinforcement learning methods go further by treating latent trajectory discovery as a policy optimization problem, allowing models to autonomously identify compact and efficient reasoning paths without relying on predetermined supervision.

4.4.3 推理Inference

对于推理时间潜在优化，模型权重For inference-time latent optimization, the model weightsθ\theta通常被冻结（也可以被训练）和潜在状态are usually frozen (also could be trained) and the latent states𝐳\mathbf{z}在测试时直接操作。 与训练前和训练后不同，推理时间方法处理are directly manipulated at test time. Unlike pre-training and post-training, inference-time methods treat𝐳\mathbf{z}本身作为优化变量。 正式地，让itself as the optimization variable. Formally, letθ\theta表示训练后的参数，则优化后的变量变为denote the trained parameters, then the optimized variable becomesω\omega，与：, with:

𝐳⋆=arg⁡minω∈Ω⁡𝒥​(𝐳;𝐱,Φθ).\mathbf{z}^{\star}=\arg\min_{\omega\in\Omega}\mathcal{J}\!\left(\mathbf{z};\mathbf{x},\Phi_{\theta}\right). (22)

哪里whereΩ\Omega是变量的可行域，并且is the feasible region of the variable, and𝒥\mathcal{J}是推理时间目标，然后根据优化的推理时间状态生成最终输出。该部分包括is the inference-time objective, final output is then generated conditioned on the optimized inference-time state. The part includes缩放Scaling, 调音Tuning, 和, and指导Guidance.

推理缩放。Inference Scaling.该类别侧重于通过生成多个候选轨迹并采用基于奖励的启发式方法来识别最佳推理路径来探索潜在空间。采用连续空间分类器作为潜在奖励模型，LTOThis category focuses on exploring the latent space by generating multiple candidate trajectories and employing reward-based heuristics to identify the optimal reasoning path. Employing a continuous-space classifier as a latent reward model, LTO[du2025latent]在推理过程中积极修剪不正确的思维模式。执行多方面信息的潜在前瞻搜索，TGRaggressively prunes incorrect thinking patterns during inference. Performing manifold-informed latent foresight search, TGR[zhuang2026geometric]对候选潜在锚点进行评分，以鼓励平滑的轨迹和多样化的长期探索。将潜在探索重新表述为连续思维表征上的条件采样，GTSscores candidate latent anchors to encourage smooth trajectories and diverse long-horizon exploration. Reformulating latent exploration as conditional sampling over continuous thought representations, GTS[wang2026gts]利用高斯思维采样器来预测上下文相关的扰动分布。应用自我奖励采样，LatentSeekutilizes a Gaussian Thought Sampler to predict context-dependent perturbation distributions. Applying self-reward sampling, LatentSeek[li2025latentseek]有效缓解连续生成过程中的灾难性遗忘。采用自我奖励，SReffectively alleviates catastrophic forgetting during continuous generation. Employing self-rewards, SR[zhu2025soft]采样并调整软推理探索以最大限度地提高效率。利用潜在语义空间，LatentPromptsamples and aligns soft reasoning explorations to maximize efficiency. Leveraging the latent semantic space, LatentPrompt[bystronski2025latentprompt]通过内在的自我奖励自动评估和优化提示。利用 KL 散度和任务损失，ITRautomatically evaluates and optimizes prompts via intrinsic self-rewards. Utilizing KL divergence and task losses, ITR[kong2026inference]指导推理时采样，大幅提升复杂推理效率。增强视觉理解和基础，DMLRguides inference-time sampling to greatly improve complex reasoning efficiency. Enhancing visual understanding and grounding, DMLR[liu2025reason]实施连续的自我奖励采样和对齐。implements continuous self-reward sampling and alignment.

推理调整。Inference Tuning.这种方法从试错随机搜索转变为在前向传播过程中直接对潜在变量或策略执行连续的、基于梯度的优化。动态优化中间潜在思维向量，LTPOThis approach shifts from trial-and-error stochastic search to continuous, gradient-based optimization executed directly on the latent variables or policy during the forward pass. Optimizing intermediate latent thought vectors on the fly, LTPO[ye2025thinking]利用由内在的基于信任的奖励引导的在线策略梯度方法。在令牌 logits 上集成可微分优化，utilizes an online policy gradient method guided by an intrinsic confidence-based reward. Integrating differentiable optimization over token logits,∇\nabla-推理者-Reasoner[wang2026nabla]通过连续样本空间中的梯度下降直接在解码循环中细化策略。结合自我奖励和重建损失，LatentEvolverefines the policy directly within the decoding loop via gradient descent in the continuous sample space. Combining self-reward and reconstruction losses, LatentEvolve[zhang2025latentevolve]通过测试时间缩放动态采样和微调实验内存状态。dynamically samples and fine-tunes experimental memory states through test-time scaling.

推理指导。Inference Guidance.该类别应用有针对性的结构约束、对比逻辑或稀疏干预来动态引导潜在表征并防止幻觉。通过稀疏干预来引导内部激活，REVISThis category applies targeted structural constraints, contrastive logic, or sparse interventions to dynamically guide latent representations and prevent hallucinations. Steering internal activations via sparse interventions, REVIS[wu2026revis]通过提取纯视觉信息向量来减轻大型视觉语言模型中的物体幻觉。内化对比学习和自我奖励，STIRmitigates object hallucination in large vision-language models by extracting pure visual information vectors. Internalizing contrastive learning and self-rewards, STIR[shi2026internalizing]引入了价值调制轨迹干预，通过基于锚的门控动态注入上下文特定的脉冲。通过专门的初始代币 SoftCoT++ 扰乱潜在想法introduces a value-modulated trajectory intervention that dynamically injects context-specific impulses via anchor-based gating. Perturbing latent thoughts via specialized initial tokens, SoftCoT++[xu2025softcot1]使用对比学习来增强软表示之间的多样性。在推理时利用对比学习，VTIuses contrastive learning to enforce diversity among soft representations. Utilizing contrastive learning at inference time, VTI[liu2025reducing]成功减轻了大规模视觉模型中的幻觉。测试时对比视觉特征，L2V-CoTsuccessfully mitigates hallucinations in massive visual models. Contrasting visual features at test time, L2V-CoT[zhan2025l2vcot]通过潜在的干预将转移能力和视觉推理能力紧密结合起来。动态预防幻视，Control++tightly aligns transferring and visual reasoning capabilities through latent intervention. Preventing visual hallucinations dynamically, Control++[wu2026test]在对齐生成过程中应用高度针对性的任务损失。applies highly targeted task losses during the alignment generation process.

总结。Summary.与参数级优化不同，推理时间方法将潜在状态本身视为优化变量，同时保持模型权重固定。方法之间的关键区别在于搜索策略：缩放方法通过奖励引导的轨迹选择随机探索潜在空间，优化方法在解码过程中直接将梯度更新应用于潜在变量，引导方法施加结构或对比约束来即时纠正潜在表示，特别是抑制幻觉。Unlike parameter-level optimization, inference-time methods treat latent states themselves as the optimization variable while keeping model weights fixed. The key distinction among approaches lies in the search strategy: scaling methods explore the latent space stochastically through reward-guided trajectory selection, optimization methods apply gradient updates directly to latent variables during decoding, and guidance methods impose structural or contrastive constraints to correct latent representations on the fly, particularly to suppress hallucinations.

5 能力：潜在空间能带来什么？Ability: What Does Latent Space Enable?

潜在空间作为大型模型中的机器本机表示基底，解锁了一系列超越显式令牌级处理边界的新兴功能。 在本节中，我们从七个维度系统地研究这些功能：The latent space, as a machine-native representational substrate within large models, unlocks a spectrum of emergent capabilities that transcend the boundaries of explicit token-level processing. In this section, we systematically examine these capabilities along seven dimensions:推理Reasoning（节(Section5.1)涉及通过连续内部状态进行演绎和关系计算的能力；) concerns the ability to carry out deduction and relational computation through continuous internal states;规划Planning（节(Section5.2) 强调解决方案轨迹的前瞻性组织、资源分配和多步骤决策；) emphasizes the prospective organization of solution trajectories, resource allocation, and multi-step decision-making;造型Modeling（节(Section5.3）重点关注潜在表征本身的表征、可解释性、可控性和可扩展深度；) focuses on the characterization, interpretability, controllability, and scalable depth of latent representations themselves;感知Perception（节(Section5.4）使模型能够保存和操纵丰富的空间结构化信息，以实现更忠实的视觉理解；) enables models to preserve and manipulate rich, spatially structured information for more faithful visual understanding;内存Memory（节(Section5.5）支持跨环境的紧凑、持久和适应性知识保留；) supports compact, persistent, and adaptive knowledge retention across contexts;协作Collaboration（节(Section5.6）允许多个代理直接通过潜在通道而不是单独的离散语言交换语义内容；和) allows multiple agents to exchange semantic content directly through latent channels rather than discrete language alone; and具体实施方式Embodiment（节(Section5.7）将潜在计算扩展到物理交互，支持扎根行动、预测性远见、空间想象以及跨异构体的传输。 如图所示) extends latent computation into physical interaction, supporting grounded action, predictive foresight, spatial imagination, and transfer across heterogeneous bodies. As depicted in Figure8，每个维度都反映了潜在表征独特赋予的智能的独特方面，从内部逻辑推论到与环境的物理交互。, each dimension reflects a distinct facet of intelligence that latent representations uniquely empower, ranging from internal logical deduction to physical interaction with the environment.

5.1 推理Reasoning

潜在空间中的推理是指大型模型通过内部连续表示而不是通过明确的逐个标记语言化来执行逻辑演绎、关系计算和结论生成的能力。 从显式 CoT 推理的转变Reasoning in latent space refers to the capacity of large models to perform logical deduction, relational computation, and conclusion generation through internal continuous representations rather than through explicit token-by-token verbalization. The shift from explicit CoT reasoning[wei2022chain]潜在推理代表了一种根本性的范式变化：模型不再用自然语言阐明每个中间步骤，而是学会在连续的、高维的潜在流形中思考to latent reasoning represents a fundamental paradigm change: instead of articulating every intermediate step in natural language, models learn to think within a continuous, high-dimensional latent manifold[hao2024training, zhu2025reasoning].

这种范式在计算效率、表示能力以及同时编码多个推理路径的叠加的能力方面提供了巨大的优势。我们按照六种能力来组织这个快速扩张的景观：This paradigm offers substantial advantages in computational efficiency, representational capacity, and the ability to encode superpositions of multiple reasoning paths simultaneously. We organize this rapidly expanding landscape along six abilities:隐式推理Implicit Inference没有完整的言语表达，without full verbalization,紧凑跟踪Compact Trace将长链压缩成紧凑的状态，that condenses long chains into compact states,持续改进Continuous Refinement以潜在形式维持和修正思想，that sustains and revises thought in latent form,分支路径Branching Path多名候选人，以及over multiple candidates, and模态泛化Modal Generalization超越纯文本设置。beyond text-only settings.

隐式推理。Implicit Inference.将推理转移到潜在空间的一个核心动机是，越来越多的证据表明，显式 CoT 虽然可以解释，但往往是多余的，并且从根本上受到语言离散、顺序性质的限制。来自 CoT 压缩的汇聚证据A central motivation for moving reasoning into latent space is the growing evidence that explicit CoT, while interpretable, is often redundant and fundamentally constrained by the discrete, sequential nature of language. Converging evidence from CoT compression[liu2024expediting, zhang2024uncovering], 隐性能力启发, implicit capability elicitation[chen2024language, implicit2025li]和潜在的自我评价, and latent self-evaluation[wang2025latent]表明类似推理的行为已经基本上编码在预训练模型的连续激活空间中。 进一步的分析将潜在推理确立为一种独特的计算模式，包含更丰富的非顺序推理shows that reasoning-like behavior is already substantially encoded in the continuous activation spaces of pretrained models. Further analyses establish latent reasoning as a distinct computational mode encompassing richer, non-sequential inference[he2026reasoning, reasoning2025chen]，共同挑战推理必须以代币形式化的假设。 基于这些见解，COCONUT, collectively challenging the assumption that reasoning must be externalized in tokens. Building on these insights, COCONUT[hao2024training]证明连续思维向量可以编码多个推理路径的叠加，从而实现紧急的广度优先搜索，并表明模型可以在投入语言之前进行内部推理。demonstrated that continuous thought vectors can encode superpositions of multiple reasoning paths, enabling emergent breadth-first search and showing that models can infer internally before committing to language.
