紧凑跟踪。Compact Trace.潜在空间释放的一项主要能力是将显式 CoT 压缩为更紧凑的内部状态，而不会失去其解决问题的价值。 广泛的监督和培训后研究One major ability unlocked by latent space is compressing explicit CoT into far more compact internal states without losing its problem-solving value. A broad range of supervision and post-training studies[cheng2024compressed, shen2025codi, wei2025simcot, he2025semcot, wang2025efficient, shen2025efficient, zheng2025fast]表明长推理痕迹可以被吸收到紧凑的潜在状态中，同时保留其大部分功能价值。 这一证据表明，已经训练好的模型只需适度的额外开销即可获得压缩推理能力。 集体证据表明，推理链可以以更紧凑的数量级表示形式保存，揭示了令牌级推理中的基本冗余。shows that long reasoning traces can be absorbed into compact latent states while preserving much of their functional value. This evidence suggests that already-trained models can acquire compressed reasoning ability with only modest additional overhead. The collective evidence indicates that reasoning chains can be preserved in representations orders of magnitude more compact, revealing fundamental redundancy in token-level reasoning.

持续改进。Continuous Refinement.除了压缩现有的 CoT 之外，潜在空间还支持将思想维持、混合和迭代修改为连续状态的能力。 软令牌方法Beyond compressing existing CoT, latent space also supports the ability to sustain, blend, and iteratively revise thought as a continuous state. Soft token methods[zhang2025soft, xu2025softcot, wang2025improving]用概率加权嵌入混合或学习的概念级混合替换离散采样，同时通过扩散进行随机细化replace discrete sampling with probability-weighted embedding mixtures or learned concept-level blending, while stochastic refinement through diffusion[kang2025ladir]和马尔可夫动力学and Markov dynamics[liu2025marcos]能够修改先前的推理决策。 基于能源的一致性执行enables revision of earlier reasoning decisions. Energy-based consistency enforcement[chen2025think1]词汇空间叠加及其理论分析and theoretical analyses of vocabulary-space superposition[deng2025latent, gozeten2025continuous]进一步表明，这种潜在状态可以保持一致性，同时仍然适合同时优化。 思维增强和情境化further show that such latent states can preserve coherence while remaining amenable to simultaneous optimization. Thought augmentation and contextualization[wang2025ltathinker, liu2026latent, sun2025enhancing, ruan2025reasoning, long2025reasoning]通过融合任务相关知识和背景知识并通过有针对性的干预措施调整推理来丰富这种细化能力。enrich this refinement ability by fusing task-relevant and background knowledge and modulating reasoning through targeted interventions.

分支路径。Branching Path.潜在空间的连续性质实现了全新的推理拓扑，使模型可以同时探索多个候选轨迹。 并行潜在推理The continuous nature of latent space enables fundamentally new reasoning topologies that let models explore several candidate trajectories at once. Parallel latent reasoning[xu2025softcot1, liu2025thoughtbubbles, you2025parallel, wu25parallel]演示通过软路径采样、随机宽度和雅可比迭代进行同步搜索，从而在保持质量的同时减少挂钟延迟。 混合潜显系统demonstrates simultaneous search through soft path sampling, stochastic width, and Jacobi iteration, reducing wall-clock latency while maintaining quality. Hybrid latent-explicit systems[piao2025spiralthinker, su2025token, shi2025swireasoning, xu2026thinkrouter]进一步表明，模型可以在有利的情况下在紧凑的内部搜索和选择性的外部化之间灵活地交替。 双系统编排研究further suggest that models can flexibly alternate between compact internal search and selective externalization when beneficial. Studies of dual-system orchestration[codaforno2025exploring]强化了这一观点，表明强大的推理者受益于协调多个推理路径和模式，而不是致力于单个线性轨迹。reinforce this view, indicating that strong reasoners benefit from coordinating multiple reasoning paths and modes rather than committing to a single linear trace.

模态泛化。Modal Generalization.潜在推理成熟度的一个关键指标是其超越纯文本设置的泛化能力。 与模态无关的连续思维A key indicator of the maturity of latent reasoning is its ability to generalize beyond text-only settings. Modality-agnostic continuous thought[pham2025multimodal, ray2025mulltokens]证明潜在推理范式适用于语言、视觉和异构基质，而跨模式转移和效率技术demonstrates that the latent reasoning paradigm applies across linguistic, visual, and heterogeneous substrates, while cross-modal transfer and efficiency techniques[zhan2025l2vcot, shao2026learning, wang2026renderofthought, lv2026onelatent]表明这种能力可以随着紧凑性的增加而跨模式移动。 我们将视觉潜在推理的详细处理推迟到感知小节（第show that this capability can move across modalities with increasing compactness. We defer detailed treatment of visual latent reasoning to the Perception subsection (Section5.4).

超越视觉，跨越化学合成的特定领域应用Beyond vision, domain-specific applications spanning chemical synthesis[armstrong2025synthstrategy], 叙事生成, narrative generation[gurung2025lightweight],新奇发现, novelty discovery[bystronski2025large]，以及联合嵌入预测, and joint-embedding prediction[liu2025jepareasoner]展现出广泛的适用性。 结构化时空推理demonstrate broad applicability. Structured spatial-temporal reasoning[xue2025reasoning, vilas2025tracing]将这种概括扩展到几何和时间域，同时进行忠实性和可控性研究extends this generalization to geometric and temporal domains, while faithfulness and controllability studies[lukas2025activationreasoning, zhang2026silence, ye2026riser, wang2026regular]表明潜在推理在跨设置时可以保持可靠。show that latent reasoning can remain reliable as it moves across settings.

5.2 规划Planning

规划涉及通过解决方案景观寻找最佳轨迹，其中潜在流形的连续、可微性质允许基于梯度的策略优化和迭代轨迹细化。 与推理不同，推理侧重于给定上下文中的逻辑演绎，规划强调计算的预期组织，确定在哪里分配资源，如何探索解决方案空间以及何时终止搜索Planning concerns the search for optimal trajectories through the solution landscape, where the continuous, differentiable nature of the latent manifold admits gradient-based policy optimization and iterative trajectory refinement. Unlike reasoning, which focuses on logical deduction within a given context, planning emphasizes the prospective organization of computation, determining where to allocate resources, how to explore the solution space, and when to terminate search[wang2026latent, xu2026no]。 我们通过四种能力来检查潜在计划：. We examine latent planning through four abilities:可控探索Controllable Exploration通过内部解决方案路径，over internal solution paths,搜索效率Search Efficiency在导航潜在流形时，in navigating the latent manifold,自适应预算Adaptive Budget将计算与难度相匹配的分配，以及allocation that matches compute to difficulty, and顺序决策Sequential Decision在下游交互任务中。in downstream interactive tasks.

可控探索。Controllable Exploration.潜在规划的核心能力是控制内部解决方案轨迹，而不是仅仅贪婪地生成下一个令牌。 基于强化学习的轨迹优化A central ability in latent planning is controlling internal solution trajectories rather than merely generating the next token greedily. RL-based trajectory optimization[du2025latent, yue2025hybrid, zheng2025softgrpo, ye2025thinking]表明连续思维表示可以通过策略梯度、Gumbel 重新参数化和测试时间细化直接改进。 培训稳定性和多样性仍然是积极的挑战，可通过预防勘探塌方来解决shows that continuous thought representations can be directly improved via policy gradients, Gumbel reparameterization, and test-time refinement. Training stability and diversity remain active challenges, addressed through exploration collapse prevention[deng2026iiblpo]、系统设计分析, systematic design analysis[enes2025reinforcement]，以及对比奖励塑造, and contrastive reward shaping[shan2026latentspace]。 这些工作共同证明，潜在几何能够实现有意的轨迹改进，这在离散令牌空间中从根本上来说是困难的。. These works collectively establish that latent geometry enables deliberate trajectory improvement that is fundamentally difficult in discrete token space.

高效搜索。Efficient Search.潜在流形提供了一个天然的基底，可以利用几何平滑性和连续性来实现有效的导航。 探索恢复和轨迹多样化The latent manifold provides a natural substrate where geometric smoothness and continuity can be exploited for efficient navigation. Exploration restoration and trajectory diversification[zhang2025relax, xiaomi2026led, zhu2025soft]通过熵利用、潜在解码和受控嵌入探索来保持推理多样性，同时几何引导搜索maintain reasoning variety through entropy exploitation, latent decoding, and controlled embedding exploration, while geometry-guided search[li2025latentseek, zhuang2026geometric, shi2026internalizing]利用内在的流形属性进行实例级定位和长上下文预见。leverages intrinsic manifold properties for instance-level targeting and long-context foresight.

自适应预算。Adaptive Budget.潜在规划的一个定义特征是动态的、依赖于输入的资源分配。 自适应深度和地平线确定A defining characteristic of latent planning is dynamic, input-dependent resource allocation. Adaptive depth and horizon determination[he2025learning, ning2025learning, wang2026latent, zheng2026beyond]通过实例级引导、基于 RL 的停止、动态终止和主动预算确定来调整推理深度，并根据问题复杂性按比例投入计算。adjusts reasoning depth through instance-level steering, RL-based stopping, dynamic termination, and active budget determination, investing computation proportionally to problem complexity.

顺序决策。Sequential Decision.潜在规划已被有效地部署在顺序决策领域，其中用户行为或系统状态的时间结构自然地映射到潜在空间中的轨迹优化。在推荐、检索和跨域适应中Latent planning has been productively deployed in sequential decision-making domains, where the temporal structure of user behavior or system states naturally maps onto trajectory optimization in latent space.In recommendation, retrieval,and cross-domain adaptation[tan2025think, liu2025lares, zhang2025reinforced, tang2026parallel, guo2026s2gr, zhang2026reasoning, shi2025bridging, wang2025decoding]，潜在规划改善了顺序 随着时间的推移，通过维护和完善内部轨迹来进行预测、重新排名和转移。在多步骤规划和工具使用中, latent planning improves sequential prediction, re-ranking, and transfer by maintaining and refining internal trajectories over time. In multi-step planning and tool use[wu2025ctrls, chen2025iclp, zhu2026colt, zheng2026pilot, li2026controlling, zeng2026latent]，它支持持续状态跟踪、中间决策优化以及对多模式代理的更严格控制，并进一步扩展到重新参数化动作空间本身——将循环低熵支架压缩为紧凑的潜在动作单元，以直接减少有效决策范围，同时保留可执行性。这些应用程序的广度涵盖推荐系统、信息检索、工具使用、动作表示学习和对话式人工智能，将潜在规划建立为一种多功能范式，远远超出了传统推理基准的范围。, it supports sustained state tracking, optimization over intermediate decisions, and tighter control of multimodal agents, and further extends to reparameterizing the action space itself—compressing recurrent low-entropy scaffolds into compact latent action units to directly reduce the effective decision horizon while preserving executability. The breadth of these applications, spanning recommendation systems, information retrieval, tool use, action representation learning, and conversational AI, establishes latent planning as a versatile paradigm that extends well beyond the scope of traditional reasoning benchmarks.

5.3 造型Modeling

建模包括在大型语言模型中表征、检查和塑造潜在表示的能力。 推理和规划关注模型在潜在空间中计算什么，而建模则关注哪些潜在表示让我们理解和控制计算本身。我们将这个维度分为四种能力：Modeling encompasses the ability to characterize, inspect, and shape latent representations within large language models. While reasoning and planning concern what models compute in latent space, modeling focuses on what latent representations let us understand and control about the computation itself. We structure this dimension into four abilities:丰富的表达Rich Expression编码复杂的计算，to encode complex computation,自检Self Inspection这使得内部状态可以分析，that makes internal states analyzable,鲁棒控制Robust Control过度危险或不稳定的行为，以及over risky or unstable behavior, and可扩展计算Scalable Computation通过潜在复发扩大容量。that expands capacity through latent recurrence.

丰富的表达。Rich Expression.严格的分析越来越表明，潜在空间支持比显式仅令牌推理更丰富的计算能力。 表现力分析Rigorous analysis increasingly shows that latent space supports a richer computational capacity than explicit token-only reasoning. Expressiveness analyses[zhu2025reasoning, xu2025formal]证明连续思维向量同时编码多个搜索前沿，并可证明比 CoT 具有更高的表达能力，而可监控性分析prove that continuous thought vectors encode multiple search frontiers simultaneously and achieve provably greater expressiveness than CoT, while monitorability analysis[korbak2025chain]揭示了效率和可解释性之间的相关权衡。 基本限制结果reveals the associated trade-offs between efficiency and interpretability. Fundamental limitation results[zou2026capabilities, sahoo2026shallow]表明探索和执行不能在固定预算内同时优化，并且在某些条件下推理深度与正确性相关性较弱。 认知和特定领域框架show that exploration and execution cannot be simultaneously optimized within fixed budgets, and that reasoning depth correlates weakly with correctness under certain conditions. Cognitive and domain-specific frameworks[hu2024understanding, sharma2025analyzing]将推理框架视为跨表示空间的转换，将见解从神经科学扩展到程序理解，共同澄清潜在推理的力量和界限。frame reasoning as transitions across representation spaces, extending insights from neuroscience to program understanding, together clarifying both the power and the boundaries of latent reasoning.

自检。Self Inspection.理解潜在推理的内部动态至关重要，因为潜在空间越来越支持直接检查模型所代表的内容以及这些状态如何演变。 有效性探测Understanding the internal dynamics of latent reasoning is critical because latent space increasingly supports direct inspection of what the model is representing and how those states evolve. Validity probing[zhang2025do, liang2026do]检查潜在标记是否编码真正的推理或利用工件，以及模型是否真正逐步推理或开发质量不同的策略。 透明度和可视化方法examines whether latent tokens encode genuine reasoning or exploit artifacts and whether models truly reason step-by-step or develop qualitatively different strategies. Transparency and visualization methods[chen2025latent, ning2025visualizing, liu2026unicog]通过潜在辩论、几何可视化、极性感知探测和认知分析使内部表征变得可解释。 表示层分析make internal representations interpretable through latent debate, geometry visualization, polarity-aware probing, and cognitive analysis. Representation-level analysis[giorgos2025language, reichman2025emotions]展示信息保存并揭示任务表现之外的丰富语义维度，而信息流研究demonstrates information preservation and reveals rich semantic dimensions beyond task performance, while information flow studies[liu2026layerorder, wezuke2025transfer]揭示多跳推理路径和跨语言转换机制。 实用转向uncover multi-hop reasoning paths and cross-lingual transition mechanisms. Practical steering[kazama2025geosteer, kamai2026talking]进一步表明，检查不仅仅是描述性的，而且可以直接支持有针对性的改进。further suggests that inspection is not merely descriptive, but can directly support targeted improvements.

稳健的控制。Robust Control.潜在空间为模型安全提供了强大但双刃剑的杠杆，因为能够实现强大性能的相同表示也可以用于攻击和防御。 一方面，攻击向量Latent space provides a powerful but double-edged lever for model safety, because the same representations that enable strong performance can also be manipulated for both attack and defense. On the one hand, attack vectors[xing2025latent, mura2025latentbreak]利用潜在融合和基于反馈的梯度，以及嵌入潜在 CoT 中的后门触发器。 另一方面，分层防御机制exploit latent fusion and feedback-based gradients, alongside backdoor triggers embedded in latent CoT. On the other hand, layered defense mechanisms[shu2025latentguard, yi2026latentspace, yang2025lfsteering, li2025kelp]提供可控转向、对抗训练、特征激活转向和流式风险检测。 培训阶段安全provide controllable steering, adversarial training, feature activation steering, and streaming risk detection. Training-phase safety[jiang2026latent, tang2026from, ball2025human]解决了对抗性正则化、对比遗忘和人类偏好建模问题，强调了强大的潜在控制对于构建安全系统至关重要。addresses adversarial regularization, contrastive unlearning, and human preference modeling, underscoring that robust latent control is essential for building safe systems.

可扩展计算。Scalable Computation.建模还强调了潜在系统扩展有效深度和容量而不按比例扩展显式代币生成的能力。 形式表达结果Modeling also highlights the ability of latent systems to expand effective depth and capacity without proportionally expanding explicit token generation. Formal expressiveness results[saunshi2025reasoning]确认具有潜在迭代的循环变压器比前馈对应物表达严格更复杂的计算。 循环块缩放confirm that looped transformers with latent iterations express strictly more complex computations than feedforward counterparts. Recurrent-block scaling[jonas2025scaling, zhu2025scaling, koishekenov2025encode, altabaa2025unlocking]迭代测试时计算的共享块，扩展循环预训练，引入编码-思考-解码架构，并演示分布外泛化。 渐进式细化和架构变体iterates shared blocks for test-time compute, scales looped pretraining, introduces encode-think-decode architectures, and demonstrates out-of-distribution generalization. Progressive refinement and architectural variants[lu2025latent, knupp2026depthrecurrent, jeddi2026loopformer, yu2026spiralformer]通过深度循环注意力、弹性深度和多分辨率递归来扩展这种灵活性。 自适应深度分配extend this flexibility through depth-recurrent attention, elastic depth, and multi-resolution recursion. Adaptive depth allocation[fu2025tah, wang2025system, li2026ponderlm, song2026adaponderlm]通过选择性迭代、双进程路由和 token-wise 思考进一步实现动态计算。further enables dynamic computation through selective iteration, dual-process routing, and token-wise pondering.

超越重复、概念层面和效率创新Beyond recurrence, concept-level and efficiency innovations[qu2025dynamic, liu2026multi]在自适应语义边界上操作并实现 KV 缓存效率，同时表示级设计operate on adaptive semantic boundaries and achieve KV cache efficiency, while representation-level design[bystronski2025latentprompt, wu2025efficient, wang2025decoding, qiu2025latent]绕过即时优化、预训练扩展和部署系统效率方面的离散瓶颈。bypasses discrete bottlenecks in prompt optimization, pretraining scaling, and deployed system efficiency.

5.4 感知Perception

潜在空间感知解决了使大型模型（尤其是 VLM）能够理解、表示和处理连续、高保真潜在空间中的视觉信息的基本挑战。 当前的 VLM 仍然面临一个关键瓶颈：将丰富的视觉内容转换为离散的文本标记不可避免地会丢弃空间结构、细粒度细节和关系几何Perception in latent space addresses the fundamental challenge of enabling large models, particularly VLMs, to understand, represent, and process visual information in continuous, high-fidelity latent spaces. Current VLMs still face a critical bottleneck: converting rich visual content into discrete text tokens inevitably discards spatial structure, fine-grained detail, and relational geometry[perception2025bigverdi, li2025latent]。 潜在感知通过保留离散标记化必然破坏的密集的空间结构信息克服了这一限制，使模型能够利用人类感知的丰富性和细微差别来推理视觉内容。 我们将潜在感知组织成三种逐渐加深的能力：. Latent perception overcomes this limitation by preserving dense, spatially-structured information that discrete tokenization necessarily destroys, enabling models to reason about visual content with the richness and nuance of human perception. We organize latent perception into three progressively deeper abilities:多模态推理Multimodal Inference超越内部视觉表征，over internal visual representations,启发式想象力Heuristic Imagination用于生成操作和 3D 理解，以及for generative manipulation and 3D understanding, and忠实接地气Faithful Grounding通过代表性层面的干预来提高输出的可信度。that improves output faithfulness through representation-level intervention.

多模态推理。Multimodal Inference.主要推动力是使 VLM 能够通过内部潜在表示而不是文本介导的描述来推理视觉内容。 基础潜在视觉推理A primary thrust is enabling VLMs to reason about visual content through internal latent representations rather than text-mediated descriptions. Foundational latent visual reasoning[li2025latent, wang2025monet]证明了与文本一起生成和更新潜在视觉状态可以实现仅通过文本推理无法实现的细粒度视觉理解。 后续工作demonstrated that generating and updating latent visual states alongside text enables fine-grained visual understanding unattainable through text-only reasoning. Follow-up work[sun2025latent, dong2025interleaved, li2025latent1, wang2026forest, chen2025vljepa]表明这种视觉推理能力可以通过选择性计算、从粗到精的处理和联合嵌入预测而保持准确和高效，而无需像素级重建。 多模式协调和调整研究shows that this visual inference ability can remain both accurate and efficient through selective computation, coarse-to-fine processing, and joint embedding prediction without pixel-level reconstruction. Multimodal coordination and alignment studies[chen2025reasoning, liu2025reason, jeon2026vision, zhang2026multimodal, li2026toward, yang2026crystal, serussi2026pregen, wu2026revis]进一步表明，结构化视觉潜伏可以丰富、稳定并推广到时域。further show that structured visual latents can be enriched, stabilized, and generalized to temporal domains.

启发式想象力。Heuristic Imagination.潜在感知还使 VLM 能够执行视觉启发式想象，生成和操纵内部视觉表征作为推理过程的一部分，类似于人类心理意象。 此功能对于需要空间推理、3D 理解或视觉规划而无法用文本充分表达的任务非常有价值。 内在视觉想象Latent perception also enables VLMs to perform visual heuristic imagination, generating and manipulating internal visual representations as part of the reasoning process, analogous to human mental imagery. This capability is valuable for tasks requiring spatial reasoning, 3D understanding, or visual planning that cannot be adequately expressed in text. Internal visual imagination[yang2025machine, chen2025think]增强潜在操作能力，并将 VLM 功能与 3D 基础模型结合起来，同时视觉暂存器empower latent manipulation and align VLM features with 3D foundation models, while visual scratchpads[zhang2025latentsketchpad, tong2025sketchinlatents, qin2025chainofvisualthought]引入草图机制，通过连续的视觉标记捕获密集的空间和几何信息。 感知保真度保持introduce sketching mechanisms that capture dense spatial and geometric information through continuous visual tokens. Perceptual fidelity preservation[wu2026lavit, ma2025multimodal]确保潜在的视觉表征在蒸馏过程中保持保真度，并动态地跨模态间隙重新集中注意力。ensures that latent visual representations maintain fidelity during distillation and dynamically refocuses attention across modality gaps.

忠实接地气。Faithful Grounding.潜在感知的一个关键应用是通过在表征层面进行干预来提高 VLM 输出的可信度，解决普遍存在的幻觉问题。 通过潜在转向和架构对齐减轻幻觉A critical application of latent perception is improving the faithfulness of VLM outputs by intervening at the representation level, addressing the pervasive problem of hallucination. Hallucination mitigation via latent steering and architectural alignment[liu2025reducing, ahmed2025alignvlm]纠正视觉文本错位并解决根本原因，同时感知基础标记corrects visual-textual misalignments and addresses root causes, while perceptual grounding tokens[perception2025bigverdi]通过深度图和检测输出提供辅助信号。 表征分析和诊断provide auxiliary signals through depth maps and detection outputs. Representation analysis and diagnostics[berasi2025not, benno2026latentlens, yao2025reading, xu2026thinking]揭示何时发生感知故障并支持校准的不确定性估计。 工业和视频异常检测中的特定领域部署reveal when perceptual failures occur and support calibrated uncertainty estimation. Domain-specific deployment in industrial and video anomaly detection[chen2026reason, cai2026steering]展示了实际的可靠性改进。这些方法共同将潜在感知建立为一种强大的机制，用于缩小模型所看到的内容与所报告的内容之间的差距，这对所部署的视觉语言系统的可靠性具有直接影响。demonstrates practical reliability improvements. These methods collectively establish latent perception as a powerful mechanism for reducing the gap between what models see and what they report, with direct implications for the reliability of deployed vision-language systems.

5.5 内存Memory

内存已成为法学硕士的必要补充，法学硕士的无状态架构需要外部机制来保留推理步骤中的知识Memory has emerged as a necessary complement to LLMs, whose stateless architecture needs external mechanisms to retain knowledge across inference steps[hu2025memory]。然而，基于标记的记忆引入了自己的瓶颈：将累积的上下文表示为离散序列会增加提示长度，降低检索保真度，并阻止自适应记忆整合所需的基于梯度的优化。潜在记忆通过将持久性知识编码为连续向量来解决这个问题，从而实现紧凑的跨上下文保留，并具有卓越的保真度和适应性。我们将潜在记忆组织成三种逐渐更广泛的能力：. Yet token-based memory introduces its own bottleneck: representing accumulated context as discrete sequences inflates prompt length, degrades retrieval fidelity, and prevents the gradient-based optimization needed for adaptive memory consolidation. Latent memory resolves this by encoding persistent knowledge as continuous vectors, enabling compact cross-context retention with superior fidelity and adaptability. We organize latent memory into three progressively broader abilities:工作保留Working Retention对于缓存干预，for cache intervention,执着的心Persistent Mind自我进化知识库的进化，以及evolution for self-evolving knowledge stores, and多模式召回Multimodal Recall跨越视觉和具体形式的基础。grounding across visual and embodied modalities.

工作保留。Working Retention.连续的潜在表示将 KV 缓存从被动记录转变为主动管理的工作内存，其扩展、压缩和整合远远超出了离散令牌序列所允许的范围。可微缓存注入和选择性令牌保留方案Continuous latent representations transform the KV cache from a passive record into an actively managed working memory that can be augmented, compressed, and consolidated far beyond what discrete token sequences allow. Differentiable cache injection and selective token retention schemes[liu2025deliberation, wu2025efficient]证明模型可以异步审议并扩展到更长的序列，而无需成比例的内存增长，同时低秩和跨层压缩demonstrate that models can deliberate asynchronously and scale to longer sequences without proportional memory growth, while low-rank and cross-layer compression[mu2025sals, hao2026deltakv]确认可以利用潜在的键向量结构来减少缓存占用空间，而不会牺牲表示保真度。内在整合confirm that latent key-vector structure can be exploited to reduce cache footprint without sacrificing representational fidelity. Intrinsic consolidation[hou2026flashmem]进一步表明，工作记忆可以直接从模型自身的瞬态推理状态合成，其中不确定性驱动的触发消除了对辅助编码器的需要。further shows that working memory can be synthesized directly from the model’s own transient reasoning states, where uncertainty-driven triggering eliminates the need for auxiliary encoders.

执着的心。Persistent Mind.潜在表征解锁了一种本质上不同的记忆机制，其中知识存储在上下文重置中持续存在，有选择地更新，并仅通过经验分化为专门的功能。门控和生成方法Latent representations unlock a qualitatively different memory regime where knowledge stores persist across context resets, update selectively, and differentiate into specialized functions through experience alone. Gated and generative approaches[xu2026gmemllm, zhang2025memgen, zhang2026nextmem]确定潜在槽可以通过可区分的选择性写作持久维持，同时按需动态合成，在没有明确认知监督的情况下出现计划、程序和工作记忆能力。自我进化和检索统一方法establish that latent slots can be durably maintained through differentiable selective writing while being dynamically synthesized on demand, with planning, procedural, and working memory faculties emerging without explicit cognitive supervision. Self-evolving and retrieval-unified methods[zhang2025latentevolve, he2025clara]进一步证明这些存储通过双阶段情景和程序整合改进跨查询，并且可以将外部文档检索折叠到与生成相同的连续空间中，从而实现端到端优化；这种持久记忆机制自然地扩展到多代理设置further demonstrate that these stores improve across queries through dual-phase episodic and procedural consolidation, and can collapse external document retrieval into the same continuous space as generation, enabling end-to-end optimization; this persistent memory regime extends naturally to multi-agent settings[fu2026latentmem]，其中角色条件组合解决了共享上下文固有的同质化和令牌开销瓶颈。, where role-conditioned composition resolves homogenization and token-overhead bottlenecks inherent to shared context.

多模式召回。Multimodal Recall.潜在空间为视觉和实体主体施加了结构性记忆障碍：空间布局、小部件细节和时间连续性在转换中丢失，使得基于标记的记忆无法在扩展生成过程中维持感知基础Latent space imposes a structural memory barrier for visual and embodied agents: spatial layout, widget details, and temporal continuity are lost in conversion, rendering token-based memory incapable of sustaining perceptual grounding during extended generation[yu2025vismem, wu2025towards]。连续编码方式. Continuous encoding methods[wu2025towards, wu2025autoscaling]证明 VLM 可以将多模态知识压缩为与冻结主干网兼容的固定长度嵌入。与长提示下基于文本的记忆不同，这些方法随记忆深度单调地扩展性能。认知结构变体prove that VLMs can compress multimodal knowledge into fixed-length embeddings compatible with frozen backbones. Unlike text-based memory under long prompts, these methods scale performance monotonically with memory depth. Cognitively structured variants[yu2025vismem]进一步揭示，将潜在存储组织成互补的感知和语义模块可以防止系统漂移，建立连续的潜在记忆作为锚定复杂任务的重要基础。further reveal that organizing latent stores into complementary perceptual and semantic modules prevents systematic drift, establishing continuous latent memory as the essential substrate for anchoring complex tasks.

5.6 协作Collaboration

代理系统中的集体智能传统上是通过自然语言来调节的Collective intelligence in agent systems has traditionally been mediated by natural language[he2025llm]。然而，语言构成了一个固有的瓶颈：将内部表示压缩为离散标记会丢弃语义细微差别，增加通信延迟，并破坏联合优化所需的梯度路径. Yet language constitutes an inherent bottleneck: compressing internal representations into discrete tokens discards semantic nuance, increases communication latency, and breaks the gradient pathways required for joint optimization[zou2025latent, fu2025cache]。潜在协作通过使代理能够交换连续表示、保留更丰富的内部状态并支持更具表现力的集体协作形式来解决这些限制。 我们将潜在的协作组织成三种逐渐更广泛的能力：. Latent collaboration addresses these limitations by enabling agents to exchange continuous representations, preserving richer internal states and supporting a more expressive form of collective collaboration. We organize latent collaboration into three progressively broader abilities:语义保真度Semantic Fidelity通过潜在通道进行无损代理间状态传输，for lossless inter-agent state transfer via latent channels,共享认知Shared Cognition用于识别和发展跨主体的共享潜在思维结构，以及for identifying and evolving shared latent thought structures across agents, and异构互操作性Heterogeneous Interoperability用于延长潜伏期 跨不同模型系列和模式的协作，无需架构耦合。for extending latent collaboration across diverse model families and modalities without architectural coupling.

语义保真度。Semantic Fidelity.连续表示解锁了多代理协作中结构上最直接的进步：用直接潜在状态传输替换基于令牌的消息传递，保留每个代理内部表示的完整语义内容。研究 KV 缓存和隐藏状态通信Continuous representations unlock the most structurally immediate advance in multi-agent collaboration: replacing token-based message passing with direct latent state transfer that preserves the full semantic content of each agent’s internal representations. Work on KV-cache and hidden-state communication[fu2025cache, du2025enabling, zou2025latent]证明代理可以在没有中间解码的情况下交换内部状态，理论分析证实它比基于文本的对应物具有更高的表达性和更低的复杂性。 互补对齐方法demonstrates that agents can exchange internal states without intermediate decoding, with theoretical analyses confirming that it has strictly higher expressiveness and lower complexity than text-based counterparts. Complementary alignment approaches[dery2026latent]进一步表明，可以跨异构模型学习共享的潜在空间，建立统一的高带宽协作通道，而无需修改任何预训练的参数。further show that a shared latent space can be learned across heterogeneous models, establishing a unified high-bandwidth collaboration channel without modifying any pre-trained parameters.

共享认知。Shared Cognition.潜在表征进一步使主体之间的共享认知结构可识别且可不断进化，这是文本通信根本缺乏的能力。正式的潜变量分析Latent representations further make the structure of shared cognition between agents identifiable and continuously evolvable, a capability that text communication fundamentally lacks. Formal latent variable analyses[zheng2025thought, yu2026dual, fu2026latentmem]证明可以从可观察的输出中非参数地识别主体之间的共享和私有思想组件，并且思想共享关系的全局拓扑在理论上也是可恢复的。策略演化方法prove that shared and private thought components between agents can be identified from observable outputs nonparametrically, with the global topology of thought-sharing relationships also theoretically recoverable. Strategy evolution methods[tang2025learning]证明智能体可以通过反思文本嵌入并将这些反射传播到外部潜在向量中来更新协作策略，其中稳定的、解开的策略风格会在长期范围内出现，而无需模型微调。demonstrate that agents can update collaborative strategies by reflecting on text embeddings and propagating these reflections into external latent vectors, where stable, disentangled strategic styles emerge over long horizons without model fine-tuning.

异构互操作性。Heterogeneous Interoperability.潜在空间还可以通过共享的连续基底而不是特定于任务的自然语言协议来实现不同架构、专业化和模式的代理之间的协调。代理原语Latent space also enables coordination across agents of different architectures, specializations, and modalities through a shared continuous substrate rather than task-specific natural language protocols. Agent Primitives[wang2026primitives]表明重复的 MAS 交互模式可以被抽象为可重用的潜在构建块，这些构建块可以跨任务泛化，而无需手动角色工程。视觉潜在框架show that recurring MAS interaction patterns can be abstracted into reusable latent building blocks that generalize across tasks without manual role engineering. Visual latent frameworks[yu2026dual, liu2026vision]进一步证明，多模态系统中的感知和推理轨迹可以解耦为互补的潜在记忆，以克服以文本为中心的通信中性能下降的扩展墙，并且 VLM 的视觉界面可以作为模型无关的端口，将异构推理轨迹直接注入接收者的感知路径中，从而无需特定配对的翻译器即可实现免训练的跨家庭协作。further demonstrate that perceptual and reasoning trajectories in multimodal systems can be decoupled into complementary latent memories to overcome the performance-degrading scaling wall of text-centric communication, and that the visual interface of VLMs can serve as a model-agnostic port for injecting heterogeneous reasoning traces directly into a receiver’s perceptual pathway, enabling training-free cross-family collaboration without pair-specific translators.

5.7 具体实施方式Embodiment

具身智能体面临着纯语言领域所面临的数据瓶颈：物理多样性的每一次增量，Embodied agents confront a data bottleneck that no purely linguistic domain faces as acutely: every increment in physical diversity,例如e.g.、新的硬件形态、视点和任务环境，使现有的标记演示无效，并强制不传输的特定于平台的重新收集, new hardware morphologies, viewpoints, and task environments, invalidates existing labeled demonstrations and forces platform-specific re-collection that does not transfer[liu2025embodied, ni2025swiftvla, bu2025univla]。潜在空间中的行动通过切断操纵所需的连续几何和因果结构，将空间上丰富的动态压缩为丢弃深度、时间连续性和跨实体对应的符号瓶颈，从而使这一点变得更加复杂。潜在表示同时解决了所有三种故障模式，使动作语义能够从未标记的视频中出现，刻意的推理能够内化为连续的状态轨迹，并且空间先验能够直接提炼到政策骨干中，而无需仪器或重新注释。我们将潜在的体现分为五种逐渐广泛的能力：. Action in latent space compounds this by severing the continuous geometric and causal structure that manipulation requires, collapsing spatially rich dynamics into a symbolic bottleneck that discards depth, temporal continuity, and cross-embodiment correspondence. Latent representations dissolve all three failure modes simultaneously, enabling action semantics to emerge from unlabeled video, deliberate reasoning to be internalized as continuous state trajectories, and spatial priors to be distilled directly into policy backbones without instrumentation or re-annotation. We organize latent embodiment into five progressively broader abilities:无监督接地Unsupervised Grounding用于从没有特定于实施例的标签的未标记视频中导出可转移的动作表示，for deriving transferable action representations from unlabeled video without embodiment-specific labels,内隐思维Implicit Thinking用于将多步骤规划内部化为连续的潜在计算，而无需显式的思想链生成，for internalizing multi-step planning as continuous latent computation without explicit chain-of-thought generation,预见性Predictive Foresight用于模拟潜在空间中的未来状态以生成密集的训练信号并指导实时决策，for simulating future states in latent space to generate dense training signals and guide real-time decision-making,空间认知Spatial Cognition用于从策略潜在空间内的 2D 观察重建 3D/4D 几何结构，以及for reconstructing 3D/4D geometric structure from 2D observations within the policy latent space, and广义转移Generalized Transfer用于通过共享的与身体无关的潜在基底来桥接异构硬件形态。for bridging heterogeneous hardware morphologies through a shared body-agnostic latent substrate.

无监督接地。Unsupervised Grounding.潜在表征赋予嵌入式人工智能最重要的优势是能够在没有任何远程操作标签的情况下从互联网规模的视频中提取动作语义，从而将机器人演示的稀缺性从结构性天花板转变为可克服的瓶颈。 量化和连续码本方法确立了帧间视觉转换可以被压缩为潜在动作标记，这些标记可以跨实施例泛化，并且在低数据状态下优于标签监督模型The most consequential advantage latent representations confer on embodied AI is the ability to ground action semantics from internet-scale video without any teleoperation labels, converting the scarcity of robot demonstrations from a structural ceiling into a surmountable bottleneck. Quantization and continuous codebook approaches establish that inter-frame visual transitions can be compressed into latent action tokens that generalize across embodiments and outperform label-supervised models in low-data regimes[ye2024lapa, bu2025univla, tharwat2025latent]，而当潜在目标受到物理轨迹先验、对比本体感受对齐或解开的结构和运动分解的约束时，基础保真度会进一步提高, while grounding fidelity improves further when latent objectives are constrained by physical trajectory priors, contrastive proprioceptive alignment, or disentangled structure-and-motion decomposition[li2025latbot, zhang2026clap, dai2026conla, jala2026joint, fx2026cowvla, bi2025motus]。正如框架所证实的那样，时空结构可作为辅助基础信号，增强行动相关性并抑制与任务无关的干扰因素 共同解决几何和时间瓶颈. Spatial and temporal structure serve as auxiliary grounding signals that sharpen action-relevance and suppress task-irrelevant distractors, as confirmed by frameworks that jointly address geometric and temporal bottlenecks[cai2025seeing]并通过预训练管道将跨视点对齐与潜在动作学习交织在一起and by pretraining pipelines that interleave cross-viewpoint alignment with latent action learning[jeong2026learning, jiang2025wholebodyvla]，共同证明潜在动作空间的质量，而不是标记数据的数量，是下游操纵泛化的主要决定因素。, collectively demonstrating that the quality of the latent action space, not the quantity of labeled data, is the primary determinant of downstream manipulation generalization.

内隐思维。Implicit Thinking.连续表示实现了一种本质上不同的具身认知模式：用紧凑的潜在轨迹取代潜伏主导、语言瓶颈的思维链，将多步审议直接带入动作生成路径。 强化学习视觉计划潜伏及其蒸馏 继任者Continuous representations enable a qualitatively different mode of embodied cognition: replacing the latency-dominated, linguistically bottlenecked chain-of-thought with compact latent trajectories that carry multi-step deliberation directly into the action generation pathway. Reinforcement-learned visual plan latents and their distilled successors[huang2025thinkact, huang2026fastthinkact]表明体现推理可以基于与动作相关的视觉奖励，并压缩为少数连续的标记，从而以一小部分的速度实现长期规划和小样本适应 文本替代品的推理成本。基于课程的方法，逐步内化明确的思想链 监督纯粹的潜在计算show that embodied reasoning can be grounded in action-aligned visual rewards and compressed into a handful of continuous tokens, achieving long-horizon planning and few-shot adaptation at a fraction of the inference cost of textual alternatives. Curriculum-based approaches that progressively internalize explicit chain-of-thought supervision into pure latent computation[bai2026latent]，通过恒定内存的循环潜在细化来迭代动作预测的架构, architectures that iterate action predictions through recurrent latent refinement at constant memory[tur2026recurrent]，以及将视觉动态、空间先验和本体感受状态统一在单个令牌有效推理空间内的框架, and frameworks that unify visual dynamics, spatial priors, and proprioceptive states within a single token-efficient reasoning space[liu2026last0, ma2025unifying, luo2026last, tan2025latent, peng2025colavla, xie2026latentvla]共同证明，潜在推理不仅比符号替代方案更有效，而且对于物理控制的连续空间领域更具有严格的表达能力。collectively establish that latent reasoning is not merely more efficient than symbolic alternatives but strictly more expressive for the continuous, spatial domain of physical control.

预测性的远见。Predictive Foresight.潜在表示独特地使实体代理能够在不生成像素的情况下模拟未来状态，从而允许想象的结果充当训练监督和实时决策指导，而不是昂贵的辅助输出。 JEPA 式预训练Latent representations uniquely enable embodied agents to simulate future states without generating pixels, allowing imagined outcomes to serve as training supervision and real-time decision guidance rather than expensive auxiliary outputs. JEPA-style pretraining[ginwind2026vlajepa]证明在无泄漏的情况下预测未来帧的目标编码器潜伏会产生对相机运动和背景变化稳健的动态抽象，而世界模型导出的潜在距离demonstrates that predicting target-encoder latents of future frames in a leakage-free regime yields dynamics abstractions robust to camera motion and background variation, while world-model-derived latent distances[fei2025srpo]提供密集的进度奖励，解决 VLA 强化学习的稀疏性瓶颈，从稀疏奖励基线开始，在 200 个 RL 步骤内实现接近完成的任务掌握。在同一潜在自回归过程中产生远见和行动的框架provide dense progress rewards that resolve the sparsity bottleneck of VLA reinforcement learning, achieving near-complete task mastery within two hundred RL steps from a sparse-reward baseline. Frameworks that generate foresight and action within the same latent autoregressive pass[huang2025thinkact, fan2026future]进一步证明，可以在一次前向传递中产生与动作一致的视觉奖励和可审查的视觉前瞻，建立潜在空间未来模拟作为离散令牌预测从根本上无法复制的训练和部署机制。further demonstrate that action-aligned visual rewards and reviewable visual look-aheads can be produced in a single forward pass, establishing latent-space future simulation as a training and deployment mechanism that discrete token prediction fundamentally cannot replicate.

空间认知。Spatial Cognition.物理操作对通过 2D 观察训练的策略提出了 3D 几何需求，并且潜在表示具有独特的定位来重建空间结构，而不需要显式的深度传感器或 3D 注释。将冻结几何感知编码器的知识蒸馏为 LLM 视觉标记表示Physical manipulation imposes a 3D geometric demand on policies trained from 2D observations, and latent representations are uniquely positioned to reconstruct spatial structure without requiring explicit depth sensors or 3D annotations. Knowledge distillation of frozen geometry-aware encoders into LLM visual token representations[guo2025glad, govind2026unilact, ni2025swiftvla]证明将策略潜伏与 3D 和 4D 结构特征相结合，无需进行架构修改即可将空间先验注入主干，从而在仅外观潜伏系统失败的情况下实现精确的丰富接触操作。将密集 3D 占用视为潜在预测输出和监督信号demonstrates that aligning policy latents with 3D and 4D structural features injects spatial priors into the backbone without architectural modification, enabling precise contact-rich manipulation where appearance-only latents systematically fail. Treating dense 3D occupancy as both a latent predictive output and a supervisory signal[liu2025occvla]表明可以仅从自动注释的二维数据开发体积空间意识，同时共同解决几何和时间基础瓶颈shows that volumetric spatial awareness can be developed from auto-annotated 2D data alone, while jointly addressing geometric and temporal grounding bottlenecks[cai2025seeing, jeong2026learning]确认几何感知编码和跨视点对齐是互补且相互必要的，将潜在的空间想象力建立为现实传感器约束下精确物理交互的表征先决条件。confirms that geometry-aware encoding and cross-viewpoint alignment are complementary and mutually necessary, establishing latent spatial imagination as the representational prerequisite for precise physical interaction under realistic sensor constraints.

广义转移。Generalized Transfer.跨硬件部署是阻止通用体现智能扩展的结构性瓶颈：每一次形态变化都会使动作空间失效，并需要特定于平台的重新训练，而这些重新训练无法适应机器人硬件不断增长的多样性。潜在动作空间通过充当与身体无关的抽象层来解决这个问题，其中来自异构实施例的语义等效运动会聚，从而实现零样本跨平台部署和数据高效适应，而无需访问 任务奖励或目标平台演示Cross-hardware deployment is the structural bottleneck that prevents generalist embodied intelligence from scaling: every morphological change invalidates action spaces and demands platform-specific retraining that cannot amortize across the growing diversity of robotic hardware. Latent action spaces resolve this by functioning as body-agnostic abstraction layers where semantically equivalent motions from heterogeneous embodiments converge, enabling zero-shot cross-platform deployment and data-efficient adaptation without access to task rewards or target-platform demonstrations[zhang2025alignthensteer, shi2026care, jiang2025wholebodyvla]。通过贝叶斯分解解开语言-动作. Language-action disentanglement via Bayesian decomposition[lian2026langforce]和 状态感知的潜在重新表示and state-aware latent re-representation[wang2025lola]进一步证明，相同的潜在基质同时解决指令跟随崩溃并支持多模式跨任务泛化，同时面向导航的潜在对齐further demonstrate that the same latent substrate simultaneously resolves instruction-following collapse and supports multi-modal cross-task generalization, while navigation-oriented latent alignment[subedi2026lcla]证实了与身体无关的潜在原理从操纵延伸到具身导航，建立连续的潜在动作空间作为具身智能的必要基础，而具身智能必须同时泛化到硬件形态、任务分配和物理环境。confirms that the body-agnostic latent principle extends from manipulation to embodied navigation, establishing continuous latent action spaces as the necessary foundation for embodied intelligence that must generalize across hardware morphology, task distribution, and physical environment simultaneously.

6 展望：下一步是什么？Outlook: What is Next?

前面几节从多个角度审视了大型模型中的潜在空间：它的基本定义以及与显式空间的比较，它从早期探索到成熟研究范式的演化轨迹，跨越架构、表示、计算和优化来控制潜在处理的技术机制，以及它在推理、规划、建模、感知、记忆、协作和体现方面释放的多种能力。总之，这些进展展示了潜在空间范式的广度和动力，同时也揭示了结构局限性和悬而未决的问题。本节将这些观察结果综合为一系列观点、挑战和未来方向。The preceding sections survey latent space in large models from multiple angles: its foundational definition and comparison with explicit space, its evolutionary trajectory from early exploration to a full-fledged research paradigm, the technical mechanisms spanning architecture, representation, computation, and optimization that govern latent processing, and the diverse abilities it unlocks across reasoning, planning, modeling, perception, memory, collaboration, and embodiment. Together, these advances demonstrate both the breadth and the momentum of the latent-space paradigm, while also revealing structural limitations and open questions. This section synthesizes these observations into a set of perspectives, challenges, and future directions.

6.1 视角Perspective

潜在空间的兴起标志着基于语言的智能研究的根本性重新定位。最近的研究不再将潜在空间视为计算的偶然副产品，而是越来越多地将其视为主要基质。从这个角度来看，我们通过四个连续的镜头来制定这项调查：The rise of latent space signals a fundamental reorientation in the study of language-based intelligence. Rather than treating latent space as a incidental byproduct of computation, recent research increasingly positions them as a primary substrate. In this perspective, we formulate this survey in four sequential lenses:基金会Foundation（节(Section2）从本质上澄清了潜在空间是什么；) intrinsically clarifies what latent space is;进化论Evolution（节(Section3）揭示了它如何从一个新兴的想法发展成为一个广泛的研究范式；) reveals how it has grown from an emerging idea into a broad research paradigm;机制Mechanism（节(Section4) 解释通过什么技术设计来实现；和) explains through what technical designs is realized; and能力Ability（节(Section5）显示了它在潜在空间中能够实现的功能。从整体上看，这些维度表明潜在空间是下一代通用智能系统的有希望的候选基础。) shows what it enables within the latent space. Viewed as a whole, these dimensions suggest that latent space is a promising candidate basis for the next generation of general-purpose intelligent systems.

基金会。Foundation.从基础角度来看，潜在空间不应仅仅被理解为辅助隐藏表示，而应被理解为机器原生空间，它重新定义了基于语言的自回归模型使用语义信息进行计算的位置From a foundational standpoint, latent space should be understood not merely as an auxiliary hidden representation, but as a machine-native space that redefines where language-based autoregressive models compute with the semantic information[hu2024understanding, xu2025formal, zou2026capabilities]。相对于显性空间（或言语空间）. Relative to explicit space (or verbal space)[xi2025rise, hu2025landscape, wu2025evolutionary, humze2025comprehensive]，其核心价值在于四个代表性属性：, its central value lies in four representational properties:机器原生machine-native, 连续的continuous, 灵活高效flexible & efficient, 和, and高保真high-fidelity，以及四种功能：, and four functional capabilities:可操作的operable, 富有表现力的expressive, 可扩展性scalability, 和, and广义的generalized，这减少了语言计算中固有的冗余、离散化瓶颈、低效率和语义损失。从这个意义上说，潜在范式标志着从人类对齐生成到机器优化计算的转变。与此同时，这种转变带来了一种本质上的张力：效率和表现力的提高。因此，潜在空间的基本意义不仅是技术上的，而且是认知上的：它改变了模型的计算内容以及计算的理解方式，为下一代模型超越以代币为中心的操作奠定了基础。, which reduces the redundancy, discretization bottleneck, inefficiency, and semantic loss inherent in verbalized computation. In this sense, the latent paradigm marks a shift from human-aligned generation to machine-optimal computation. At the same time, this shift introduces a constitutive tension: the gains in efficiency, expressiveness. Thus, the foundational significance of latent space is not only technical but epistemic: it changes both what models compute and how that computation can be understood, laying the groundwork for next-generation models to transcend token-centric operation.

进化。Evolution.潜在空间研究的进化轨迹表明，该领域正在从萌芽走向The evolutionary trajectory of latent-space research suggests that the field is moving from sprout toward全面爆发all-round outbreak，不仅体现在作品的数量上，还体现在范式的多样性上。早期阶段通过证明推理相关结构已经存在于内部激活中并且可以部分绕过明确的语言表达来建立可行性。随后的基础阶段提供了理论论证和初步的多模式扩展，从而将孤立的论证转化为连贯的研究议程。后期的扩展和爆发阶段揭示了进一步的转变：潜在空间不再被视为仅用于文本推理的压缩技巧, in terms of not only the number of the works but also the diversity of paradigms. The early stage established feasibility by showing that reasoning-relevant structure already resides in internal activations and can, in part, bypass explicit verbalization. The subsequent foundation stage supplied theoretical justification, and initial multimodal extensions, thereby converting isolated demonstrations into a coherent research agenda. The later expansion and outbreak stages reveal a further transition: latent space is no longer treated as a compression trick for textual reasoning alone[reasoning2025chen, implicit2025li, survey2025zhu]，而是作为涵盖视觉认知、记忆、协作和具体行动的总体框架。这一进展表明，最好不要将潜在空间视为自回归模型的瞬态优化，而应将其视为下一代通用智能的新兴系统原理。, but as a general framework spanning visual cognition, memory, collaboration, and embodied action. This progression indicates that latent space is best viewed not as a transient optimization of autoregressive models, but as an emerging systems principle for next-generation general intelligence.

机制。Mechanism.从机制的角度来看，调查表明潜在空间的进步是由四个相互依赖的维度的共同设计驱动的：From a mechanistic perspective, the survey implies that progress in latent space is driven by the co-design of four interdependent dimensions:建筑学architecture, 代表性representation, 计算computation, 和, and优化optimization。关键问题不仅仅是模型是否包含潜在变量，而是. The key issue is not simply whether a model contains latent variables, but使用什么架构what architectures are utilized, 实例化了哪些表示what representations are instantiated, 如何通过它们进行计算how computation is operated through them, 和, and他们是如何优化的at how they are optimized。这种分类法揭示了一个重要趋势：该领域正在逐渐从启发式使用转向系统化原理，从外部集成转向内部启用，从静态和固定转向动态和自适应，从传统设计转向多种范式。因此，未来的研究更多的是设计其主要核心本质上是潜在的模型，而不是向现有模型添加潜在空间。. This taxonomy reveals an important trend: the field is gradually moving from heuristic usage toward systematic principle, from externally integrated to internally enabled, from static and fixed to dynamic and adaptive, and from conventional designs to multiple paradigms. Accordingly, future research is less about adding latent space to existing models than about designing models whose primary core is intrinsically latent.

能力。Ability.就能力而言，潜在空间最重要的贡献是它拓宽了智能的功能范围，超越了显式空间模型。调查显示，基于语言的模型的潜在空间不仅支持增强In terms of ability, the most consequential contribution of latent space is that it broadens the functional scope of intelligence beyond explicit-space models. The survey shows that latent space of language-based models supports not only enhanced推理reasoning，而且还, but also规划planning, 建模modeling, 知觉perception, 记忆memory, 沟通communication, 和, and实施例embodiment。这些能力的统一之处在于，它们都需要用自然语言外部化的结构，这些结构是困难的、昂贵的或根本上有损的。因此，潜在空间充当了跨模式、时间尺度和主体的一般整合的共同基础。根据这种观点，其最终承诺不在于取代显式文本标记，而在于使模型能够在共享的连续潜在空间内协调异构形式的信息。最强烈的长期影响是潜在空间可能成为通用模型的主要媒介。. What unifies these capacities is that they all require structures that are difficult, costly, or fundamentally lossy to externalize in natural language. Latent space therefore acts as a common substrate for general integration across modalities, timescales, and agents. Under this view, its ultimate promise lies not in replacing explicit textual tokens, but in enabling models to coordinate heterogeneous forms of information within a shared continuous latent space. The strongest long-term implication is that latent space may become the principal medium of general-purpose models.

总体而言，本次调查中提出的关于潜在空间的观点表明，从其基本属性到其历史扩展，从其底层机制到其新兴能力，潜在空间始终指向一个共同的结论：未来的智能系统可能会越来越依赖潜在计算而不是纯粹的语言计算作为其主要操作原则。Overall, the perspective presented in this survey about latent space suggests that from its foundational properties to its historical expansion, from its underlying mechanisms to its emerging abilities, latent space consistently points toward a common conclusion: future intelligent systems may rely increasingly on latent rather than purely verbal computation as their primary operating principle.

6.2 挑战Challenge

尽管潜在空间作为机器原生计算基础的前景越来越广阔，但在成为通用智能系统的可靠基础之前，它仍然面临着几个基本障碍。使潜在表示强大的相同属性，即它们的连续性、压缩性、灵活性和表达能力，也使它们难以检查、评估和治理，从而导致相对较低的结果Despite its growing promise as a machine-native substrate for computation, latent space still faces several fundamental obstacles before it can serve as a reliable foundation for general-purpose intelligent systems. The same properties that make latent representations powerful, their continuity, compression, flexibility, and expressive capacity, also make them difficult to inspect, assess, and govern, resulting relatively low可评价性Evaluability, 可控性Controllability, 和, and可解释性Interpretability。这些问题共同表明，潜在空间的进步不仅取决于能力的提高，还取决于使潜在计算更加可观察、可操纵和易于理解。. Together, these issues reveal that progress in latent space depends not only on improving capability, but also on making latent computation more observable, steerable, and understandable.

可评价性。Evaluability.潜在空间推理方法的一个主要挑战在于其有限的可评估性。与显式推理痕迹不同A central challenge for latent-space reasoning methods lies in their limited evaluability. Unlike explicit reasoning traces[miles2023language, temera2023measuring]，人类检查无法直接访问潜在轨迹，这使得确定中间计算是否正确、完整甚至与手头的任务相关存在本质上的困难, latent trajectories are not directly accessible to human inspection, which makes it inherently difficult to determine whether an intermediate computation is correct, complete, or even relevant to the task at hand[du2025latent, li2026dynamics, zou2026capabilities]。这种不透明性极大地限制了过程级验证：研究人员通常无法区分真正结构化的中间推理和仅与正确输出相关的表示。因此，潜在推理系统的评估仍然主要依赖于最终答案的准确性或事后的言语表达，这两者都只提供有关实际推理过程的间接且可能不完整的证据. This opacity substantially constrains process-level verification: researchers are often unable to distinguish between genuinely structured intermediate reasoning and representations that merely correlate with the correct output. Consequently, the evaluation of latent reasoning systems still relies predominantly on final-answer accuracy or on post hoc verbalization, both of which offer only indirect and potentially incomplete evidence about the actual reasoning process[zhang2025do, implicit2025li].

尽管最近的一些研究已经开始提出潜在空间推理的基准策略Although some recent studies have begun to propose benchmarking strategies for latent-space reasoning[hagendorff2025beyond]，该领域仍缺乏成熟且广泛接受的监督和评估协议, the field still lacks mature and widely accepted protocols for supervision and evaluation[zou2026capabilities, sahoo2026shallow]。现有的方法在任务、数据集和测量标准方面仍然支离破碎，而且目前还没有标准化的框架来评估潜在推理轨迹的真实性、稳健性或内部一致性。这种基准分散和度量不一致使得方法之间的公平比较变得困难，阻碍累积进展，并使真正方法论进步的识别变得复杂。因此，提高可评估性仍然是潜在推理模型开发中最紧迫的开放问题之一。. Existing approaches remain fragmented across tasks, datasets, and measurement criteria, and there is as yet no standardized framework for assessing the faithfulness, robustness, or internal consistency of latent reasoning trajectories. Such benchmark fragmentation and metric inconsistency make fair comparison across methods difficult, hinder cumulative progress, and complicate the identification of genuine methodological advances. As a result, improving evaluability remains one of the most pressing open problems for the development of latent reasoning models.

可控性。Controllability.尽管原则上潜在空间是计算和控制的高度可操作的基础，但实现对潜在表示的可靠和可概括的操作在实践中仍然是一个巨大的挑战Although latent space is, in principle, a highly operable substrate for computation and control, achieving reliable and generalizable manipulation of latent representations remains a substantial challenge in practice[zhang2024survey, lu2025latent, survey2025zhu]。对隐藏状态的细粒度干预确实可以以有用且有时非常精确的方式重塑模型行为；然而，此类干预措施的可控性往往较低。核心困难不仅在于确定在何处以及如何进行干预，还在于确定应如何指定高级语义意图，以便它们同时可由机器操作、足够精确且易于人类操作员理解. Fine-grained interventions on hidden states can indeed reshape model behavior in useful and sometimes remarkably precise ways; however, such interventions often suffer from relatively low controllability. The central difficulty lies not merely in identifying where and how to intervene, but in determining how high-level semantic intentions should be specified so that they are simultaneously machine-actionable, sufficiently precise, and intelligible to human operators[kyle2024steering, andy2023representation, sadiekh2025polarity]。这种张力暴露了连续的内部动态与离散的、可解释的目标之间更深的差距。因此，开发真正可控的潜在系统需要的不仅仅是局部引导技术：它需要有原则的机制，能够以稳健和自适应的方式将明确的目标、安全要求和资源约束映射到内部计算过程。. This tension exposes a deeper gap between continuous internal dynamics and discrete, interpretable objectives. Consequently, the development of truly controllable latent systems requires more than local steering techniques alone: it calls for principled mechanisms that can map explicit goals, safety requirements, and resource constraints onto internal computational processes in a robust and adaptive manner.

可解释性。Interpretability.困难在于潜在表示的本质：它们是高维的、分布式的，并且通常是深度纠缠的，因此单个维度及其诱导的轨迹都不能整齐地映射到稳定的语义概念上The difficulty lies in the very nature of latent representations: they are high-dimensional, distributed, and often deeply entangled, so that neither individual dimensions nor their induced trajectories map neatly onto stable semantic concepts[andy2023representation, van2017neural, yang2025internal]。出现的是一个具有巨大表达能力的表征空间，但其内部组织却难以人类理解。这种不透明性使得解释模型为何得出特定结论、追踪信息如何在连续的计算阶段中转换或确定错误和失准首先出现的位置变得具有挑战性. What emerges is a representational space of immense expressive power, but one whose internal organization is resistant to human understanding. This opacity makes it challenging to explain why a model reaches a particular conclusion, to trace how information is transformed across successive stages of computation, or to determine where error and misalignment first arise[zou2026capabilities, berasi2025not, sahoo2026shallow, li2026imagination]。更重要的是，问题不仅仅是认知上的，而且是制度上的：通过难以理解的潜在操作进行推理的系统可能会变得更加强大，同时变得更难审计、更难诊断、更不负责任。因此，可解释性研究仍有空间。. More importantly, the problem is not simply epistemic but institutional: systems that reason through inscrutable latent operations may become more powerful while simultaneously becoming less auditable, less diagnosable, and less accountable. Thus, there is still rooms for the interpretability study.

6.3 未来Future

展望未来，潜在空间研究的下一个决定性步骤不仅仅是产生更好的潜在推理方法，而是将潜在空间建立为机器智能的原生基础。当前的进展正在出现更广泛的架构转变：显式语言可能仍然是指令、生成和验证的界面，而潜在空间日益成为模型思考、理解、模拟、记忆和行动的内部工作空间。从这个意义上说，潜在空间的未来不仅仅是提高效率，而是重新定义通用操作发生的地方。Looking ahead, the next decisive step for latent space research is not merely to produce better latent reasoning methods, but to establish latent space as the native substrate of machine intelligence. What is emerging from current progress is a broader architectural shift: explicit language may remain the interface for instruction, generation, and verification, while latent space increasingly becomes the internal workspace where models think, understand, simulate, remember, and act. In this sense, the future of latent space is not simply about improving efficiency, but about redefining where general-purpose operations happens.

理论。Theory.未来研究的首要任务是超越经验成功，转向对潜在空间智能的原则性理论理解A central priority for future research is to move beyond empirical success toward a principled theoretical understanding of latent-space intelligence[hao2024training]。该领域不仅仅是展示潜在空间在实践中的作用，还必须解释潜在空间如何以及为何支持计算，在什么条件下它们优于显式标记级空间，以及哪些形式的推理真正是潜在空间所固有的。从这个意义上说，关键问题不仅仅是潜在推理是否比语言推理更有效，而是它作为计算基础何时更具可操作性、更具表现力、更具可扩展性和更通用性。更广泛地说，该领域必须从分散的理论验证发展到潜在表示、潜在计算及其所实现的能力增益的统一框架。. Rather than merely showing that latent works in practice, the field must explain how and why latent spaces support computation, under what conditions they outperform explicit token-level space, and what forms of reasoning are genuinely native to latent space. In this sense, the key question is not simply whether latent reasoning is more efficient than verbalized reasoning, but when it is more operable, more expressive, more scalable, and more generalizable as a computational substrate. More broadly, the field must progress from scattered theoretical validation to a unified framework for latent representation, latent computation, and the capability gains they enable.

因此，迫切需要一个There is therefore an indispensable need for a基础理论foundational theory的潜在空间。现有的工作已经开始提供其表达能力和计算优势的正式说明of latent space. Existing work has begun to provide formal accounts of its expressiveness and computational advantages[hagendorff2025beyond, zhu2025reasoning, yang2025internal]，但系统理论仍不发达, but a systematic theory remains underdeveloped[xu2025formal, zhang2025do, zou2026capabilities, liang2026do, sahoo2026shallow]。未来的研究不仅应该阐明潜在推理的运作方式，还应该阐明. Future research should clarify not only how latent reasoning operates, but also为什么why, 当when，并在, and under什么what它超越了明确或口头推理的限制。这需要更深入地考虑潜在轨迹的几何、语义、优化动力学和计算组织，以便潜在推理可以被理解为不仅仅是一种有效的工程技术。constraints it surpasses explicit or verbal reasoning. This requires a deeper account of the geometry, semantics, optimization dynamics, and computational organization of latent trajectories, so that latent reasoning can be understood as more than an effective engineering technique.

同样重要的是显性空间和潜在空间的原则性表述为两个Equally important is a principled formulation of explicit and latent spaces as two互补的代表制度complementary representational regimes基于语言的智能within language-based intelligence[survey2025zhu, giorgos2025language, xu2025formal, zou2026capabilities]。核心问题不是潜在计算是否会取代语言，而是符号表示和连续表示在表达能力、计算功能和交流作用方面有何不同。在这样的框架内，显式语言可能仍然是用于指令、生成和验证的外部可访问接口，而潜在空间则充当推理、抽象、记忆、模拟和规划的内部工作空间。理论目标是解释. The central issue is not whether latent computation will replace language, but how symbolic and continuous representations differ in expressive capacity, computational function, and communicative role. Within such a framework, explicit language may remain the externally accessible interface for instruction, generation, and verification, while latent space serves as the internal workspace for reasoning, abstraction, memory, simulation, and planning. The theoretical goal is to explain如何how这两个空间相互作用，these two spaces interact,什么what各种信息和操作最自然地分配给每个人，并且kinds of information and operations are most naturally allocated to each, and什么what在它们的协调中出现了权衡。trade-offs emerge in their coordination.

未来的工作还必须发展一个原则性的理论Future work must also develop a principled theory of值得信赖的trustworthy潜在空间。由于潜在轨迹本质上对于直接人类检查来说是不透明的，因此进展不能仅依赖于结果水平的表现latent space. Because latent trajectories are inherently opaque to direct human inspection, progress cannot rely on outcome-level performance alone[hao2024training, implicit2025li, survey2025zhu]。相反，该领域需要严格的可评估性、可控性和可解释性框架，以及标准化基准和监督协议，以评估潜在计算的忠实性、稳健性和内部一致性。如果没有这样的基础，基准分散和指标不一致将继续阻碍公平比较和累积进展。. Instead, the field needs rigorous frameworks for evaluability, controllability, and interpretability, together with standardized benchmarks and supervision protocols, to assess the faithfulness, robustness, and internal consistency of latent computation. Without such foundations, benchmark fragmentation and metric inconsistency will continue to obstruct fair comparison and cumulative progress.

最终，潜在空间研究的未来在于将潜在空间从经验方法转变为原理性理论：正式解释其计算优势，形式化其与显式空间的关系，并使其隐藏过程可评估、可控制和可解释。Ultimately, the future of latent-space research lies in transforming latent space from an empirical method into a principled theory: one that formally explains its computational advantages, formalizes its relation to explicit space, and renders its hidden processes evaluable, controllable, and interpretable.

多式联运。Multimodal.调查表明，多模式智能的未来，The survey suggests that the future of multimodal intelligence,例如e.g.视觉模型和具身模型，不应该被理解为仅仅在语言模型上添加更多的感觉通道。相反，更重要的转变是潜在空间作为共享计算工作空间的出现，其中语言、视觉、动作、记忆和代理间通信可以在连续表示中联合处理。在这个观点中，潜在空间不再是压缩推理痕迹的辅助设备，而是支持跨模态和时间尺度的通用智能的内部组织的机器原生基底。, visual models and embodied models, should not be understood as the mere addition of more sensory channels to language models. Rather, the more consequential shift is the emergence of latent space as a shared computational workspace, in which language, vision, action, memory, and inter-agent communication can be jointly processed within continuous representations. In this view, latent space is no longer a secondary device for compressing reasoning traces, but a machine-native substrate that supports the internal organization of general-purpose intelligence across modalities and timescales.

这一观点暗示了未来研究的第一个主要方向：从文本介导的多模态到This perspective implies a first major direction for future research: the transition from text-mediated multimodality to模态本机多模态modality-native multimodality潜在计算。现有的多模式系统通常依赖于在进行更高级别的操作之前将非语言输入翻译为文本或标记化形式latent computation. Existing multimodal systems often rely on translating non-linguistic inputs into textual or tokenized forms before higher-level operation takes place[yin2023survey, tadas2019multimodal, liu2025embodied]。相比之下，调查强调，与显式符号通道相比，潜在表示可以保留高保真信息，减少模态差距，并支持更平滑的融合、对齐和交互。因此，长期目标不仅仅是用语言描述感知，而是使模型能够直接在视觉、空间和面向动作的潜在空间中运行。. By contrast, the survey highlights that latent representations can preserve high-fidelity information, reduce modality gaps, and support smoother fusion, alignment, and interaction than explicit symbolic channels. The long-term goal, therefore, is not simply to describe perception in language, but to enable models to operate within visual, spatial, and action-oriented latent spaces directly.

第二个方向涉及从孤立的多模态模型到A second direction concerns the evolution from isolated multimodal models to综合多式联运系统integrated multimodal systems [ma2025multimodal, li2025latent, li2025latent1, yu2025vismem]在以能力为导向的分类法中，调查强调潜在空间不仅可以推理，还可以规划、建模、感知、记忆、协作和体现。这些功能的统一之处在于，它们都涉及用自然语言外部化很困难、成本高昂或有损的结构。因此，多模态人工智能的未来可能取决于架构，其中感知、世界建模、记忆形成、通信和行动规划通过共同的潜在基质而不是通过松散耦合的模块或额外的计算来协调。.Across its ability-oriented taxonomy, the survey emphasizes that latent space enables not only reasoning, but also planning, modeling, perception, memory, collaboration, and embodiment. What unifies these capabilities is that they all involve structures that are difficult, costly, or lossy to externalize in natural language. For this reason, the future of multimodal AI is likely to depend on architectures in which perception, world modeling, memory formation, communication, and action planning are coordinated through a common latent substrate rather than through loosely coupled modules or additional calculations.

总体而言，调查得出了一个更广泛的结论：多模态模型的未来不在于将以令牌为中心的生成扩展到更多模态，而在于为跨模态推理、记忆、通信和具体交互建立统一的潜在计算基础。在这个框架下，显式语言可能仍然是指导、报告和验证的界面，而潜在空间日益成为模型思考、模拟、协调和行动的内部媒介。Overall, the survey points toward a broader conclusion: the future of multimodal model lies not in expanding token-centric generation to more modalities, but in establishing a unified latent computational substrate for cross-modal reasoning, memory, communication, and embodied interaction. Under this framework, explicit language is likely to remain the interface for instruction, reporting, and verification, whereas latent space increasingly becomes the internal medium in which models think, simulate, coordinate, and act.

下游任务。Downstream Task.未来的下游进展应该被理解为更广泛的转变，其中显式语言仍然是指令、监督和验证的界面，而潜在空间越来越多地充当计算的内部工作空间。根据这种观点，最有前途的下游任务是那些Future downstream progress should be understood as a broader shift in which explicit language remains the interface for instruction, supervision, and verification, while latent space increasingly serves as the internal workspace for computation. Under this view, the most promising downstream tasks are those whose中间状态intermediate states难以被离散的言语痕迹捕获，包括搜索密集型推理are poorly captured by discrete verbal traces, including search-intensive reasoning[survey2025zhu, hao2024training, implicit2025li], 顺序规划, sequential planning[hagendorff2025beyond, yang2025internal]、视觉感知, visual perception[yin2023survey, yin2023survey], 长视野记忆, long-horizon memory[hu2025memory], 多智能体协调, multi-agent coordination[he2025llm]和体现控制, and embodied control[liu2025embodied]。在这些设置中，潜在表示为紧凑搜索、持续细化、更丰富的视觉基础、持久记忆、更高带宽的协调和可转移的动作抽象提供了统一的基础；因此，未来的系统可能会在潜在空间中执行大多数内部推理、规划和状态演化，并且仅将最终输出或战略选择的检查点外部化。更广泛地说，调查表明，潜在空间的核心机会在于从以文本为中心的问题解决转向跨异构任务和模式的持久内部状态管理，尽管实现这一承诺需要在评估、控制、可解释性和界面标准化方面取得原则性进展。. Across these settings, latent representations offer a unified substrate for compact search, continuous refinement, richer visual grounding, persistent memory, higher-bandwidth coordination, and transferable action abstractions; accordingly, future systems are likely to perform most internal inference, planning, and state evolution in latent space, and externalize only final outputs or strategically selected checkpoints. More broadly, the survey suggests that the central opportunity of latent space lies in moving from text-centric problem solving toward persistent internal state management across heterogeneous tasks and modalities, although realizing this promise will require principled progress in evaluation, control, interpretability, and interface standardization.

可治理。Governable.未来一个有希望的方向是将潜在空间发展成可观察和可控制的基质。尽管潜在表示是连续的、紧凑的和富有表现力的，但这些相同的属性也使它们难以评估、控制和解释。因此，未来的工作应该不仅仅是提高潜在推理的准确性，而是建立一个完整的方法论A promising future direction is to develop latent space into an observable and governable substrate. Although latent representations are continuous, compact, and expressive, these same properties also make them difficult to evaluate, control, and interpret. Future work should therefore go beyond improving latent reasoning accuracy, and instead establish a full methodology for值得信赖的trustworthy潜在计算：评估潜在轨迹的真实性和鲁棒性的基准套件；latent computation: benchmark suites that assess the faithfulness and robustness of latent trajectories;监督supervision提供过程级信号而不仅仅是最终答案反馈的策略；可控的潜在接口，使内部动态与明确的目标、资源预算和安全要求保持一致；和strategies that provide process-level signals rather than only final-answer feedback; controllable latent interfaces that align internal dynamics with explicit goals, resource budgets, and safety requirements; and可以解释的explainable识别潜在表示中的语义结构、因果路径和失败源的框架。这些努力将有助于弥合机器本地计算的效率与人类监督的需要之间的差距，从而有可能使潜在空间成为可靠的基础。frameworks that identify semantic structure, causal pathways, and failure sources in latent representations. Such efforts would help bridge the gap between the efficiency of machine-native computation and the need for human oversight, potentially enabling latent space to serve as a dependable substrate.

7 结论Conclusion

在本次调查中，我们从基础、演化、机制、能力和展望五个互补的角度对基于语言的模型中的潜在空间进行了系统回顾。总而言之，这些观点表明，潜在空间应该成为一个基础，可以从根本上重塑智能语言模型处理不同信息的方式。我们进一步表明，该领域的发展已从早期对潜在推理的探索迅速发展到涵盖语言、视觉、记忆、协作和具体行动的更广泛且日益统一的研究范式。In this survey, we have presented a systematic review of latent space in language-based models from five complementary perspectives: foundation, evolution, mechanism, ability, and outlook. Taken together, these perspectives suggest that latent space should be a substrate that may fundamentally reshape how intelligent language models deal with diverse information. We further show that the development of this field has rapidly progressed from early explorations of latent reasoning to a broader and increasingly unified research paradigm spanning language, vision, memory, collaboration, and embodied action.

为了系统地组织这一前景广阔的前景，我们提出了沿着两个正交轴的分类法：机制导向和能力导向。在轴上To systematically organize this promising landscape, we propose a taxonomy along two orthogonal axes: mechanism orientation and ability orientation. On the axis of机制Mechanism，我们对四种关键类型进行了分类：架构、表示、计算和优化，它们定义了潜在空间的操作方式。在轴上, we classify four key types: architecture, representation, computation, and optimization, which defines how latent space is operationalized. On the axis of能力Ability，我们将以往调查中的单一类型扩展为七个主要功能类别：推理、计划、建模、感知、记忆、协作和体现。在这些维度上，一个一致的趋势变得明显：潜在空间给模型机制带来了根本性的转变，同时突破了模型能力的界限。, we expand the single type in previous surveys to seven main functional categories: reasoning, planning, modeling, perception, memory, collaboration, and embodiment. Across these dimensions, a consistent trend becomes visible: Latent space brings a fundamental transformation to model mechanisms while pushing the boundaries of model capabilities.

与此同时，必须同时考虑潜在空间的前景及其尚未解决的挑战。随着越来越多的认知被内化到连续的隐藏计算中，所产生的过程变得更难以评估、控制和解释。因此，未来的进展不仅取决于经验绩效的提高，还取决于建立更坚实的理论基础、更可靠的基准和监管协议以及更透明、可控的潜在机制。总的来说，这项调查的中心结论是，潜在空间有可能成为基于语言的模型的基本原则。我们希望这项调查为未来的研究提供一个连贯的基础，并为未来的研究人员提供有价值的参考。At the same time, the promise of latent space must be considered together with its unresolved challenges. As increasingly more cognition is internalized into continuous hidden computation, the resulting processes become harder to evaluate, control, and interpret. Future progress will therefore depend not only on improving empirical performance, but also on establishing stronger theoretical foundations, more reliable benchmarks and supervision protocols, and more transparent as well as controllable latent mechanisms. Overall, the central conclusion of this survey is that latent space holds the potential to become a foundational principle for language-based models. We hope that this survey offers a coherent foundation for future research and serves as a valuable reference for future researchers.
